This design strictly preserves feature norms, bounds pre-softmax attention logits regardless of the physical translation scale, and maintains exact invariance to global rigid coordinate changes. Across nuScenes and PanShot, which cover large-baseline trajectories and diverse camera optics, respectively, MeRoPE achieves stronger camera control than prior encodings, with the best consistency between generated camera motion and conditioning poses in both rotation and translation. Code will be made publicly available.
summary_zh: 在相机可控视频生成任务中，感知几何信息的位置编码可基于相机外参与逐像素观测射线对token进行条件约束。但现有方案在真实世界度量相机轨迹上存在尺度相关的失效问题：齐次投影编码会导致注意力对数与特征范数随物理平移基线的增大而无限制增长。本研究提出MeRoPE（Metric Rotary Position Embedding，度量旋转位置嵌入）这一面向注意力的保范数相对相机编码方法。MeRoPE通过正交旋转块对已校准观测射线之间的相对朝向进行编码，将原始度量位移映射为多频旋转相位，并沿极线弧添加视差锚定的对应关系先验。该设计可严格保留特征范数，无论物理平移尺度多大都能约束softmax前注意力对数的取值范围，同时保持对全局刚性坐标变换的严格不变性。在分别覆盖大基线轨迹与多样相机光学配置的nuScenes与PanShot数据集上，MeRoPE的相机控制性能优于现有编码方法，生成的相机运动与条件位姿在旋转和平移维度上的一致性均达到最优。相关代码将对外公开。

title: One Prompt Is Enough: Watermark Laundering Through Foundation Image Models
title_zh: 一条提示语即可实现：通过图像基础模型完成水印清洗
authors: Jidong Yang, Qi Li, Wei Zong, Yang-Wai Chow, Willy Susilo 等 (8 人)
abstract: Invisible watermarks are typically evaluated against predefined perturbations such as compression, blur, noise, cropping, and denoising. Public foundation image models expose a distinct threat: an attacker can submit a watermarked image with a single reconstruction prompt and obtain a visually faithful output from which the invisible watermark can no longer be decoded reliably. We formalize this failure mode as watermark laundering and evaluate it using a joint payload-fidelity profile that combines bit error rate (BER) with visual and semantic preservation. Across six OpenAI and Google image editing models, three representative watermarking schemes, and 1,800 reconstructed outputs, we identify two complementary laundering regimes: OpenAI models produce the strongest payload disruption across the evaluated schemes, whereas Nano Banana 2 shows that DwtDct remains vulnerable under high-fidelity reconstruction. Prompt ablations show that no single removal-oriented instruction is necessary for payload disruption, indicating that the effect is primarily induced by the reconstruction pathway rather than by explicit attack wording. Comparisons with conventional attacks further show that prompt-conditioned reconstruction constitutes a distinct operational attack interface. These findings motivate foundation-model reconstruction as a missing robustness condition in invisible watermark evaluation.
summary_zh: 现有隐式水印技术通常仅针对压缩、模糊、噪声、裁剪与去噪等预定义扰动开展鲁棒性评估。公开可用的图像基础模型带来了全新的安全威胁：攻击者可向模型输入带水印的图像并附带一条重建提示语，即可得到视觉保真度高、但隐式水印已无法被可靠解码的输出结果。本研究将该失效模式正式定义为水印清洗，采用结合误码率与视觉、语义保真度的有效载荷-保真度联合评估框架开展相关测试。在6个OpenAI与Google图像编辑模型、3种代表性水印方案、总计1800个重建输出上开展的实验表明，存在两类互补的清洗模式：OpenAI模型对所有评估水印方案的有效载荷破坏能力最强，而Nano Banana 2的测试结果表明DwtDct水印在高保真重建场景下仍存在脆弱性。提示语消融实验表明，无需任何专门面向水印移除的指令即可实现有效载荷破坏，说明该效应主要由重建路径本身引发，而非显式攻击措辞导致。与传统攻击方法的对比进一步证明，提示语条件重建构成了一类全新的可操作攻击接口。上述研究结果表明，基础模型重建场景应当成为隐式水印评估中不可缺失的鲁棒性测试条件。

title: S$^2$Prune: Spatially Structured Visual Token Pruning for Multimodal Large Language Models
title_zh: S²Prune：面向多模态大语言模型的空间结构化视觉token剪枝方法
authors: Yuanyuan Jia, Shunpu Tang, Qianqian Yang
abstract: Visual token pruning reduces the inference overhead of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) by retaining only a subset of visual tokens. Existing methods usually select tokens based on importance or redundancy. However, we observe that these criteria produce stable spatial biases across inputs and do not always outperform simple Uniform Grid sampling, highlighting the value of broad spatial coverage. Motivated by this, we propose S$^2$Prune, a training-free pruning method that preserves spatial coverage while adapting token density to local image structure. We first divide the image into regions and assign at least one token to each region to preserve coverage. The remaining token budget is then distributed according to Laplacian variation, giving more tokens to regions with richer structure. We then use Early Representation Change (ERC), computed from the first decoder block, to select representative tokens within each region. We evaluate S$^2$Prune across diverse settings and two MLLM architectures. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, it achieves the highest average accuracy among the evaluated training-free pruning methods. With only 32 of the original 576 visual tokens, it still retains 79.3% of the full-model performance. Code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 视觉token剪枝通过仅保留部分视觉token降低多模态大语言模型（Multimodal Large Language Models, MLLMs）的推理开销。现有方法通常基于重要性或冗余度选择token，但本研究发现这类选择标准会在不同输入上产生稳定的空间偏置，性能并不总能超越简单的均匀网格采样方法，说明保证广泛的空间覆盖度具备重要价值。受该发现启发，本研究提出S²Prune这一无需训练的剪枝方法，可在保留空间覆盖度的同时根据图像局部结构自适应调整token密度。该方法首先将图像划分为多个区域，为每个区域至少分配1个token以保证空间覆盖度，随后根据拉普拉斯方差将剩余token预算分配给各区域，为结构更丰富的区域分配更多token，最后利用从首个解码器块计算得到的早期表征变化（Early Representation Change, ERC）在每个区域内选择代表性token。本研究在多样设置与两类MLLM架构上对S²Prune开展评估，在Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct模型上，该方法在所有评估的无需训练剪枝方法中取得最高平均准确率，仅使用原始576个视觉token中的32个时，仍可保留全模型79.3%的性能。相关代码已公开。

title: Compressing AI Traffic: Standardized Neural Network Coding of Visual-Token Representations in Split Vision-Language Inference
title_zh: AI流量压缩：拆分式视觉-语言推理中视觉token表示的标准化神经网络编码
authors: Reza Heidari, Hamed R. Tavakoli, Juho Kannala
abstract: When the visual encoder and the language decoder of a vision-language model (VLM) run on different compute nodes, the intermediate visual-token embeddings become a communicated payload rather than an internal activation. We call such machine-consumed intermediate tensors AI traffic and ask how far they can be compressed with a standardized, training-free codec. We insert ISO/IEC 15938-17 Neural Network Coding (NNC) round trips on the complete visual interface of a Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct video question answering pipeline, comprising the main visual-token representation and the DeepStack feature streams, while leaving weights, prompts, and generation untouched, and sweep the quantization parameter (QP) over a wide rate range. Closed-ended Video-MME accuracy remains close to the uncompressed reference up to a 98% reduction of the transmitted BF16 tensor and only then collapses; open-ended MLVU generation shows the same plateau-and-collapse profile under an LLM judge. This robustness is not due to near-lossless reconstruction: the decoded tensor is heavily discretized, carries substantial row-wise relative L2 error, and has a visibly steeper singular-value decay than its source. Downstream reasoning therefore depends on coarse structure and relative geometry rather than exact floating-point values, which argues for rate-task rather than rate-distortion optimization of AI traffic codecs.
summary_zh: 当视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Model, VLM）的视觉编码器与语言解码器部署在不同计算节点上时，中间视觉token嵌入就从内部激活转变为需要传输的负载。本研究将这类机器生成的中间张量定义为AI流量，探索其在采用标准化、无需训练编解码器的前提下可实现的压缩极限。本研究在Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct视频问答流水线的完整视觉接口上插入符合ISO/IEC 15938-17神经网络编码（Neural Network Coding, NNC）标准的往返处理流程，覆盖主视觉token表示与DeepStack特征流，不改动模型权重、提示语与生成过程，在大范围内调整量化参数（Quantization Parameter, QP）测试压缩性能。实验结果表明，当传输的BF16张量压缩率最高达到98%时，闭集Video-MME精度仍接近未压缩参考值，仅在压缩率进一步提升时性能才会骤降；在大语言模型裁判评估下的开集MLVU生成任务也呈现出相同的平台-骤降特性。该鲁棒性并非来自近无损重建：解码后的张量已被高度离散化，存在显著的行级相对L2误差，且奇异值衰减速度明显快于原始张量。这说明下游推理依赖的是粗粒度结构与相对几何关系，而非精确浮点值，因此AI流量编解码器应当面向码率-任务性能优化，而非传统的码率-失真度优化。

title: Monocular Depth Estimation from a Single Image: Progress and Opportunities
title_zh: 单图像单目深度估计：研究进展与机遇
authors: Muxin Liu, Xiaoyang Lyu, Yang-Tian Sun, Yi-Hua Huang, Ziyi Yang 等 (7 人)
abstract: Monocular depth estimation has long stood as a fundamental challenge in computer vision, enabling a wide range of applications including 3D reconstruction, robotics, autonomous driving, and augmented reality. This survey traces the field's evolution from early learning-based methods to the emergence of transformative foundation models. We begin by framing the problem, distinguishing between relative and metric depth estimation, and highlighting the key challenges that have shaped a decade of research. We then present common problem formulations and introduce the most widely used datasets, covering indoor, outdoor, and synthetic data. Following this, we review major advances prior to the foundation model era, distilling core insights from influential methods that contributed to improvements in accuracy, efficiency, and robustness. The survey then turns to the recent surge of foundation-model-based approaches, categorizing them into discriminative and generative paradigms and emphasizing the critical roles of large-scale pretraining (e.g., DINOv3) and synthetic data. We compare representative models using both quantitative benchmarks and qualitative examples, and discuss natural extensions to video-based depth estimation. Further, to illustrate real-world impact, we highlight the integration of depth estimation into applications such as visual SLAM, content generation, and robot perception. Finally, we outline open challenges and promising research directions as the field advances further into the era of foundation models.
summary_zh: 单目深度估计长期以来都是计算机视觉领域的基础挑战性任务，可支撑3D重建、机器人、自动驾驶、增强现实等广泛应用场景。本综述梳理了该领域从早期基于学习的方法到变革性基础模型涌现的发展历程：首先明确任务定义，区分相对深度估计与度量深度估计两类任务，总结推动该领域十年研究发展的核心挑战；随后介绍通用任务范式与覆盖室内、室外、合成数据的主流公开数据集；之后回顾基础模型时代到来前的核心技术进展，从各类代表性方法中提炼出可提升精度、效率与鲁棒性的核心洞见；进一步梳理近年基于基础模型的单目深度估计方法的爆发式发展成果，将其划分为判别式与生成式两大范式，重点强调大规模预训练（如DINOv3）与合成数据的关键作用。本综述通过定量基准测试与定性样例对比代表性模型，探讨了向视频深度估计方向的自然拓展路径；结合视觉SLAM、内容生成、机器人感知等落地场景的应用案例，阐释该技术的实际产业价值；最后面向基础模型时代的下一阶段发展，总结当前尚未解决的开放挑战与极具潜力的研究方向。

title: Dotting the Eye: An Intent-Driven Image Retouching Agent for Visual Focus Enhancement
title_zh: 画龙点睛：面向视觉焦点增强的意图驱动图像修图智能体
authors: Chujie Qin, Zilong Zhang, Zewei Chang, Chunle Guo, Ruixing Wang 等 (8 人)
abstract: Image retouching is commonly formulated as enhancing overall visual quality through color adjustment, but in practice, it also serves to emphasize visual focus by guiding viewers' attention toward a specific subject or region. Achieving such focus-oriented retouching is inherently challenging, as it requires well-coordinated global and local adjustments to manipulate perceptual saliency while maintaining visual naturalness. This intricate process typically demands substantial professional expertise. In this study, we propose EyeControl, a MLLM-driven agent with a diffusion-based retouching executor that enables visual focus enhancement under weak user intent. With only a few clicks or coarse strokes, EyeControl directs visual attention to the intended region, effectively "dotting the eye" of the image. The core idea is to explicitly link the weak user intention with the target editing region and the corresponding tonal adjustment operations during retouching. To achieve this, the system first interprets the intent and image content to infer the visual focus and generate structured intent guidance for the retouching executor. Second, the retouching executor is encouraged to respond more strongly to the target region, explicitly aligning its attention map with a designed pseudo-intent map. We also introduce an operation-consistency constraint to improve coordination between global and local adjustments, achieving more natural and coherent retouching. Additionally, we contribute ControlArt-Bench, a high-quality evaluation dataset for visual focus enhancement. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that EyeControl yields perceptually appealing results with stronger intent alignment. Code can be found inthis https URL.
summary_zh: 图像修图通常被定义为通过色彩调整提升整体视觉质量，但在实际应用中，修图也承担着引导观众注意力向特定主体或区域聚集、强化视觉焦点的作用。这类面向焦点的修图任务难度极高，需要全局与局部调整高度协同，在保持视觉自然度的前提下调控感知显著性，该复杂过程通常要求操作者具备极强的专业技能积累。本研究提出EyeControl，这是一款由MLLM（多模态大语言模型）驱动、搭载扩散模型修图执行器的智能体，可在用户意图输入极弱的条件下完成视觉焦点增强：用户仅需少量点击或粗略涂抹，EyeControl即可将视觉注意力引导至目标区域，实现对图像的有效“画龙点睛”效果。该方法的核心思路是在修图过程中显式地将用户弱意图与目标编辑区域、对应色调调整操作进行关联：系统首先解读用户意图与图像内容，推断视觉焦点并为修图执行器生成结构化意图引导；其次引导修图执行器对目标区域生成更强响应，将其注意力图与专门设计的伪意图图显式对齐；同时引入操作一致性约束提升全局与局部调整的协同性，生成更自然连贯的修图结果。此外本研究构建了面向视觉焦点增强的高质量评估数据集ControlArt-Bench。大量实验表明，EyeControl生成的结果视觉观感优异，与用户意图的匹配度更高，相关代码已公开。

title: On the Design Fundamentals of Pixel Text Representation Learning
title_zh: 像素文本表征学习的设计基础研究
authors: Chaohao Yuan, Ruifeng Yuan, Zhuoxu Huang, Yu Rong, Hong Cheng 等 (7 人)
abstract: Text-rich visual inputs require models that can read, retrieve, and compress language directly in pixel space, yet existing pixel-text encoders struggle with fixed resolution pretraining, visual shortcut learning, weak visual grounding, and multilingual visual text understanding. In this work, we investigate the fundamental design principles required for robust visual text representation learning. Through systematic controlled ablations, we identify four critical components: variable image resolutions and rendered font sizes provide spatial proxies for high-resolution document generalization; natural image-text pairs are indispensable for grounding and prevent text-only collapse; layout-aware rendering helps prevent pixel-level shortcuts; and a two-stage multilingual curriculum enables effective cross-lingual alignment. By integrating these principles into a scalable training recipe, we train Pixel Linguist II, a native-resolution vision encoder trained with on-the-fly rendering, unified contrastive grounding, and a multilingual curriculum over 280M training examples. Pixel Linguist II sets new state-of-the-art results on English, cross-lingual, and multilingual Visual STS and ViDoRe, while also enabling better MLLM downstream evaluation. Notably, Pixel Linguist II remains robust under 80\% visual token compression, showing great promise for optical context compression. Our code and resources are available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 富含文本的视觉输入要求模型能够直接在像素空间完成语言的读取、检索与压缩，但现有像素文本编码器普遍存在固定分辨率预训练、视觉捷径学习、视觉 grounding 能力弱、多语言视觉文本理解效果差等缺陷。本研究面向鲁棒的视觉文本表征学习，探索其所需的核心设计原则：通过系统的控制变量消融实验，识别出四项关键组件：可变图像分辨率与渲染字体尺寸可为高分辨率文档泛化提供空间代理；自然图文配对数据是实现视觉 grounding、避免仅生成文本的模式崩溃的必要条件；布局感知渲染可避免像素级捷径学习；两阶段多语言课程学习可实现高效的跨语言对齐。将上述原则整合到可扩展训练流程中，本研究训练得到Pixel Linguist II，这一原生分辨率视觉编码器采用实时渲染、统一对比学习grounding与覆盖2.8亿训练样本的多语言课程学习策略训练而成。Pixel Linguist II在英文、跨语言、多语言Visual STS与ViDoRe基准测试集上均取得当前最优性能，同时可提升多模态大语言模型下游任务的评估表现。值得注意的是，Pixel Linguist II在80%视觉token压缩率下仍保持鲁棒性，在光学上下文压缩场景中展现出极高的应用潜力，相关代码与资源已公开。

title: StainPresetNet: Stain Preset Network for Fast Multi-to-Multi Stain Normalization
title_zh: StainPresetNet：面向快速多对多染色归一化的染色预设网络
authors: Hongtao Kang, Die Luo, Li Chen, Jing Cai, Junbo Hu 等 (7 人)
abstract: Stain normalization reduces color variations caused by variations in staining protocols and imaging conditions, thereby enhancing computer-aided diagnostic system performance. Traditional methods derive mapping relationships from individual or limited reference images through pixel-wise transformation, offering style flexibility but suffering from inaccurate color mapping extraction. While existing deep-learning-based approaches achieve accurate dataset-wide color mapping through complex neural networks, they face challenges including computational inefficiency, artifact generation, and fixed normalization directions requiring model retraining for directional changes. To address these limitations, we propose StainPresetNet - a novel framework that combines structural preservation with dataset-level color mapping while maintaining computational efficiency. Our method implements pixel-wise normalization guided by preset reference images, enabling multi-directional adaptability without retraining. Evaluations on cytopathology and histopathology datasets demonstrate that StainPresetNet achieves superior color mapping accuracy compared to conventional methods, effectively improves classifier generalization in diagnostic tasks, and reduces computational overhead by 90\% versus existing deep learning approaches. The proposed preset-guided mechanism facilitates flexible adjustment of normalization directions through simple reference image replacement, overcoming the directional rigidity of current deep-learning-based solutions.
summary_zh: 染色归一化可消除染色方案与成像条件差异导致的颜色偏差，进而提升计算机辅助诊断系统的性能。传统方法通过像素级变换从单张或有限参考图像中推导映射关系，具备风格灵活的优势，但存在颜色映射提取不准确的问题；现有深度学习方法通过复杂神经网络实现数据集级的精准颜色映射，但普遍存在计算效率低、易生成伪影、归一化方向固定（变更方向需要重新训练模型）等缺陷。针对上述局限，本研究提出StainPresetNet这一全新框架，在保留结构信息的同时实现数据集级颜色映射，且具备极高计算效率。该方法通过预设参考图像引导像素级归一化，无需重新训练即可实现多方向适配。在细胞病理与组织病理数据集上的评估结果表明，StainPresetNet的颜色映射精度优于传统方法，可有效提升诊断任务中分类器的泛化能力，与现有深度学习方法相比计算开销降低90%。该预设引导机制仅需替换参考图像即可灵活调整归一化方向，解决了当前深度学习染色归一化方案方向刚性的问题。

title: Revisiting Face Recognition for Monozygotic Twins: The Celeb Twins Test Set
title_zh: 面向同卵双胞胎人脸识别的再研究：Celeb Twins测试集
authors: Michael Zang, Haiyu Wu, Mrinal Sharma, Kevin W. Bowyer
abstract: Past literature on face recognition for monozygotic (("identical") twins points to facial marks and mirror asymmetry as possible directions for improved accuracy of twins recognition. The Celeb Twins Test Set (CTTS) contains web-scraped image pairs for 80 sets of celebrity twins. It is the only twins test set with meta-data for twins with distinguishing skin marks and possible mirror asymmetry. CTTS is organized in the manner of face verification test sets such as LFW, CALFW, CPLFW, CFP-FP, and AgeDB-30. Current deep CNN matchers can achieve over 76% accuracy in classifying CTTS same-person / different-person image pairs. We show that current matchers do not make use of skin marks, or asymmetry, and discuss reasons for this. Finally, we discuss the feasibility of using generative AI tools such as Grok, ChatGPT and Gemini to create images of imagined monozygotic twins as a means to increase representation of twins in face recognition training sets.
summary_zh: 过往同卵双胞胎人脸识别相关研究指出，面部标记与镜像不对称是提升双胞胎识别精度的潜在优化方向。本次构建的Celeb Twins测试集（CTTS）包含80组名人双胞胎的网络爬取图像对，是目前唯一附带区分性皮肤标记、潜在镜像不对称元数据的双胞胎测试集，其组织方式与LFW、CALFW、CPLFW、CFP-FP、AgeDB-30等人脸验证测试集保持一致。当前深度CNN匹配器在CTTS的“同一人/不同人”图像对分类任务中可实现超过76%的精度，但实验表明现有匹配器并未利用皮肤标记或面部不对称特征，本文对该现象的成因进行了讨论。最后本研究探讨了使用Grok、ChatGPT、Gemini等生成式AI工具生成虚构同卵双胞胎图像、提升人脸识别训练集中双胞胎样本占比的可行性。

title: Different Changes Require Different Reasoning: Change-Type-Specialized Experts for Robust Change Captioning
title_zh: 不同变更需要不同推理：面向鲁棒变更描述的变更类型专用专家模型
authors: Jiyoung Park, InJae Oh, Jung Uk Kim
abstract: Change captioning is the task of generating natural language descriptions that explain the changes between a pair of images. Although different change types (e.g., color shifts, object additions) exhibit distinct visual cues and require specialized reasoning processes, existing methods often overlook these distinctions. To address this limitation, we propose Multi-Expert Diagnosis for Image Change (MEDIC), a novel framework that introduces change-type awareness by explicitly modeling change categories. MEDIC employs type-specialized memory experts that dynamically retrieve type-relevant visual patterns conditioned on the input. This design enables each expert to capture diverse variations within its change type while focusing on the most informative visual cues. By softly routing inputs across type-specialized experts and learning dedicated representations for each change category, MEDIC generates more precise and type-aware change descriptions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed MEDIC consistently outperforms existing methods across diverse and challenging datasets. The code is available at \href{this https URL}{GitHub}.
summary_zh: 变更描述任务指生成自然语言描述解释一对图像之间的差异。尽管不同变更类型（如颜色偏移、物体新增）具备完全不同的视觉线索，需要差异化的推理流程，现有方法普遍忽略了这类差异。针对该局限，本研究提出MEDIC（面向图像变更的多专家诊断框架），通过显式建模变更类别引入变更类型感知能力。MEDIC采用类型专用记忆专家，可根据输入动态检索与变更类型相关的视觉模式，该设计使得每个专家能够聚焦于最具信息量的视觉线索，捕获对应变更类型下的各类差异化变化。通过在类型专用专家之间对输入进行软路由，为每类变更学习专属表征，MEDIC可生成更精准、更符合变更类型特征的变更描述。大量实验表明，所提出的MEDIC在各类高难度数据集上的表现始终优于现有方法，相关代码已在GitHub开源。

title: P-PatchDiff: Progressive Patch Diffusion Models for Low-light Image Enhancement
title_zh: P-PatchDiff：面向低光照图像增强的渐进式补丁扩散模型
authors: Ruoyu Guo, Haonan Zhong, Maurice Pagnucco, Yang Song
abstract: Recent advancements in low-light image enhancement have leveraged diffusion models for their strong ability to generate perceptually realistic, detailed images. Patch diffusion models further offer a promising solution to size-agnostic image restoration while improving efficiency. However, existing methods typically rely on small, fixed patches (e.g., 64$\times$64) that cannot capture image-level brightness context, whereas enlarging the receptive field improves brightness and colour estimation but substantially increases computational cost. Moreover, low-light images often exhibit uneven brightness across regions, making it necessary to ensure that locally enhanced patches remain visually coherent when combined into the full image. To address these limitations, we propose P-PatchDiff, a scalable progressive patch diffusion framework for low-light image enhancement that dynamically adjusts patch size throughout the denoising process, enabling a gradual shift from local to global views. A Multi-Patch Alignment strategy is also introduced to normalise features across varying patch scales using an estimated global brightness proxy. Rather than pursuing pixel-level reconstruction accuracy, P-PatchDiff focuses on scalability and coherent brightness across the whole image, allowing the model to perceive multi-scale information and better enhance regions with varying brightness. We empirically demonstrate that P-PatchDiff effectively enhances images ranging from 400 $\times$ 600 to 4K and is 80$\times$ faster than existing patch diffusion models while using less than 9GB of memory. The code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 近年低光照图像增强领域借助扩散模型生成感知真实、细节丰富图像的强能力取得了诸多进展，补丁扩散模型进一步为尺寸无关的图像恢复提供了可行方案，同时提升了计算效率。但现有方法普遍采用64×64这类固定小补丁，无法捕获图像级亮度上下文；扩大感受野可提升亮度与颜色估计效果，但会大幅提升计算成本。此外低光照图像不同区域亮度分布不均，局部增强后的补丁拼接为完整图像时需要保证视觉连贯性。针对上述局限，本研究提出P-PatchDiff，这一可扩展的渐进式补丁扩散框架面向低光照图像增强任务，可在去噪过程中动态调整补丁尺寸，实现从局部视角到全局视角的逐步过渡。本研究还提出多补丁对齐策略，通过估计的全局亮度代理对不同补丁尺度下的特征进行归一化。P-PatchDiff不追求像素级重建精度，而是聚焦于全图亮度的可扩展性与连贯性，让模型感知多尺度信息，更好地增强不同亮度区域的图像。实验结果表明，P-PatchDiff可有效增强分辨率从400×600到4K的图像，速度是现有补丁扩散模型的80倍，运行内存占用低于9GB，相关代码已公开。

title: When Modality Gap Reduction Fails: Prediction-Level Hubness in CLIP
title_zh: 模态间隙缩减失效场景研究：CLIP中的预测级hubness问题
authors: Shota Sato, Hajime Kiyama, Tosho Hirasawa, Mamoru Komachi
abstract: Reducing the modality gap between image and text representations in CLIP is widely expected to improve cross-modal alignment and downstream performance. However, a smaller average image-text gap does not necessarily lead to consistent accuracy gains. We analyze this mismatch from the perspective of the decision structure in zero-shot classification, i.e. selecting the most similar class-text prototype for an input image. Zero-shot accuracy depends not only on average image--text alignment, but also on class-wise decision margins. Using Linear correction as an analytically tractable case, we show that modality gap correction can alter the relative decision structure among classes and cause predictions to concentrate on a small subset of classes. We refer to this output-space failure mode as prediction-level hubness. Furthermore, experiments across multiple datasets show that accuracy degradation under gap correction is consistently associated with increased prediction concentration, both for Linear correction and for learning-based correction methods. This provides a systematic explanation of why modality gap reduction does not consistently improve CLIP zero-shot accuracy from the perspective of downstream decision structure. Our results suggest that gap correction should be evaluated not only by average alignment, but also by its impact on downstream prediction structure.
summary_zh: 缩减CLIP中图像与文本表征的模态间隙被广泛认为可提升跨模态对齐效果与下游任务性能，但平均图文间隙的缩小并不一定会带来精度的持续提升。本研究从零样本分类的决策结构（即从所有类别文本原型中选择与输入图像最相似的原型）视角解释该不匹配现象：零样本精度不仅取决于平均图文对齐效果，还与各类别的决策边距相关。以线性校正作为可解析案例的分析结果表明，模态间隙校正会改变类别间的相对决策结构，导致预测结果集中在少数类别中，本研究将这类输出空间失效模式定义为预测级hubness。多数据集实验表明，无论是线性校正还是基于学习的校正方法，间隙校正过程中的精度下降始终与预测集中度上升相关。本研究从下游决策结构的角度系统解释了模态间隙缩减无法持续提升CLIP零样本精度的原因，结果表明间隙校正的评估不能仅参考平均对齐效果，还需要考量其对下游预测结构的影响。

title: IT-TextFusion: Iterative Text-Image Interaction with Text-Guided Residual Refinement for Degradation-Aware Image Fusion
title_zh: IT-TextFusion：面向感知退化图像融合的文本引导残差细化迭代图文交互框架
authors: Siyang Liu, Peiyi Zhou, Tianle Jin, Rongrong Bian, Zheke Jin 等 (6 人)
abstract: Text-guided image fusion has recently emerged as an effective paradigm for integrating multi-modal information while enabling flexible and task-oriented fusion control. However, existing text-guided fusion methods often rely on shallow semantic-visual interaction and limited attention mechanisms, which restrict their ability to robustly handle complex degradations and fully exploit textual guidance. In this paper, we propose an iterative text-guided image fusion framework that incorporates text-conditioned feature interaction across multiple fusion and refinement stages. The proposed method integrates deepest-level Cross-Attention, multi-scale Cross-Gate Fusion, and stage-specific text-conditioned modulation, allowing the global text embedding to condition hierarchical feature fusion and residual refinement. By repeatedly injecting the pooled text embedding across hierarchical decoder and refinement stages, the proposed framework provides degradation-aware global semantic conditioning while preserving complementary information from the visible and infrared modalities. Experiments on several benchmark datasets show that the proposed method improves several information-preservation and perceptual-quality metrics, while exhibiting metric-dependent trade-offs on some datasets.
summary_zh: 文本引导图像融合是近年新兴的有效范式，可在实现多模态信息整合的同时支持灵活的面向任务的融合控制。但现有文本引导融合方法普遍采用浅层语义-视觉交互与有限注意力机制，难以鲁棒处理复杂退化场景，无法充分利用文本引导信息。本研究提出迭代式文本引导图像融合框架，在多轮融合与细化阶段引入文本条件特征交互。该方法整合深度跨注意力机制、多尺度跨门融合与阶段专属文本条件调制模块，让全局文本嵌入可对层级特征融合与残差细化过程进行条件约束。通过在层级解码器与细化阶段反复注入池化后的文本嵌入，该框架可在保留可见光与红外模态互补信息的同时，生成感知退化的全局语义约束。在多个基准数据集上的实验结果表明，所提方法可提升多项信息保留与感知质量指标，同时在部分数据集上呈现出与指标相关的性能权衡特性。

title: Let Confidence Change, Not the Prediction: Prediction-Preserving Repair for Post-hoc Calibration
title_zh: 让置信度调整、预测结果保持不变：面向后验校准的预测保留修复方法
authors: Daehwan Kim, Haejun Chung, Ikbeom Jang
abstract: Post-hoc calibration corrects reported confidence, yet a multiclass calibrator can also change the associated top-1 prediction. Accuracy captures only the net effect of these changes on correctness, not how often predictions change; the Top-1 Prediction Change Rate (TPCR) instead measures this frequency. We propose Calibrator-Output Repair for Top-1 Decision Preservation (CORD), the first post-fit adapter to impose exact prediction preservation by repairing the full calibrated probability vector. From the original and calibrated outputs alone, CORD determines the mass assigned to the original top-1. The calibrated conditional distribution allocates the remaining mass over the other classes, yielding a repaired vector whose own argmax recovers the original prediction. On the calibration split, CORD coordinates the repaired masses to retain the calibrated outputs' mean mass on original predictions whenever attainable. The adapter alters neither the fitted calibrator nor its direct output, fits no additional supervised map, and requires no user- or validation-tuned hyperparameter. Across CIFAR-10/100 and ImageNet-1K, CORD attains zero TPCR by construction and lowers mean ECE, NLL, and Brier relative to the corresponding direct outputs in every dataset; paired gains persist under distribution shift and across calibration-set sizes. CORD thus removes the preservation constraint from calibrator fitting and assigns exact recovery of the original decision to subsequent output repair. Our code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 后验校准用于修正模型输出的置信度，但多类校准器可能同时改变对应的Top-1预测结果。精度指标仅能反映这类变更对结果正确性的净影响，无法衡量预测结果发生变更的频率，而Top-1预测变更率（TPCR）可直接度量该频率。本研究提出CORD（面向Top-1决策保留的校准器输出修复方法），这是首个通过修复完整校准概率向量实现严格预测保留的后适配模块：仅基于原始输出与校准后输出，CORD即可确定分配给原始Top-1类别的概率质量，校准后的条件分布将剩余概率质量分配给其余类别，最终生成的修复向量的argmax结果与原始预测完全一致。在校准集划分阶段，CORD可在可行范围内协调修复后的概率质量，保留校准输出中原始预测的平均概率质量。该适配模块既不修改已训练的校准器也不改变其直接输出，无需额外训练监督映射，也不需要用户或验证集调优超参数。在CIFAR-10/100与ImageNet-1K数据集上，CORD从原理上实现了零TPCR，且在所有数据集上的平均ECE、NLL、Brier指标均优于对应直接校准输出，该优势在分布偏移场景与不同校准集尺寸下均稳定存在。CORD将预测保留约束从校准器训练阶段剥离，将原始决策的精确恢复任务交由后续输出修复环节完成，相关代码已公开。

title: Lightweight Interpretable RGB-Guided Hyperspectral Super-Resolution under Real Cross-resolution Misalignment
title_zh: 真实跨分辨率失配场景下轻量可解释的RGB引导高光谱超分辨率方法
authors: Mohamad Jouni, Aurélien Godet, Mauro Dalla Mura
abstract: Compact snapshot hyperspectral cameras provide rich instantaneous spectral measurements for ground-level machine vision, but at lower spatial resolution than standard RGB cameras. RGB-guided hyperspectral super-resolution (HSR) addresses this limitation by transferring spatial detail from a high-resolution RGB guide to a low-resolution hyperspectral image (HSI). These dual-camera systems are typically in a horizontal rig geometry, requiring cross-camera image alignment due to different fields of view. However, residual misregistration can inject spurious high-frequency details. Existing learned unaligned-fusion methods are usually trained for a fixed spectral support and spatial scale factors and can be computationally demanding, limiting their flexibility across sensors. We propose a lightweight and interpretable RGB-guided HSR framework combining cross-modal flow alignment with model-based Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization fusion. The method first warps the RGB guide onto the HSI grid, then estimates an energy-based confidence weight map by measuring local alignment reliability. This map is then used both in a weighted least-squares spectral regression and in a gated fusion between the super-resolved estimate and an HSI-preserving estimate. Unlike existing learned methods, the proposed framework has a low computational footprint and supports VIS-NIR spectral supports and scale factors without retraining. Experiments on the Real benchmark show that the proposed method improves reconstruction accuracy over learned fusion baselines while remaining substantially faster. On a 34-frame sequence acquired with our real RGB-HSI dual-camera setup, a reduced-resolution quantitative evaluation validates the method under genuine cross-sensor radiometric, noise, and geometric differences, while native-resolution qualitative results demonstrate deployment on the full 51-band VIS-NIR acquisition.
summary_zh: 紧凑型快照式高光谱相机可为地面级机器视觉提供丰富的瞬时光谱测量数据，但其空间分辨率低于标准RGB相机。RGB引导高光谱超分辨率（HSR）技术可将高分辨率RGB引导图的空间细节迁移至低分辨率高光谱图像（HSI），从而弥补上述缺陷。这类双相机系统通常采用水平支架构型，由于两个相机视场不同，需要进行跨相机图像对齐，但残留的配准误差会引入虚假高频细节。现有基于学习的未对齐融合方法通常针对固定光谱支持范围和空间缩放因子训练，计算成本较高，跨传感器适配灵活性受限。本文提出一种轻量可解释的RGB引导高光谱超分辨率框架，将跨模态光流对齐与基于模型的格拉姆-施密特正交化融合相结合。该方法首先将RGB引导图扭曲对齐到高光谱图像网格上，随后通过测量局部对齐可靠性估计出基于能量的置信权重图，该权重图同时用于加权最小二乘光谱回归，以及超分辨率估计结果与高光谱保真估计结果之间的门控融合。与现有学习类方法不同，所提框架计算开销极低，无需重新训练即可支持可见光-近红外光谱范围和任意缩放因子。在Real基准数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法相比学习类融合基线方法提升了重建精度，同时运行速度大幅提升。在使用自研RGB-HSI双相机采集的34帧序列上，降分辨率定量评估验证了该方法在真实跨传感器辐射差异、噪声差异和几何差异下的有效性，原生分辨率定性结果证明该方法可部署于完整的51波段可见光-近红外采集任务中。

title: Dyn-3D: Unveiling and Resolving Ego-Motion Ambiguity in Vision-Language Models
title_zh: Dyn-3D：揭示并解决视觉语言模型中的自运动歧义问题
authors: Jiayu Ding, Zhuodong Liu, Lei Zhang, Manyu Xiong, Hongbo Jin 等 (9 人)
abstract: As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) tackle dynamic 3D spatial reasoning, ego-motion perception becomes essential to resolve monocular scale ambiguity. However, current models often overfit to smooth trajectory priors rather than genuinely understanding physical motion. Consequently, their spatial reasoning degrades severely under large displacements, a phenomenon we term Kinematic Collapse. This failure stems from spurious visual-motion correlations in natural videos and a lack of explicit physical supervision. To evaluate this, we introduce Dyn-3D, a benchmark using counterfactual 3D rendering to rigorously decouple visual changes from true kinematic properties. Furthermore, we propose the TempoVista framework, featuring the Kinematic-GSPO algorithm. By embedding metric physical ground truth into policy optimization, TempoVista explicitly grounds visual representations in 3D space. Experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly improves both motion estimation and robust spatial reasoning by utilizing camera dynamics as an effective geometric calibration signal.
summary_zh: 随着视觉语言模型（VLMs）逐步处理动态3D空间推理任务，自运动感知成为解决单目尺度歧义的核心要素。但当前模型往往过度拟合平滑轨迹先验，并未真正理解物理运动规律，导致其在大位移场景下空间推理性能严重下降，本文将该现象定义为运动坍缩。该失效问题源于自然视频中虚假的视觉-运动关联，以及缺乏显式的物理监督信号。为了对该问题进行评估，本文构建了Dyn-3D基准，通过反事实3D渲染严格将视觉变化与真实运动属性解耦。此外本文还提出了TempoVista框架，核心为Kinematic-GSPO算法，该算法将度量级物理真值嵌入策略优化过程，将视觉表示显式锚定在3D空间中。实验结果表明，通过将相机动力学作为有效的几何校准信号，本文方法可同时显著提升运动估计性能和空间推理鲁棒性。

title: SAGE: Subpopulation-Aware Generative Enhancement for Mitigating Spurious Correlations
title_zh: SAGE：用于缓解伪相关的亚群体感知生成增强方法
authors: Yiming Luo, Rongqiang Zhao, Jie Liu
abstract: Spurious correlations pose a significant challenge to the robustness of modern machine learning. The inherent imbalance in dataset distributions often leads traditional Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM) models to rely on majority spurious attributes for classification, resulting in poor performance on minority groups. This problem becomes particularly challenging when the spurious attributes are unavailable. Existing group-label-free methods often upsample minority groups or misclassified real training examples; repeating the same instances can reduce effective diversity and encourage overfitting. To mitigate these spurious correlations from a data-centric perspective in the absence of prior knowledge, we introduce Subpopulation-Aware Generative Enhancement (SAGE), a two-stage generative augmentation framework. Using cluster-derived sub-labels and class labels, we fine-tune a conditional generative model and text encoder, generating targeted synthetic data to fill underrepresented regions in the training set and construct a balanced validation set for last-layer reweighting. We experimentally show that SAGE achieves 89.5%, 85.7%, and 79.1% worst-group accuracy on Waterbirds, CelebA, and MetaShift, respectively, outperforming the best group-label-free baselines by up to 7.7 percentage points.
summary_zh: 伪相关是现代机器学习鲁棒性面临的核心挑战。数据集分布的固有不平衡性往往导致传统经验风险最小化（ERM）模型依赖多数群体的伪属性完成分类，在少数群体上表现不佳。当伪属性不可获取时，该问题的解决难度进一步提升。现有无需群体标签的方法通常采用上采样少数群体或误分类训练样本的策略，但重复相同实例会降低有效多样性，引发过拟合。为了在无先验知识的前提下从数据中心视角缓解伪相关问题，本文提出亚群体感知生成增强框架SAGE，这是一个两阶段生成式增强框架。该方法利用聚类得到的子标签和类别标签对条件生成模型和文本编码器进行微调，生成针对性合成数据以填补训练集中代表性不足的区域，同时构建平衡验证集用于最后一层权重重校准。实验结果表明，SAGE在Waterbirds、CelebA和MetaShift数据集上的最差组准确率分别达到89.5%、85.7%和79.1%，相比最优的无群体标签基线方法性能提升最高达7.7个百分点。

title: ViTAMINS: An Empirical Study of Training Self-Supervised Vision Transformers with Synthetic Hard Negatives
title_zh: ViTAMINS：基于合成难例的自监督视觉Transformer训练实证研究
authors: Nikos Giakoumoglou, Andreas Floros, Kleanthis-Marios Papadopoulos, Tania Stathaki
abstract: We introduce ViTAMINS, a method that integrates synthetic hard negatives into unsupervised vision transformer pretraining to improve representation quality. Our approach is thoroughly benchmarked on ImageNet and transfer learning, image retrieval, copy detection, and image, video segmentation tasks. Notably, our proposed negatives give rise to emergent properties, where learned representations contain explicit information about the semantic content of an image and serve as excellent classifiers (up to +11.3% over baselines). ViTAMINS achieves these benefits through simple modifications to existing contrastive frameworks and outperforms competing methods while being more resource efficient, e.g., our ViT-B surpasses V-JEPA with ViT-L. Our findings motivate reconsidering contrastive learning as a simpler yet powerful alternative to dominant generative and self-distillation approaches.
summary_zh: 本文提出ViTAMINS方法，将合成难负例引入无监督视觉Transformer预训练过程，以提升表示质量。本文在ImageNet数据集上针对迁移学习、图像检索、拷贝检测、图像分割、视频分割等任务完成了全面基准测试。值得注意的是，本文提出的负例可催生涌现特性：学习得到的表示包含图像语义内容的显式信息，可直接作为高性能分类器使用，相比基线方法性能最高提升11.3%。ViTAMINS仅需对现有对比学习框架进行简单修改即可获得上述收益，性能优于同类方法且资源效率更高，例如本文的ViT-B模型性能超过了采用ViT-L架构的V-JEPA模型。该研究结论表明，对比学习可作为主流生成式方法和自蒸馏方法的更简洁且高效的替代方案。

title: MultiGait: A Multi-Sensor Multi-Perspective Multi-Session Biometric Inference Benchmark and its Dataset
title_zh: MultiGait：多传感器多视角多会话生物特征推理基准及对应数据集
authors: Julian Todt, Felix Morsbach, Philip Dissert, Thorsten Strufe
abstract: A lack of suitable datasets has limited the research into the privacy risks of novel smart city sensors, such as thermal cameras, depth cameras, and lidar. Given the number of unsubstantiated privacy claims and their potential widespread deployment into many people's everyday life, understanding the privacy risks of these sensors -- in isolation and in like-for-like comparisons -- is crucial. With MultiGait, we collected the first multi-sensor, multi-perspective, multi-session gait-focused dataset, for the corresponding, and additional more far-reaching investigations. The dataset, validated with multiple state-of-the-art recognition systems, comprises various walking modes and annotated personal attributes for 199 individuals, to ensure the benefit for advanced studies including cross-sensor recognition and anonymization at the edge. MultiGait represents a foundation for rigorous privacy investigations, demonstrated through an extensive identity inference benchmark across eight sensors, four perspectives, and three recording sessions. Our benchmark incidentally reveals that sensors often assumed to be privacy-friendly do still entail considerable identity inference risks, while the poor cross-session generalization of existing methods underscores an important research gap.
summary_zh: 缺乏合适的数据集限制了热成像相机、深度相机、激光雷达等新型智慧城市传感器的隐私风险研究。目前大量隐私相关主张缺乏实证支撑，且这类传感器可能广泛部署到大众日常生活中，因此亟需在独立场景和对等对比场景下明确这类传感器的隐私风险。本文构建了MultiGait数据集，这是首个面向步态任务的多传感器、多视角、多会话数据集，可支撑相关研究以及更多延伸方向的探索。该数据集经过多个前沿识别系统验证，包含199名受试者的多种行走模式和标注个人属性，可支撑跨传感器识别、边缘侧匿名化等前沿研究。MultiGait为严格的隐私风险研究提供了基础，本文基于该数据集构建了覆盖8类传感器、4个视角、3段采集会话的大规模身份推理基准，实验结果意外发现：通常被认为隐私友好的传感器仍然存在相当高的身份推理风险，同时现有方法的跨会话泛化能力较差，凸显了该领域的重要研究缺口。

title: Fi-ImageNet-1k: An OOD Benchmark From the Inside of the ImageNet-1k Validation Set
title_zh: Fi-ImageNet-1k：源自ImageNet-1k验证集内部的分布外（OOD）检测基准
authors: Ruslan Rozumnyi, Matěj Suchánek, Tomáš Vojíř, Klára Janoušková, Jiří Matas
abstract: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection predicts whether a test image belongs to none of the predefined classes. To evaluate this task, benchmarks need images from outside the in-distribution (ID) data; typically, these are defined or collected in an ad hoc fashion. Since no ground truth is perfect, ID-labeled datasets themselves contain a natural source of OOD images. We exploit such annotation errors and present Fi-ImageNet-1k, an OOD dataset built from ImageNet-1k validation images that the recent ReImageNet reannotation effort assigned to no ImageNet-1k class. Each image was examined by expert human annotators supported by evidence from MLLMs, VLMs, and reverse image search, comparing it against all visually similar ID classes. We keep only images that could be assigned a specific class outside the ImageNet-1k label space.The resulting Fi-ImageNet-1k, with 655 images from 522 classes, is substantially more challenging than any commonly used OOD dataset. No evaluated combination of classifier and OOD detector achieves a false positive rate below 51% at 95% true positive rate (FPR@95). Compared to the recent NINCO, our dataset is 3.8x more challenging in the FPR@95 metric for state-of-the-art supervised OOD detection methods.
summary_zh: 分布外（OOD）检测任务用于判断测试图像是否不属于任何预定义类别。为了评估该任务，基准数据集需要包含分布内（ID）数据之外的图像，现有基准通常采用自定义或临时采集的方式构建。由于不存在绝对完美的真值标注，标注为分布内的数据集本身就天然包含分布外图像。本文利用这类标注误差构建了Fi-ImageNet-1k数据集，该OOD数据集由ImageNet-1k验证集中的图像构成，这些图像在近期ReImageNet重标注工作中被判定为不属于任何ImageNet-1k类别。所有图像均由专业标注人员结合多模态大语言模型、视觉语言模型和以图搜图工具提供的证据，与所有视觉相似的分布内类别逐一比对完成核验，仅保留可被标注为ImageNet-1k标签空间之外特定类别的图像。最终得到的Fi-ImageNet-1k数据集包含来自522个类别的655张图像，相比现有常用OOD数据集难度显著提升。在95%真阳性率条件下（FPR@95），所有测试的分类器与OOD检测器组合的假阳性率均高于51%。与近期发布的NINCO基准相比，本文数据集在前沿监督式OOD检测方法的FPR@95指标上难度高出3.8倍。

title: PyDoseRT Proton: A GPU Pencil-Beam Engine with a Convolutional Residual-Correction Network for Fast Proton Dose Calculation
title_zh: PyDoseRT Proton：搭载卷积残差校正网络的GPU笔形束引擎用于快速质子剂量计算
authors: Lukas Zimmermann, Hermann Fuchs, Attila Simkó, Gerd Heilemann
abstract: Architecture category. Hybrid method: a physics-based analytical pencil-beam (PB) dose engine followed by a 3-D convolutional residual-correction network (RepVGG-U-Net). We addressed the DoseRAD2026 proton dose-prediction task with PyDoseRT Proton, a GPU-accelerated engine implemented in PyTorch and augmented by a learned residual toward Monte Carlo (MC) accuracy. A double-Gaussian PB kernel was calibrated to GATE/Geant4 integrated depth doses in water in two stages: a classical per-energy curve fit, then a gradient-based fit of the full 3-D dose through the PyTorch physics engine as it retains a differentiable execution path for gradient-based optimization of dose-dependent objectives. The engine computes each beamlet on a beam's-eye-view (BEV) lattice with variance-preserving Gaussian splitting, an analytic nuclear halo, and a Fermi-Eyges heterogeneity term, then rotates the result into the patient frame. Additionally, a compact residual U-Net predicts an additive correction in BEV space. It is conditioned on voxelwise material-label embeddings, a discrete energy embedding and spot size. The same model was used for all anatomical sites (thoracic and abdominal). It was trained with a patient-space L1 objective emphasizing the scored high-dose region and multi-scale BEV deep supervision. The submitted CT configuration obtained preliminary-test beamlet MAE 0.0066, image-z IDD distance 0.0025, plan MAE 0.0049, 98.30\% gamma pass rate (1\%/1 mm), and DVH error 0.460.
summary_zh: 本文提出混合架构方案：首先采用基于物理的解析笔形束（PB）剂量引擎，后续接入3D卷积残差校正网络RepVGG-U-Net。本文基于PyDoseRT Proton引擎参与了DoseRAD2026质子剂量预测任务，该引擎基于PyTorch实现GPU加速，通过学习得到的残差项将计算精度逼近蒙特卡洛（MC）水平。本文分两个阶段对双高斯笔形束核进行校准，使其匹配GATE/Geant4测得的水中积分深度剂量：首先完成经典的逐能量曲线拟合，随后通过PyTorch物理引擎对完整3D剂量进行基于梯度的拟合，保留可微执行路径以支持针对剂量相关目标的梯度优化。该引擎在射束视角（BEV）网格上计算每个子束，采用保方差高斯拆分、解析核晕项和Fermi-Eyges异质性项，随后将结果旋转到患者坐标系。此外，轻量残差U-Net在射束视角空间预测附加校正项，该校正项以体素级材料标签嵌入、离散能量嵌入和束斑尺寸为条件。同一模型可适配所有解剖部位（胸部和腹部），训练过程采用患者空间L1损失，重点关注评分高剂量区域，同时施加多尺度射束视角深度监督。提交的CT配置在初步测试集上取得子束平均绝对误差0.0066，图像z向积分深度剂量距离0.0025，计划平均绝对误差0.0049，伽马通过率（1%/1mm）98.30%，剂量体积直方图（DVH）误差0.460。

title: Low-Quality Face Recognition using Center Aligned Representations and Local Margin Constraints
title_zh: 基于中心对齐表示与局部间隔约束的低质量人脸识别
authors: Vedat Can Dilaver, Benjamin S. Riggan
abstract: Low-quality face recognition (LQFR) remains challenging due to the difficulty of matching degraded query (probe) images against low-quality (LQ) enrollment (gallery) imagery and the scarcity of training data for large-scale models. While recent face recognition (FR) models perform well on high-quality (HQ) imagery, their accuracy drops significantly on LQ images with extremely low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Moreover, fine-tuning HQ-pretrained models on LQ data often improves LQ recognition at the expense of HQ generalization. This trade-off becomes more pronounced in modern evaluation settings spanning multiple datasets with varying image quality levels. To address these limitations, we propose a unified framework that combines three main components: (1) Local Probability Margin (LPM), which estimates per-sample difficulty directly from the model's discriminative landscape; (2) Nested Attention Module (NAM), a new low-rank adapter module that embeds a self-attention mechanism within selected transformer layers; and (3) Quality Gating Protocol (QGP), where an off-the-shelf image quality estimator modulates the adapter contribution at test time, enabling a single model to handle the full quality spectrum without sacrificing HQ performance. Experiments on surveillance (TinyFace, SurvFace) and standard (IJB-B, IJB-C) face recognition benchmarks demonstrate consistent gains in both identification and verification. Code and models will be released atthis http URL.
summary_zh: 低质量人脸识别（LQFR）任务仍面临诸多挑战：难以将退化的查询（探针）图像与低质量的注册（库）图像完成匹配，同时缺乏支撑大规模模型训练的数据集。当前前沿人脸识别（FR）模型在高质量图像上表现优异，但在信噪比极低的低质量图像上精度大幅下降。此外，在低质量数据上对预训练的高质量模型进行微调，往往会在提升低质量识别性能的同时损失高质量场景下的泛化能力。在覆盖多类不同图像质量数据集的现代评估设置中，这类性能权衡问题更加突出。为解决上述缺陷，本文提出统一框架，包含三个核心组件：（1）局部概率间隔（LPM），直接从模型判别特征空间估计每个样本的识别难度；（2）嵌套注意力模块（NAM），这是一种新型低秩适配器模块，可在选定的Transformer层中嵌入自注意力机制；（3）质量门控协议（QGP），在测试阶段通过现成的图像质量估计器调制适配器的贡献，使单个模型可覆盖全质量范围的图像，且不会损失高质量场景下的性能。在监控场景人脸数据集（TinyFace、SurvFace）和标准人脸数据集（IJB-B、IJB-C）上的实验结果表明，该方法在人脸识别和人脸验证任务上均取得了一致的性能提升。相关代码和模型将通过指定链接开源。

title: SinkPruner: Sink-Free Visual Token Pruning for Multimodal Large Language Models
title_zh: SinkPruner：面向多模态大语言模型的无注意力下沉视觉Token剪枝方法
authors: Shiyu Li, Zi-Yuan Hu, Shijia Huang, Yanyang Li, Yiwu Zhong 等 (6 人)
abstract: Despite their strong multimodal understanding ability, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) incur substantial computational overhead when processing long visual token sequences. To reduce inference costs, recent studies have explored visual token pruning through vision-centric or text-guided strategies. However, these methods often overlook high-norm outlier tokens, i.e., tokens with abnormally large feature norms, leading to suboptimal pruning decisions. In this work, we show that such high-norm outlier tokens are highly redundant in both feature and spatial dimensions, yet are often mistakenly preserved as informative cues by existing methods.Motivated by this observation, we propose SinkPruner, a training-free visual token pruning framework for efficient MLLM inference. SinkPruner follows a coarse-to-fine design with two key modules: a visual sanitizer that filters high-norm redundancies and alleviates attention sink and attention dispersion, and a text-guided pruner that further retains tokens semantically aligned with the text query.Extensive experiments on twelve image-language and four video-language benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness, efficiency, and generalizability of our framework. Notably, SinkPruner preserves 96.5% (91.8%) of the original performance of LLaVA-1.5 (Qwen2.5-VL) under an 89% token reduction. Experiments further indicate that our visual sanitizer exhibits promising transferability in enhancing the performance of existing pruning methods. Our code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）虽然具备强大的多模态理解能力，但处理长视觉Token序列时会产生极高的计算开销。为降低推理成本，近期研究探索了以视觉为中心或文本引导的视觉Token剪枝策略，但这类方法往往忽略了高范数离群Token（即特征范数异常大的Token），导致剪枝决策并非最优。本文研究发现，这类高范数离群Token在特征维度和空间维度上都存在极高冗余，但现有方法往往误将其作为有效信息保留。基于该发现，本文提出SinkPruner，这是一种无需训练的视觉Token剪枝框架，可实现多模态大语言模型的高效推理。SinkPruner采用由粗到细的设计思路，包含两个核心模块：视觉清洗器用于过滤高范数冗余Token，缓解注意力下沉和注意力分散问题；文本引导剪枝器进一步保留与文本查询语义对齐的Token。在12个图文基准和4个视频文本基准上的大量实验验证了该框架的有效性、高效性和泛化性。值得注意的是，在Token削减比例达到89%的条件下，SinkPruner可分别保留LLaVA-1.5和Qwen2.5-VL原有性能的96.5%和91.8%。实验还表明，本文提出的视觉清洗器具备优秀的迁移性，可用于提升现有剪枝方法的性能。相关代码已通过指定链接开源。

title: Does This Moment Justify the Recommendation? Counterfactual Behavior-Grounded Evidence Retrieval for Personalized Video Recommendation
title_zh: 该片段能否支撑推荐？面向个性化视频推荐的反事实行为锚定证据检索
authors: Xin Liu
abstract: Personalized video recommendation predicts user preference at the video level, while temporal video grounding localizes query-relevant moments. However, strong localization does not establish whether the retrieved moment constitutes valid evidence for recommending the video to a particular user. We study counterfactual behavior-grounded evidence retrieval, which separates where personalized evidence occurs from whether such evidence exists and evaluates whether model predictions respond consistently when that evidence is replaced. We introduce CBGER-10K, containing 5,000 controlled factual--counterfactual pairs for 3,026 users, where each pair replaces only the focal behavior-supported segment while preserving the user, temporal position, and hard distractors. We further propose CBGER, a compact framework that decouples segment-level localization from video-level evidence estimation and learns both through structured counterfactual supervision. CBGER achieves $0.4432$ MRR, $0.6977$ Pair Accuracy, and $0.6987$ Intervention Consistency across five adapted personalized-highlight and temporal-grounding baselines. Notably, compared with QD-DETR, its MRR improvement is not statistically significant, while Pair Accuracy improves by $11.03$ points. These results show that accurate temporal localization does not necessarily imply reliable personalized evidence existence, motivating explicit evaluation of Whether alongside Where.
summary_zh: 个性化视频推荐任务在视频层级预测用户偏好，而时序视频定位任务用于定位与查询相关的视频片段。但优秀的定位性能并不能证明检索到的片段是向特定用户推荐该视频的有效证据。本文研究反事实行为锚定证据检索任务，该任务将个性化证据的发生位置与证据是否真实存在两个问题解耦，评估当证据片段被替换后模型预测结果是否保持一致。本文构建了CBGER-10K数据集，包含3026名用户的5000组受控事实-反事实配对样本，每组配对仅替换核心行为支撑片段，同时保留用户身份、时序位置和硬负样本不变。本文进一步提出CBGER轻量框架，将片段级定位与视频级证据估计解耦，通过结构化反事实监督同时学习两个子任务。在5个适配的个性化高光和时序定位基线方法上，CBGER取得了0.4432的平均倒数排名（MRR）、0.6977的配对准确率和0.6987的干预一致性。值得注意的是，与QD-DETR相比，其MRR提升无统计显著性，但配对准确率提升了11.03个百分点。上述结果表明，精准的时序定位并不一定代表可靠的个性化证据存在，有必要在评估“位置”的同时显式评估“证据是否有效”。

title: CQF-HMR: Continuous Quaternion Flows for Probabilistic 3D Human Mesh Recovery from a Single Image
title_zh: CQF-HMR：基于连续四元流的单图像概率三维人体网格恢复
authors: Cuong Le, Bao-Long Tran, Pavlo Melnyk, Tahereh Dehdarirad, Bastian Wandt 等 (6 人)
abstract: Recovering 3D digital humans from a single 2D image is an ill-posed computer vision problem due to the loss of depth information. Probabilistic 3D human pose estimation compensates for this by estimating a set of 3D hypotheses from a prior distribution via generative models. However, most prior work focuses only on 3D keypoints, which often leads to implausible poses that are difficult to apply to downstream tasks, e.g. animation or digital humans. SMPL-based methods are more scalable thanks to the explicit body priors, but it requires more complex modeling of the generation process due to the non-additive nature of the joint rotations. In this work, we propose a novel approach for probabilistic 3D humans using quaternion-constrained continuous normalizing flows conditioned on 2D pose estimations. Our proposed quaternion flows show significant advantages over approaches using other rotation representations. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art results of our method on Human3.6M, particularly in ambiguous settings, and comparable pose estimation accuracy on challenging 3DPW and EMDB benchmarks.
summary_zh: 从单张二维图像中恢复三维数字人体是一类不适定计算机视觉问题，根源在于深度信息的丢失。概率三维人体姿态估计通过生成式模型从先验分布中估计一组三维假设来弥补这一缺陷。然而，现有多数相关研究仅聚焦于三维关键点，往往生成不符合现实逻辑的姿态，难以应用于动画、数字人等下游任务。基于SMPL（人体参数化模型）的方法因具备显式人体先验而拥有更强的可扩展性，但由于关节旋转的非加性特性，这类方法需要对生成过程进行更复杂的建模。本研究提出一种基于二维姿态估计作为条件的四元约束连续归一化流的新型概率三维人体重建方法。我们提出的四元流相比使用其他旋转表示的方法展现出显著优势。实验结果表明，该方法在Human3.6M数据集上取得了当前最优性能，尤其在歧义场景下表现突出，同时在挑战性基准数据集3DPW和EMDB上也达到了可比拟的姿态估计精度。

title: EvoGS: Modeling Deformation Evolution for Dynamic Gaussian Splatting
title_zh: EvoGS：面向动态高斯溅射的形变演化建模
authors: Wei Dong, Shahram Shirani, Jun Chen, Han Zhou
abstract: Recent extensions of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enable real-time novel view synthesis in dynamic scenes by learning time-conditioned Gaussian deformations. However, existing MLP-based methods typically estimate deformations independently at each timestamp, making them less robust to large or abrupt motions. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{EvoGS}, a 3DGS-based dynamic reconstruction framework that models Gaussian deformation as a temporal evolution process. EvoGS maintains persistent deformation states for each Gaussian, extrapolates future states from historical deformation states, and corrects the predictions with MLP-derived observations. The correction is adaptively weighted using a temporal residual memory and evolution statistics such as deformation velocity and trajectory deviation. To further improve reconstruction quality, EvoGS introduces deformation-aware densification. Clone and split operations are performed along corrected deformation directions, while an uncertainty-aware strategy suppresses densification for Gaussians with unstable deformation histories. Experiments show that EvoGS improves dynamic novel view synthesis quality and achieves competitive performance across benchmarks.
summary_zh: 近期3D高斯溅射（3DGS，三维高斯溅射）的扩展工作通过学习时间条件高斯形变，实现了动态场景下的实时新视角合成。但现有基于MLP（多层感知机）的方法通常在每个时间戳独立估计形变，导致其对大幅或突发运动的鲁棒性较差。针对该问题，本文提出EvoGS，一种基于3DGS的动态重建框架，将高斯形变建模为时间演化过程。EvoGS为每个高斯单元维护持久的形变状态，从历史形变状态外推未来状态，并通过MLP输出的观测值对预测结果进行校正。该校正过程通过时间残差记忆以及形变速度、轨迹偏差等演化统计量实现自适应加权。为进一步提升重建质量，EvoGS引入形变感知密度增强策略：沿校正后的形变方向执行克隆与分裂操作，同时通过不确定性感知策略抑制形变历史不稳定的高斯单元的密度增强过程。实验表明，EvoGS提升了动态新视角合成质量，在多个基准测试集上取得了极具竞争力的性能。

title: Semi-Supervised Virtual Staining via Morphology Preservation and Histopathological Realism Constraints
title_zh: 结合形态保留与组织病理学真实性约束的半监督虚拟染色
authors: Baoshun Wang, Weiping Lin, Linwu Wang, Yihuang Hu, Baptiste Magnier 等 (6 人)
abstract: Virtual staining aims to computationally generate target-stained histopathological images while reducing the cost and time associated with conventional staining procedures. However, existing methods rely predominantly on strictly paired and accurately registered training data, which are difficult and expensive to obtain in routine practice. To reduce this dependence, we propose a stable semi-supervised virtual staining framework that jointly exploits both limited paired data and abundant unpaired source images. Directly incorporating unpaired images is challenging because their generated results lack corresponding targets for supervision, potentially leading to unrealistic staining, morphological degradation, or even training collapse. To obtain reliable supervision from these images, Hessian-derived morphology preservation extracts structural cues from each source image and constrains the generated output to retain tissue morphology. Histopathological realism constraints further guide the output toward plausible target-stain characteristics, preventing the source-derived structural supervision from degenerating into contour enhancement or simple color transformation. Together, the two components suppress structural and appearance drift, stabilize semi-supervised stain translation, and promote the preservation of diagnostically relevant information. Extensive experiments on H&E-to-IHC translation for Ki67 and HER2, as well as FFPE-to-H&E translation, demonstrate consistent improvements in image quality, morphology preservation, robustness, and downstream diagnostic performance. Code will be available.
summary_zh: 虚拟染色技术旨在通过计算生成目标染色的组织病理学图像，降低传统染色流程的成本与时间消耗。但现有方法大多高度依赖严格配对且精确配准的训练数据，这类数据在常规临床实践中获取难度大、成本高。为降低该依赖，本文提出一种稳定的半监督虚拟染色框架，可同时利用少量配对数据和大量未配对源图像。直接引入未配对图像存在明显挑战：生成结果缺乏对应的监督目标，可能导致染色效果不符合现实、形态退化甚至训练崩溃。为从这类图像中获取可靠监督信号，本研究通过基于Hessian矩阵的形态保留模块从每张源图像中提取结构线索，约束生成输出保留组织形态；组织病理学真实性约束进一步引导输出符合合理的目标染色特征，避免源域导出的结构监督退化为轮廓增强或简单颜色变换。两个模块共同作用抑制结构与外观漂移，稳定半监督染色转换过程，促进对诊断相关信息的保留。针对Ki67、HER2标志物的H&E（苏木精-伊红染色）转IHC（免疫组化）任务，以及FFPE（福尔马林固定石蜡包埋）切片转H&E染色任务的大量实验表明，该方法在图像质量、形态保留能力、鲁棒性和下游诊断性能上均实现了持续提升，相关代码后续将公开。

title: Prior-Guided Implicit Neural Representations for Single-Subject Diffusion MRI Super-Resolution
title_zh: 面向单受试者扩散MRI超分辨率的先验引导隐式神经表示
authors: Abdulkader Ghandoura, Marsil Zakour, William Consagra, Yogesh Rathi
abstract: Resolving complex fiber geometries in brain white matter requires high-resolution diffusion MRI at the cost of long acquisition times. This leads many clinical protocols to opt for low-resolution scans, making downstream microstructure estimation and tractography challenging. Implicit neural representations (INRs) can model the diffusion signal continuously, enabling native single-subject super-resolution by querying the network at arbitrary spatial coordinates, yet existing methods often suffer from long training times and lack a mechanism to incorporate anatomical priors to regularize super-resolution by constraining the space of plausible reconstructions. To address these limitations, we propose a novel transfer-learning framework that pre-trains an INR on a high-resolution template and then adapts it to subject-specific scans via registration and fine-tuning. For $4\times$ through-plane super-resolution from 5 mm to 1.25 mm on Human Connectome Project (HCP) data, our method reduces NRMSE by 36-49% and increases FSIM by 24-43% over a recent baseline with $6\times$ faster training, outperforming competing INR-based methods across both image quality and domain-specific metrics. Code is available on the project page atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 解析脑白质的复杂纤维几何结构需要高分辨率扩散MRI（磁共振成像），但这类扫描的采集时间极长。这导致很多临床方案选择低分辨率扫描，给下游微结构估计和纤维束追踪任务带来挑战。INRs（隐式神经表示）可对扩散信号进行连续建模，通过在任意空间坐标查询网络实现原生单受试者超分辨率，但现有方法普遍存在训练时间长的问题，且缺乏整合解剖先验的机制，无法通过约束合理重建空间实现超分辨率正则化。针对上述缺陷，本文提出一种新型迁移学习框架：先在高分辨率模板上预训练INR，再通过配准和微调将其适配到受试者专属扫描数据。在HCP（人类连接组计划）数据集上实现从5mm到1.25mm的4倍面内超分辨率任务中，该方法相比最新基线模型将归一化均方误差降低36%-49%，将特征相似性指标提升24%-43%，训练速度快6倍，在图像质量和领域专属指标上均优于其他对比INR方法，相关代码可在项目主页获取。

title: ReFlowSET: Representation-Aligned Latent Flow Matching for SAR-to-EO Image Translation
authors: Jeonghyeok Do, Seungchul Lee, Munchurl Kim
abstract: SAR-to-EO image translation aims to generate electro-optical (EO) imagery from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) observations. Existing latent diffusion approaches typically inherit a predetermined autoencoder, although reconstruction fidelity can vary substantially across codecs and modalities. Because the latent codec affects the round-trip preservation of both SAR conditions and EO targets, codec selection constitutes a fundamental design choice; nevertheless, existing methods largely rely on codecs pretrained on natural images. To remedy this, we introduce ReFlowSET, a conditional latent flow-matching framework that selects its codec through a joint SAR--EO reconstruction audit. Rather than inheriting a heavyweight pretrained generator, ReFlowSET trains a substantially smaller conditional DiT from scratch in the selected latent space, using dual-stream SAR conditioning followed by joint feature refinement. To provide semantic guidance for this from-scratch training, intermediate noisy-EO features are aligned with clean target-EO representations extracted by a frozen vision foundation model. This alignment is used only during training and introduces no additional inference cost. Experiments on QXS-SAROPT and SAR2Opt demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across diverse perceptual fidelity and distributional metrics. Code and pretrained weights are publicly available atthis https URL.

title: Conditional Flow Matching for Cross-Field MRI Harmonisation
title_zh: 面向跨场磁共振图像一致性校准的条件流匹配
authors: Baris Imre, Aram Salehi, Levente Baljer, Andrew Webb, Marius Staring 等 (6 人)
abstract: Magnetic resonance images of the same subject look markedly different across field strengths, which complicates the comparison and pooling of data across sites. We address cross-field brain-MRI translation for the MRIxFields2026 challenge, and in particular its Task~3: a single model that translates between any directed pair of the five field strengths and across three contrasts. We phrase the problem as a conditional flow matching path: because the source and target volumes are spatially registered, we learn a velocity field that carries the source slice directly to the target slice, rather than starting from noise. To learn this mapping from only three paired subjects, the unified model is trained in three stages: a degradation-bridge pretraining that distills a restoration prior from the abundant unpaired retrospective cohort, a cross-field finetuning over all directed pairs on the paired cohort, and an adversarial refinement that sharpens the output. At inference, we integrate the learned velocity with a second-order Heun solver in a handful of steps. A restoration prior learned without any paired data already reaches a mean SSIM of 0.837, and each subsequent training stage improves on it. A single 6.3M-parameter model thereby covers all 60 field-pair and contrast combinations, with inference in five solver steps per slice. On the challenge evaluation set the model reaches a mean SSIM of 0.909, averaged over the three contrasts, outperforming regression and diffusion baselines built on the identical network on all three challenge metrics.
summary_zh: 同一受试者的磁共振图像在不同场强下呈现出显著差异，给跨站点数据的对比与汇总带来困难。本研究针对MRIxFields2026挑战赛的跨场脑部MRI翻译任务展开研究，重点解决其第三项任务：使用单个模型实现5种场强任意有向配对、3种对比度之间的图像转换。本文将该问题建模为条件流匹配路径：由于源图像和目标体空间已配准，我们学习一个速度场，将源切片直接映射到目标切片，而非从噪声开始生成。为仅使用3个配对受试者样本完成该映射学习，统一模型分三阶段训练：第一阶段为退化桥接预训练，从大量未配对回顾性队列中蒸馏恢复先验；第二阶段在配对队列上针对所有有向配对执行跨场微调；第三阶段通过对抗优化细化输出，提升图像清晰度。推理阶段使用二阶Heun求解器对学习到的速度场进行少量步积分。仅使用无配对数据学习的恢复先验已达到0.837的平均结构相似性（SSIM），后续每个训练阶段均进一步提升性能。最终仅含6.3M参数的单个模型覆盖所有60种场强配对与对比度组合，单切片推理仅需5步求解器运算。在挑战赛测试集上，该模型三种对比度的平均SSIM达到0.909，在全部三项挑战赛指标上均优于基于相同网络构建的回归和扩散基线模型。

title: Candidate-Expanding Routing with Permutation-Stabilized Experts for Mixed-Format Medical VQA
title_zh: 面向混合格式医疗视觉问答的带置换稳定专家的候选扩展路由
authors: Hai-Dang Nguyen, Huy-Hieu Pham
abstract: Mixed-format medical visual question answering (VQA) requires stable option selection and machine-readable free-text output. The two formats fail differently: multiple-choice predictions can change with option symbols or positions, while clinically plausible open answers can fail automated evaluation when serialization is malformed. We address both challenges with an answer-text memory, a permutation-stabilized vision--language expert, and a sparse candidate- expanding router. The cyclic schedule follows prior work; our contribution is to make expert top-2 a routable candidate alongside memory and expert top-1. On a 1,403-case retrospective internal analysis, this expansion improves a matched binary router from 88.95% to 91.73% (+2.78 percentage points; 95% CI 1.57--3.99), with 56 rescued errors and 17 regressions. Oracle coverage rises from 90.31% to 96.15%, and the final submitted configuration reaches 92.23% on the same retrospective split. For open questions, strict generation and deterministic guards produce 475/475 schema- valid participant-facing outputs without repair, retry, or hard-gate failure. Visual ablations reveal substantial textual dependence. Candidate expansion supplies the principal controlled routing gain; open-path evidence establishes output-contract validity rather than clinical correctness in medical use or deployment.
summary_zh: 混合格式医疗VQA（视觉问答）需要稳定的选项选择能力和机器可读的自由文本输出能力。两类输出格式存在不同的失效模式：多选题预测结果可能随选项符号或位置变化而改变，而临床合理的开放答案可能因序列化格式错误无法通过自动评估。本研究通过答案文本记忆模块、置换稳定的视觉-语言专家模块、稀疏候选扩展路由模块同时解决两类挑战。本研究采用循环训练调度策略，核心创新是将专家输出的Top2结果与记忆模块输出、专家输出的Top1结果共同作为可路由候选。在包含1403个病例的回顾性内部数据集上，该候选扩展策略将匹配二元路由的准确率从88.95%提升至91.73%（提升2.78个百分点，95%置信区间1.57%-3.99%），修正了56个原有错误，仅新增17个错误。Oracle覆盖率从90.31%提升至96.15%，最终提交的配置在同一份回顾性划分集上达到92.23%的准确率。针对开放问题，严格生成与确定性防护机制实现了475个输出全部符合 schema 要求，无需修复、重试或硬门限干预。可视化消融实验表明模型存在显著的文本依赖特性：候选扩展是路由性能提升的核心可控因素，开放路径验证可确保输出符合格式规范，而非保证医疗场景下的临床正确性。

title: PredErase: Training-Free Object-and-Effect Removal with Predictive Latent Guidance
title_zh: PredErase：基于预测性隐式引导的免训练对象及其关联效应移除
authors: Waikit Xiu, Qiang Lu, Junbiao Chen, Xiying Li
abstract: Removing an object is not the same as filling its mask. Cast shadows and contact shading usually lie outside the user-provided instance mask M_obj, so a frozen Fill model that edits only that mask leaves the object's photometric footprint on nearby surfaces. Supervised removers learn this joint erasure from paired clean plates. Training-free editors freeze pretrained weights, yet most still treat M_obj as the entire editable support and steer sampling with CLIP or DINO energies that do not predict the occluded scene. We present PredErase, a training-free inference procedure on frozen FLUX.2 and I-JEPA. The method separates where Fill may rewrite pixels from what structure should occupy the hole. A contact-band expansion M_flux of M_obj exposes local residuals on the supporting plane. I-JEPA, pretrained for masked token prediction, supplies a context-conditioned hole target in representation space; sparse projected gradients align decoded Fill completions with that target inside the instance, while coordinates outside the packed support stay locked. Under instance-only masks on RemovalBench, RORD-Val, and DEFACTO-Val, PredErase improves the native FLUX.2 backbone. Supervised removers remain stronger on several full-image appearance metrics; the supported claim is training-free object-and-effect editing of frozen Fill, not replacement of paired-data erasers.
summary_zh: 移除图像中的目标对象不等同于填充其掩码区域：投射阴影、接触阴影通常位于用户提供的实例掩码M_obj之外，仅编辑该掩码区域的冻结填充模型会在邻近表面上残留对象的光影痕迹。有监督的移除方法可从配对干净样本中学习这种联合擦除能力，免训练编辑方法则冻结预训练权重，但多数方法仍将M_obj作为全部可编辑区域，使用不预测被遮挡场景的CLIP或DINO能量函数引导采样过程。本文提出PredErase，一种在冻结FLUX.2和I-JEPA模型上运行的免训练推理流程，该方法区分了填充模型可重写像素的区域与孔洞区域应包含的结构。通过对M_obj进行接触带扩展得到的M_flux可暴露支撑平面上的局部残差；针对掩码令牌预测预训练的I-JEPA在表征空间中提供上下文条件的孔洞目标；稀疏投影梯度将实例内部的解码填充结果与该目标对齐，而打包支撑区域外的坐标保持锁定。在RemovalBench、RORD-Val和DEFACTO-Val数据集上仅使用实例级掩码的测试结果表明，PredErase的性能优于原生FLUX.2基线。虽然有监督移除方法在多项全图像外观指标上仍表现更优，但本方法实现了基于冻结填充模型的免训练对象及其关联效应编辑，并非旨在替代基于配对数据的擦除方法。

title: ASSERT: Adaptive Stochastic Sampling for Robust Diffusion Models on Analog Compute-in-Memory Hardware
title_zh: ASSERT：面向模拟存内计算硬件的鲁棒扩散模型自适应随机采样
authors: Yuannuo Feng, Yizhe Chen, Wenshuai Yao, Yuxin Xie, Ngai Wong 等 (7 人)
abstract: Diffusion models achieve strong image generation quality but incur high iterative denoising costs. Analog compute-in-memory (CIM) can accelerate matrix-vector multiplications, yet spatial memory variations perturb weights and accumulate during sampling. Unlike conventional neural networks, diffusion models' temporal sensitivity to hardware noise remains underexplored. We investigate diffusion inference using a noise model calibrated and validated against measurements collected from multiple physical CIM chips. Our results show that the early, high-noise denoising stage is substantially more vulnerable than the final refinement stage. A first-order trajectory analysis attributes this behavior to the repeated propagation of correlated prediction errors induced by a fixed hardware mapping. Based on this observation, we propose ASSERT, a training-free sampler that uses higher stochasticity early and smoothly transitions to deterministic denoising. The injected stochasticity changes subsequent activation trajectories and thereby reduces their alignment with persistent spatial errors. Across the evaluated settings, ASSERT achieves up to 2.58$\times$ lower FID than deterministic DDIM on high-resolution datasets and 7.68$\times$ lower FID in the CIFAR-10 step-count study, without changing model parameters or the number of network evaluations.
summary_zh: 扩散模型可实现优异的图像生成质量，但迭代去噪过程的计算成本极高。模拟CIM（存内计算）硬件可加速矩阵向量运算，但空间内存变异会扰动权重，且该扰动在采样过程中不断累积。与传统神经网络不同，扩散模型对硬件噪声的时间敏感性尚未得到充分研究。本研究基于从多个物理CIM芯片采集的测量数据校准并验证的噪声模型，对扩散推理过程展开研究。结果表明，早期高噪声去噪阶段比最终细化阶段更容易受硬件噪声影响。一阶轨迹分析表明，该现象源于固定硬件映射导致的相关预测误差的持续传播。基于该发现，本文提出ASSERT，一种免训练采样器，在采样早期使用更高随机性，平滑过渡到确定性去噪模式。注入的随机性改变后续激活轨迹，降低其与持续空间误差的对齐程度。在所有测试场景下，ASSERT在高分辨率数据集上的FID（弗雷歇 inception 距离）比确定性DDIM基线低最多2.58倍，在CIFAR-10步长研究中FID低7.68倍，且无需修改模型参数或增加网络评估次数。

title: CERF: Communication-Efficient and Retraining-Free Collaborative Perception
title_zh: CERF：通信高效且无需重训练的协同感知
authors: Jiuwu Hao, Ziyi Ni, Liguo Sun, Yuting Wan, Yueyang Wu 等 (8 人)
abstract: Collaborative perception shares information among multiple agents to obtain a comprehensive scene representation, enhancing the perceptual capability of individual agents. However, most existing methods rely on transmitting and fusing dense feature maps for collaboration, which incurs inevitable communication overhead and heterogeneity challenges, limiting their practicality for real-world deployment. To address these challenges, we propose CERF, a novel Communication-Efficient and Retraining-Free framework for open heterogeneous collaborative perception. In CERF, we introduce a new virtual modality (termed Poture), which is generated from the perception outputs of other agents, to augment the extracted Bird's Eye View (BEV) features of the ego agent. To mitigate transmission delays, we employ a Kalman-filter based tracker and a motion forecasting model to derive the current predictions from historical perception results. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CERF achieves performance comparable to mainstream intermediate-collaboration methods while reducing communication overhead by 95% across various downstream tasks. Furthermore, CERF enables seamless integration of unknown heterogeneous agents into the existing collaborative framework without additional retraining costs. Code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 协同感知通过在多个智能体之间共享信息获得全面的场景表征，提升单个智能体的感知能力。但现有多数方法依赖传输和融合密集特征图实现协同，带来不可避免的通信开销和异构性挑战，限制了其在真实场景的落地应用。针对上述挑战，本文提出CERF，一种面向开放异构协同感知场景的通信高效且无需重训练的新型框架。CERF引入一种名为Poture的新型虚拟模态，由其他智能体的感知结果生成，用于增强自智能体提取的BEV（鸟瞰图）特征。为降低传输延迟，本研究采用基于卡尔曼滤波的跟踪器和运动预测模型，从历史感知结果推导当前预测值。大量实验表明，CERF在各类下游任务上实现与主流中间协同方法相当的性能，同时通信开销降低95%。此外，CERF可将未知异构智能体无缝集成到现有协同框架中，无需额外重训练成本，相关代码可在项目主页获取。

title: From Terminology to Diagrams: Visual-Instruction Generation for Scientific Diagram Understanding
title_zh: 从术语到图表：面向科学图表理解的视觉指令生成
authors: Raul Ortega, José Manuel Gómez-Pérez
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in visual question answering with natural images. However, they continue to struggle with scientific diagrams, which are designed to convey functional or relational meaning rather than literal scenes. We therefore introduce a framework for generating large-scale diagram-grounded instruction data by leveraging terminology derived from scientific curricula. Our approach systematically extracts domain concepts, synthesizes atomic facts, retrieves relevant diagrams from the web, and generates multimodal supervision in the form of diagram captions and multiple-choice questions. Using this pipeline, we construct SciGram, a dataset of over 194K diagrams and 1.4M visual instructions across life, earth, and physical sciences. Despite relying on noisy web data and synthetic annotations, models fine-tuned on SciGram achieve substantial improvements on diagram-centric benchmarks, including TQA, ScienceQA, and AI2D, outperforming or matching state-of-the-art VLMs while using fewer training instances. Furthermore, augmenting existing models such as LLaVA OneVision with SciGram establishes new state-of-the-art performance on diagram question answering. Our results highlight the effectiveness of terminology-grounded instruction generation as a general strategy for improving vision-language reasoning in scientific domains. To support future research in scientific diagram understanding, we release both the SciGram dataset and models.
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（Vision-language models, VLMs）在自然图像视觉问答任务中已经展现出优异性能，但在以传递功能或关联语义而非呈现具象场景为设计目标的科学图表上仍表现不佳。为此本文提出一套基于科学课程术语生成大规模图表关联指令数据的框架：该方法系统性提取领域概念、合成原子事实、从网络检索相关图表，并生成图表字幕、多选题形式的多模态监督信号。基于该流水线本文构建了SciGram数据集，覆盖生命科学、地球科学、物理科学三大领域，包含超过19.4万张图表与140万条视觉指令。尽管依赖存在噪声的网络数据与合成标注，在SciGram上微调的模型在TQA、ScienceQA、AI2D等以图表为核心的基准测试集上取得了显著性能提升，仅使用更少训练样本即可匹配或超越当前最优的视觉语言模型表现。此外，将SciGram数据引入LLaVA OneVision等现有模型后，图表问答任务的性能达到了新的最优水平。研究结果表明，基于术语的指令生成是提升科学领域视觉语言推理能力的通用有效策略。为支撑后续科学图表理解相关研究，本文开源了SciGram数据集与相关训练模型。

title: Beyond the Image Plane: World-Grounded Queries for Multi-Object Tracking
title_zh: 超越图像平面：面向多目标跟踪的世界空间查询
authors: Orcun Cetintas, Guillem Brasó, Tim Meinhardt, Laura Leal-Taixé
abstract: Monocular videos record 3D scenes as sequences of 2D image-plane projections, obscuring depth and spatial relationships. Multi-object trackers localize and associate objects primarily using appearance and geometry observed only in the image plane, inheriting these ambiguities. To address this limitation, we introduce PLANET, an end-to-end multi-object tracker designed to move beyond the image plane. As an enabling step, we lift existing 2D tracking datasets into 3D. We then form world-grounded queries by embedding reconstructed 3D scene geometry into the features and positional encodings used during query formation. An auxiliary 3D location prediction task further encourages the queries to encode object positions during training. A complementary dual-resolution temporal memory preserves this evidence across longer temporal gaps. As a result, PLANET achieves state-of-the-art performance across three diverse benchmarks.
summary_zh: 单目视频将三维场景记录为二维图像平面投影序列，丢失了深度信息与空间关联关系。现有多目标跟踪器主要仅利用图像平面内观测到的外观与几何特征完成目标定位与关联，天然继承了上述信息缺失带来的歧义问题。为解决该局限，本文提出端到端多目标跟踪器PLANET，设计思路跳出了图像平面的约束。作为支撑步骤，本文首先将现有二维跟踪数据集升维至三维空间，随后将重建得到的三维场景几何信息嵌入查询构建阶段使用的特征与位置编码中，生成基于真实世界空间的查询；训练过程中额外增设三维位置预测辅助任务，进一步引导查询编码目标的空间位置信息；配套的双分辨率时序记忆模块可在更长的时间间隔内保留上述空间关联证据。最终PLANET在三类不同的基准测试集上均取得了当前最优性能。

title: On-the-Fly3R: Towards Robust Online 3D Reconstruction with Feed-Forward 3R Models for Large-Scale UAV Scenarios
title_zh: On-the-Fly3R：面向大规模无人机场景、基于前馈3R模型的鲁棒在线三维重建
authors: Zhe Shen, Liyuan Lou, Yifei Yu, Guanbo Wang, Quanjian Ji 等 (7 人)
abstract: While feed-forward 3D reconstruction (3R) offers efficient end-to-end modeling, its application in large-scale UAV mapping is hindered by the prohibitive memory cost of Transformer attention. Current scalable streaming 3R methods assume temporally and spatially continuous inputs, rendering them ineffective for the weakly ordered or unordered image streams common in cross-strip UAV operations. To address this, we propose On-the-Fly3R, a training-free, progressive online 3D reconstruction framework for large-scale UAV images that upgrades various 3R backbones for large-scale UAV scenarios. Our method enables reconstruction from unordered inputs via retrieval-guided dynamic subset construction, which adaptively selects spatially relevant images. To further improve the robustness, a validation-rejection-retry mechanism is designed to guarantee global consistency, performing a pre-integration consistency check and automatically rejecting misaligned images and retrying with alternative subset. Finally, inspired by VSLAM, pose graph optimization based on the retrieval loop closure is employed to mitigate camera drift. Evaluations on several UAV benchmarks show that our On-the-Fly3R successfully scales various 3R models to over 5,000 images across square-kilometer UAV scenes, delivering substantially superior accuracy compared to several SOTA streaming 3R methods. Code is available atthis https URL
summary_zh: 前馈三维重建（3D Reconstruction, 简称3R）可实现高效端到端建模，但Transformer注意力机制的极高内存开销严重阻碍了其在大规模无人机测绘场景中的落地。现有可扩展流式3R方法均假设输入具备时空连续性，无法适配跨条带无人机作业中常见的弱有序甚至无序图像流场景。针对该问题，本文提出无训练的渐进式在线三维重建框架On-the-Fly3R，可适配多种3R骨干网络、面向大规模无人机图像场景完成升级。该方法通过检索引导的动态子集构建机制，自适应选择空间关联图像，支持从无序输入中完成重建；为进一步提升鲁棒性，设计了「校验-拒绝-重试」机制，预先完成积分一致性校验，自动剔除错位图像并选择替代子集重试，保障全局一致性；最后借鉴视觉同时定位与地图构建（VSLAM）思路，采用基于检索回环的位姿图优化缓解相机位姿漂移。在多个无人机基准数据集上的实验结果表明，On-the-Fly3R可将各类3R模型扩展至支持平方公里级无人机场景下超过5000张图像的重建，精度显著优于多个当前最优的流式3R方法。相关代码已在指定开源链接公开。

title: VerNav: Verifier-First Low-Latency Vision-and-Language Navigation
title_zh: VerNav：基于优先校验器的低延迟视觉语言导航
authors: Zhixin Wang, Chengzheyi Yao, Leyuan Liu, Xiaosong Zhang, Yongzhao Zhang
abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an agent to navigate through unseen 3D environments according to natural-language instructions. Explicit reasoning can improve instruction understanding and semantic grounding, but autoregressive generation at every step accumulates large decision-stage latency over multi-step navigation. We propose VerNav, a verifier-first framework for low-latency LLM-based VLN. The verifier reduces decision-stage latency by replacing per-step autoregressive generation with batched action verification, while an entropy-based adaptive generator is invoked only for uncertain decisions to produce compact state evidence. To further improve navigation performance with the verifier, we introduce a two-stage alignment scheme: (i) VPO improves local action-preference alignment in static verifier training, and (ii) step-level reinforcement fine-tuning provides dense progress rewards over multi-step navigation rollouts during dynamic task execution. Experiments on the Room-to-Room (R2R) benchmark show that the verifier-only decision path of VerNav achieves competitive navigation performance among representative LLM-based VLN agents while reducing average decision-stage LLM latency per step by more than $10\times$ compared with autoregressive methods.
summary_zh: 视觉语言导航（Vision-and-Language Navigation, VLN）要求智能体根据自然语言指令在未见过的三维环境中完成导航。显式推理可提升指令理解与语义对齐效果，但每一步的自回归生成会在多步导航过程中累积极高的决策阶段延迟。本文提出面向大语言模型驱动VLN任务的低延迟框架VerNav，核心采用优先校验器架构：校验器用批量动作校验替代每一步的自回归生成，大幅降低决策阶段延迟，仅在遇到不确定决策时才调用基于熵的自适应生成器，输出精简的状态证据。为进一步借助校验器提升导航性能，本文设计了两阶段对齐方案：1）在静态校验器训练阶段采用VPO方法优化局部动作偏好对齐效果；2）在动态任务执行阶段通过步级强化微调，为多步导航轨迹提供密集进度奖励。在Room-to-Room（R2R）基准测试集上的实验结果表明，VerNav仅使用校验器的决策路径即可在代表性大语言模型驱动VLN智能体中取得有竞争力的导航性能，相比自回归方法，单步平均决策阶段大语言模型延迟降低10倍以上。

title: A multicenter benchmark and clinically structured metric for coronary CTA report generation
title_zh: 面向冠状动脉CTA报告生成的多中心基准与临床结构化指标
authors: Zhiyu Ye, Yue Sun, Limiao Zou, Cheng Xu, Keting Xu 等 (10 人)
abstract: Reliable evaluation of automated coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA) report generation requires standardized multicentre benchmarks and clinically structured metrics. We established a four-centre benchmark comprising 3,021 CCTA series from 818 patient-report pairs to evaluate seven open-source three-dimensional vision-language models. We developed CSM$_{\text{CCTA}}$, a clinically structured metric for CCTA report evaluation, with patient-, vessel-, and segment-level variables defined according to clinical guidelines. Report pairs are compared at the finest shared anatomical level, and the contributions of different clinical components are weighted based on expert assessments. We estimated these weights using 70 expert-scored cases and evaluated clinical alignment in a non-overlapping set of 30 cases. CSM$_{\text{CCTA}}$ showed a strong correlation with radiologist scores (Pearson's $r=0.97$, $p<0.001$), exceeding the next-best metric, FORTE ($r=0.70$), by 0.27, and agreed with expert preferences in 115 of 160 pairwise comparisons (71.9\%). Under controlled perturbations, CSM$_{\text{CCTA}}$ remained stable to clinically equivalent wording and decreased monotonically with progressive information omission. In the multicenter benchmark, the CCTA-trained C2RG model achieved the highest CSM$_{\text{CCTA}}$ scores across all four hospitals, although its performance remained far from optimal. In contrast, CCTA-irrelevant reports accounted for up to 98.7\% of the outputs from generalist models. Together, the benchmark provides a standardized setting for model comparison, while CSM$_{\text{CCTA}}$ enables clinically structured evaluation of finding agreement and anatomical specificity. These results support a more clinically aligned and anatomically resolved approach to evaluating CCTA report generation. Code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 自动化冠状动脉计算机断层血管造影（Coronary computed tomography angiography, CCTA）报告生成任务的可靠评估，需要标准化的多中心基准与符合临床逻辑的结构化指标。本文构建了包含818对患者-报告样本、总计3021组CCTA序列的四中心基准数据集，用于评估7款开源三维视觉语言模型的性能。本文提出面向CCTA报告评估的临床结构化指标CSM$_{	ext{CCTA}}$，其按照临床指南定义了患者级、血管级、节段级三类变量，在最细的共享解剖层级上对比报告对的差异，并基于专家评估结果为不同临床组分分配权重。本文基于70份专家评分样本估算权重参数，在30份无重叠样本上完成临床对齐效果评估。实验结果显示CSM$_{	ext{CCTA}}$与放射科医师评分的皮尔逊相关系数r=0.97（p<0.001），比次优指标FORTE的相关系数（r=0.70）高出0.27；在160组两两对比中，该指标的判断结果与专家偏好一致的比例达71.9%。在受控扰动测试中，CSM$_{	ext{CCTA}}$对临床等价的措辞表达保持稳定，且随信息逐步缺失单调下降。在多中心基准测试中，经过CCTA数据训练的C2RG模型在全部四家医院的数据集上取得了最高的CSM$_{	ext{CCTA}}$得分，但性能仍远未达到最优水平；与之相对，通用模型生成的输出中与CCTA无关的报告占比最高可达98.7%。综上，该基准为模型对比提供了标准化环境，而CSM$_{	ext{CCTA}}$可实现面向发现一致性与解剖特异性的临床结构化评估，为CCTA报告生成任务提供了更符合临床逻辑、解剖粒度更精细的评估方案。相关代码已在指定开源链接公开。

title: HELIOS: From midnight to noon, continuous outdoor urban scene relighting
authors: Hala Djeghim, Nathan Piasco, Luis Roldão, Moussab Bennehar, Dzmitry Tsishkou 等 (7 人)
abstract: Modifying the illumination of driving images is a fundamental challenge, as most datasets are captured at specific times of day. Existing methods rely on synthetic data or paired multi-illumination supervision, which limits their generalization to the diverse and challenging conditions of real-world scenarios. To address this, we propose HELIOS, a novel image relighting approach that relies on unlabeled real-world datasets without requiring any paired images for training. Our approach integrates albedo-based conditioning into a cycle-consistent diffusion pipeline to prevent identity collapse and ensure accurate domain translation.
