The results demonstrate that harness tampering consistently occurs in real runs from different agents, often persists in the lineage of the best agent, and forms distinct system-specific profiles across the taxonomy.
summary_zh: 自改进智能体通过迭代修改自身运行测试框架来不断突破性能上限，但这类修改可能产生虚假的性能提升，或是在没有实际提升能力的前提下破坏授权、溯源、完整性等安全约束。本文将这类现象定义为测试框架篡改，将原有奖励篡改、度量篡改的概念拓展到了完整的自改进生命周期。为了系统研究该问题，本文提出了一个双维度分类体系，基于错位修改发生的测试框架功能角色、其违反的合规义务两个维度对所有错位修改进行分类。随后研究通过将「篡改-良性」修改对注入自改进智能体的真实运行轨迹，构建了一份带标注的语料库，并在篡改分类和定位任务上对多种审计方法开展了基准测试。最后研究对自改进智能体的真实运行轨迹开展了系统性审计，结果表明测试框架篡改行为在不同智能体的真实运行过程中普遍存在，往往会在性能最优的智能体的演化谱系中持续保留，且在分类体系下呈现出不同系统独有的特征分布。

title: Life Operators: a self-evolving framework for multiscale life modelling
title_zh: 生命算子：面向多尺度生命建模的自演化框架
authors: Shuo Wang, Yike Guo
abstract: Medical AI is moving beyond recognition towards clinical dialogue and longitudinal prediction. Yet a central question remains: how would a patient's state change under intervention? Statistical models learn future observations, whereas mechanistic models describe selected processes. Neither provides a common framework for representing patient state, coupling scales or revising failed assumptions. We propose Life Operators: task-bounded mappings that define three scientific roles. Perception operators infer task-relevant biological states from multimodal observations, Evolution operators propagate these states under natural or intervention-conditioned dynamics, and Generation operators map them to measurable signals. Each role may be realised by equations, statistical models, neural networks or hybrids. Bridge operators connect components with different variables, scales and time steps. Selected operators and bridges form task-specific Operator Graphs containing the smallest set of states and mechanisms sufficient for a declared claim. This modular structure also makes scientific revision localisable. An AI co-scientist may propose changes to states, operators, bridges or graph structure, while independent evidence determines which variants are retained, restricted or retired. Over time, validated components could accumulate into broader multiscale models of the human body and provide a computational foundation for medical artificial superintelligence.
summary_zh: 医学人工智能正从识别任务向临床对话与长期预测方向发展，但核心问题依然悬而未决：在干预作用下患者的状态会如何变化？统计模型学习未来观测结果，而机制模型仅能描述选定的过程，二者都无法提供统一框架来表征患者状态、耦合多尺度信息或修正失效假设。本文提出生命算子（Life Operators）：一类限定任务边界的映射，定义了三类科学角色：感知算子从多模态观测中推断与任务相关的生物状态，演化算子在自然动力学或干预条件动力学下推演上述状态，生成算子将状态映射为可测量信号。每类角色都可通过方程、统计模型、神经网络或混合结构实现。桥接算子可连接变量、尺度、时间步均不同的组件，选定的算子与桥接算子共同构成面向特定任务的算子图，其中包含支撑目标结论所需的最小状态集与机制集。该模块化结构还可实现科学修正的局部化：人工智能协同科学家可对状态、算子、桥接算子或图结构提出修改方案，再通过独立证据决定哪些变体被保留、限制或弃用。随着时间推移，经验证的组件可积累为更全面的人体多尺度模型，为医学人工超智能提供计算基础。

title: Do Multimodal LLMs See Before They Read? Diagnosing Contextual Sycophancy
title_zh: 多模态大语言模型在读取文本前是否会“看见”图像？针对上下文谄媚效应的诊断研究
authors: Yi-Cheng Lai, Hen-Hsen Huang
abstract: External text can override conflicting image evidence in multimodal large language models, a failure we call multimodal contextual sycophancy. We introduce a 998-case diagnostic that independently varies visual evidence, commonsense priors, and external text, and probe when this failure arises by moving the information boundary around a context-blind visual witness. On abnormal images paired with Gemini-generated false text, GPT-5.1 scores 7.9% under joint conditioning, 49.7% when the context-blind witness report is scored directly, 63.7% under a matched two-call witness-arbiter pipeline that exposes the witness to the text, and 84.2% under System-2 Visual Arbitration (S2VA), which withholds the text from the witness. Across six models, S2VA improves over the direct witness report by 19.7 to 44.1 points, with all paired 95% confidence intervals excluding zero. The best information boundary is not uniform: textual context scaffolds some models, and a GPT-4o-regenerated subset changes the relative ordering of joint conditioning, Witness-Only, and S2VA. Contextual sycophancy is therefore sensitive to when text is introduced, as well as to the model and context source.
summary_zh: 外部文本可以覆盖多模态大语言模型中与之冲突的图像证据，我们将这一失效现象命名为多模态上下文谄媚效应。本文构建了包含998个案例的诊断数据集，独立调整视觉证据、先验常识与外部文本三类变量，通过在上下文盲视觉见证模块周围移动信息边界来探究该失效现象的触发条件。在异常图像搭配Gemini生成的错误文本的测试场景下，GPT-5.1在联合条件设置下准确率为7.9%，直接对上下文盲见证模块的输出评分时准确率为49.7%，采用让见证模块接触文本的双调用见证-仲裁流水线时准确率为63.7%，采用将文本对见证模块屏蔽的System-2 Visual Arbitration（S2VA，系统2视觉仲裁方法）时准确率达84.2%。在6个测试模型中，S2VA相比直接见证报告的性能提升幅度达19.7至44.1个百分点，所有配对结果的95%置信区间均不包含0。最优信息边界并非统一：文本上下文对部分模型起到支撑作用，而经GPT-4o重新生成的子集改变了联合条件设置、仅见证模式与S2VA三者的相对性能排序。由此可见，上下文谄媚效应对文本引入时机、模型类型与上下文来源均十分敏感。

title: OCGQuant: Outlier-Companion Grouping for NVFP4 Quantization
title_zh: OCGQuant：面向NVFP4量化的离群点伴随分组方法
authors: Yishan Yao, Binjun Li, Hanling Yi, Pengyu Li, Xiaoqing Liu 等 (8 人)
abstract: NVFP4 is an efficient microscaling format for low-bit inference, but activation outliers can still degrade quantization accuracy within NVFP4 blocks. Within each quantization block, large activations can dominate the block scale, increasing the quantization error of the remaining values sharing the same scale. Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods mitigate outlier errors through strategies such as mixed precision, rotation, or residual compensation, but these approaches are either not specifically tailored to NVFP4 or introduce additional computation. In this work, we revisit NVFP4 from a channel-grouping perspective and define the reducible error incurred by remaining block values under the scale set by the block maximum as Collateral Quantization Error. Based on this insight, we propose OCGQuant, a post-training quantization method centered on Outlier-Companion Grouping (OCG), which adaptively pairs outlier channels with low-magnitude companion channels to improve NVFP4 activation block composition. Experiments on Llama3 and Qwen3 show that OCGQuant achieves the lowest WikiText-2 perplexity and highest average downstream accuracy among evaluated PTQ methods, while maintaining prefill speedup close to RTN and matching its peak decoding memory. Code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: NVFP4是面向低比特推理的高效微缩放格式，但激活值离群点仍会降低NVFP4块内的量化精度。在每个量化块中，大激活值会主导块的缩放系数，增大共享同一缩放系数的其余数值的量化误差。现有后训练量化（Post-Training Quantization, PTQ）方法通过混合精度、旋转或残差补偿等策略缓解离群点误差，但这些方法要么并非专门针对NVFP4设计，要么会引入额外计算开销。本文从通道分组视角重新审视NVFP4量化问题，将块最大值设定的缩放系数导致块内其余数值产生的可约误差定义为连带量化误差。基于该洞见，本文提出OCGQuant：一种以Outlier-Companion Grouping（OCG，离群点伴随分组）为核心的后训练量化方法，自适应将离群点通道与低幅值伴随通道配对，优化NVFP4激活块的组成结构。在Llama3与Qwen3模型上开展的实验表明，在所有参评后训练量化方法中，OCGQuant取得了最低的WikiText-2困惑度与最高的平均下游任务精度，同时预填充加速比接近RTN（舍入到最近量化），峰值解码内存占用与RTN持平。代码已公开至对应链接。

title: Scientific Agent Skills: A Library of Procedural Knowledge for Research Agents
title_zh: 科学智能体技能库：面向研究智能体的过程性知识资源库
authors: Timothy Kassis, Vinayak Agarwal, Yuhuan He, Darshil Patel, Aubrey M. Brueckner
abstract: A language-model agent asked to analyse an experiment will usually return working code. Whether the analysis is defensible is a different question. A defensible analysis depends on procedural choices: which test the field accepts, which identifier namespace is authoritative, and which caveats must accompany a result. We present Scientific Agent Skills, an open library of 163 such procedures in 16 areas of practice, including genomics, cheminformatics, medical imaging, study design and scientific communication. Each skill is a directory built around a versioned, human-readable instruction file. An agent loads the file only when a task calls for it; the directory often also contains reference material and runnable scripts. We report no task-level evaluation and no host selection rate. Openly licensed and available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 若要求语言模型智能体分析一项实验，其通常会返回可运行的代码，但该分析结果是否严谨可靠则是另一回事。严谨的分析依赖于过程性选择：即领域认可的测试方法、权威的标识符命名空间，以及结果必须附带的注意事项。本文提出科学智能体技能库，这是一个开放资源库，包含基因组学、化学信息学、医学影像、研究设计与科学传播等16个实践领域的163项此类过程性知识。每一项技能都是以版本化、人类可读的指令文件为核心构建的目录，智能体仅在任务需要时才加载对应文件，目录中通常还包含参考资料与可运行脚本。本研究未开展任务级评估，也未统计宿主选择率。该资源库采用开源许可，可通过对应链接获取。

title: Attention Sensitivity Is Not Enough: Dissociating Attention-Level and Behavioural In-Context Learning under Fine-Tuning
title_zh: 仅靠注意力敏感度并不足够：微调下注意力层级与行为层级上下文学习的分离特性研究
authors: Jinyuan Zhang, Peng He, He Hu, Yin Yuan, ShengShuo Jiao
abstract: In-context learning (ICL) lets large language models adapt to new tasks from demonstrations, and fine-tuning can erode this behaviour. Many preservation diagnostics inspect attention: if attention changes when demonstrations change, the model is treated as context-sensitive. This paper asks how far that proxy can be trusted once it is optimised. We formalise \emph{In-Context Sensitivity} (ICS), the average row distance between last-token attention on matched and mismatched demonstration prefixes, and pair it with \emph{ICL-GAP}, the behavioural accuracy gap between the same prefixes. In a controlled four-arm ablation on Llama-2-7B, an ICS-maximising regulariser ($\armKL$) drives ICS to $1.413$, within $0.5\%$ of its geometric ceiling. The behavioural readout tells a different story: ICL-GAP stays near zero and MMLU accuracy moves from $0.371$ to $0.279$, a Goodhart dissociation of the bounded attention proxy. Endpoint statistics locate the mechanism: attention grows sharp and near-disjoint across prefixes yet routes to formatting and demonstration-body tokens rather than labels. A random-label protocol confirms that the behavioural probe family retains dynamic range at the same checkpoints. In a constructive sweep, behaviour gating partially mitigates the effect, while objectives anchored to pretrained computation hold the high-MMLU, moderate-ICS region that divergence maximisers leave. The main lesson is diagnostic: attention-level ICL proxies earn their place as training targets only after validation against behavioural gaps.
summary_zh: 上下文学习（In-Context Learning, ICL）让大语言模型能够从演示样本中适配新任务，而微调可能削弱该特性。许多现有保留度诊断方法以注意力为代理指标：若演示样本变化时注意力随之变化，则认为模型具备上下文敏感性。本文探究该代理指标在经过优化后可信度的边界。本文形式化定义了上下文敏感度（In-Context Sensitivity, ICS）：即匹配演示前缀与不匹配演示前缀下最后一个token注意力矩阵的平均行距离，并将其与ICL-GAP指标配对，后者代表相同前缀下的行为精度差。在基于Llama-2-7B的四组受控消融实验中，ICS最大化正则器（KL-arm）可将ICS提升至1.413，距离其几何上限的差距不足0.5%，但行为层面的结果却呈现完全不同的规律：ICL-GAP始终接近0，MMLU精度从0.371降至0.279，出现了有界注意力代理指标的古德哈特定律失效现象。端点统计结果揭示了背后机制：跨前缀的注意力变得尖锐且几乎互不重叠，但注意力被分配给格式与演示体token而非标签。随机标签实验证实，在相同检查点下，行为探针体系仍保留动态范围。在构造性扫描实验中，行为门控可部分缓解该效应，而锚定预训练计算的目标函数可保留高MMLU、中等ICS的区间，该区间是发散最大化器无法覆盖的区域。本研究的核心结论具有诊断意义：注意力层级的ICL代理指标只有经过行为差距验证后，才适合作为训练目标使用。

title: Medical Causal Hypothesis Verification with Large Language Models
title_zh: 基于大语言模型的医学因果假设验证研究
authors: Safiyyah Ahmed, Abrar Ansari, Md Aminul Islam, Elena Zheleva
abstract: The growing use of large language models (LLMs) for search and information retrieval underscores the need to evaluate their reliability in high-stakes domains such as healthcare. Although LLMs can effectively answer questions about diseases, symptoms, and treatments, their ability to accurately assess causal relationships and ground their conclusions in verified scientific evidence remains unclear. Here, we present a preliminary, small-scale study that investigates the accuracy of LLMs in evaluating causal medical claims and supporting them with peer-reviewed research. We propose an evaluation framework for causal hypothesis verification that can be used to systematically track the performance of existing and future LLMs. We assess the performance of eight LLMs on 17 medical causal hypotheses to evaluate whether they can reliably verify these hypotheses using scientific evidence from the literature. We systematically annotate the scientific evidence they provide according to six criteria (a total of 1,067 annotation points) and assess them with nine evaluation metrics. Our analysis shows that while LLMs exhibit strong recall, they often perform poorly at providing valid scientific articles and evidence for support and at rejecting unsupported hypotheses. These findings highlight a critical limitation of current LLMs, as they cannot yet be trusted fully to verify causal relationships from the biomedical literature. This work underscores the need for rigorous evaluation before using LLMs for search and retrieval in healthcare settings.
summary_zh: 大语言模型在信息搜索与检索领域的广泛应用，凸显了在医疗等高风险场景下评估其可靠性的必要性。尽管大语言模型可以有效回答疾病、症状与治疗相关问题，但其准确评估因果关系、将结论锚定到已验证科学证据的能力仍不明确。本文开展了一项初步的小规模研究，探究大语言模型评估医学因果声明、用同行评审研究支撑结论的准确性。本文提出了面向因果假设验证的评估框架，可系统追踪现有及未来大语言模型的性能表现。我们针对17项医学因果假设测试了8个大语言模型的性能，评估其能否利用文献中的科学证据可靠验证这些假设。我们按照6项标准对模型输出的科学证据进行系统标注，共生成1067个标注点，并采用9项评估指标开展评测。分析结果表明，尽管大语言模型表现出较高的召回率，但在提供有效科学文献与支撑证据、拒绝无依据假设方面的表现普遍较差。该发现揭示了当前大语言模型的关键局限性：目前尚不能完全信任其从生物医学文献中验证因果关系的能力。本研究表明，在医疗场景下将大语言模型用于搜索与检索前，必须对其开展严格评估。

title: RePro: Proof-Verified Benchmark Rewriting for Reliable Evaluation of LLM Mathematical Problem Solving
title_zh: RePro：面向大语言模型数学问题求解可靠评估的证明验证型基准重写框架
authors: Xiyuan Zhou, Zhuoqi Li, Xinlei Wang, Yirui He, Yuhao Wu 等 (9 人)
abstract: Data contamination undermines the reliable evaluation of large language models (LLMs) on mathematical problem solving. While rewriting-based evaluation mitigates memorization, existing methods lack guarantees of problem validity and answer correctness. We propose Proof-Verified Benchmark Rewriting (RePro), the first framework to integrate Lean-oriented neural automated theorem provers (ATPs) into benchmark rewriting, which rewrites problems and regenerates answers with correctness ensured by Lean-verified proofs. Experiments on GSM8K and MATH show that RePro's retained rewritten instances achieve 100% well-definedness, feasibility, and answer correctness, while existing methods still produce invalid or incorrect instances. Moreover, several models exhibit accuracy drops on proof-verified rewritten benchmarks, suggesting that their performance is sensitive to surface-level and structural variations and may partly reflect memorization effects. Our source code and data are available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 数据污染会破坏大语言模型数学问题求解能力评估的可靠性。尽管基于重写的评估方法可以缓解记忆效应，但现有方法无法保证问题的有效性与答案的正确性。本文提出Proof-Verified Benchmark Rewriting（RePro，证明验证型基准重写框架），这是首个将面向Lean的神经自动定理证明器集成到基准重写流程的框架，可通过Lean验证的证明保证重写后问题与再生答案的正确性。在GSM8K与MATH数据集上开展的实验表明，RePro生成的重写实例在良定义性、可行性与答案正确性三个维度均达到100%，而现有方法仍会生成无效或错误的实例。此外，多个模型在经过证明验证的重写基准上出现精度下降，说明其性能对表层与结构变化敏感，原有性能部分反映了记忆效应。本文的源代码与数据可通过对应链接获取。

title: A Formal Analysis of Agent Payment Protocols
title_zh: 智能体支付协议的形式化分析研究
authors: Ke Jiang, Mohan Yu, Yuan Chang, Mohit Kumar Jangid, Jianyu Niu 等 (7 人)
abstract: Agent payment protocols are emerging as a key transaction layer for autonomous commerce, enabling AI agents to purchase goods and services and execute payments on users' behalf. Unlike conventional payment flows, they distribute user intent, delegated authority, credential use, settlement, and fulfillment across multiple actors and stages, creating security dependencies that no single message or participant can enforce. Yet these guarantees remain largely implicit across evolving specifications, schemas, and reference implementations, with little systematic formal analysis.We formalize four representative agent payment protocols: x402, MPP, ACP, and AP2 in Tamarin. Using a common abstraction of the agent payment lifecycle, we construct source-grounded models that capture each protocol's roles, state, trust assumptions, and lifecycle transitions. Rather than assuming a complete property taxonomy, we use source-backed verification questions and counterexample traces to expose missing bindings, state constraints, and cross-stage correspondences, consolidating them into 18 shared security principles. Across 86 verification cases, our analysis reproduces 46 known or calibration cases and identifies 40 previously undocumented formal-consistency findings. For each retained violation, we isolate the missing protocol relation, construct a minimally strengthened reference model, and reverify the intended property. We further evaluate the new x402 findings across three implementations and validate ten representative findings through implementation PoCs, SDK/schema-level witnesses, and source-aligned executable traces spanning five security principles. Our results show that delegated authorization must remain consistent with its resulting economic and service effects across actors, states, and protocol stages.
summary_zh: 智能体支付协议正逐步成为自主商业领域的核心交易层，支持人工智能智能体代表用户购买商品与服务、执行支付操作。与传统支付流程不同，智能体支付协议将用户意图、委托权限、凭证使用、结算与履约分布到多个参与方与阶段，形成了无法由单条消息或单个参与方保障的安全依赖关系。但这类安全保障在不断迭代的规范、模式与参考实现中大多是隐式的，缺乏系统的形式化分析。本文在Tamarin形式化验证工具中对四类代表性智能体支付协议x402、MPP、ACP、AP2进行了形式化建模。基于智能体支付生命周期的通用抽象，本文构建了基于源文件的模型，覆盖每个协议的角色、状态、信任假设与生命周期转换。本文没有预设完整的属性分类体系，而是采用基于源文件的验证问题与反例轨迹，暴露缺失的绑定关系、状态约束与跨阶段对应关系，将其整合为18项通用安全原则。在86个验证用例中，本文的分析复现了46个已知或校准用例，发现了40项此前未被记录的形式一致性问题。针对每一个确认的违规问题，本文定位了协议中缺失的关联关系，构建了最小强化参考模型，重新验证了目标属性。本文进一步在三类实现中评估了新发现的x402协议问题，通过概念验证实现、SDK/模式层证据与覆盖5项安全原则的源对齐可执行轨迹，验证了10项代表性发现。研究结果表明，委托授权必须在所有参与方、状态与协议阶段中，与其产生的经济与服务效果保持一致。

title: DISTAL: Distillation and Self-Supervised Pretraining for Structure-Agnostic Materials Property Prediction
title_zh: DISTAL：面向结构无关材料属性预测的蒸馏与自监督预训练框架
authors: Weiran Wang, Xintong Huo, Yueying Wang, Yusi Fan, Wenyan Wang 等 (10 人)
abstract: Materials property prediction remains difficult in low-data settings, where many target properties are supported by only a limited number of labeled samples. Models with the strongest predictive accuracy often depend on crystal structures, which restricts their use in early-stage screening when structural information is limited or unavailable. To address this challenge, we propose DISTAL, a dual-prior framework for structure-agnostic materials property prediction that combines self-supervised compositional pretraining with structure-aware knowledge distillation. DISTAL first learns transferable compositional representations from a large virtual composition space using 145 composition-derived descriptors. It then distills structural knowledge from a pretrained ALIGNN teacher into a composition-conditioned student. This setting allows structural priors to be used during training without requiring structural inputs at inference. By integrating explicit compositional descriptors, pretrained latent features, and distilled structural features within a unified prediction pipeline, DISTAL captures complementary signals that are difficult to recover from any single representation alone. Across 39 benchmark tasks, the best-performing multimodal configuration combines all three signals, and improves over the reference benchmark on 37 tasks. DISTAL achieves the strongest overall performance among all evaluated feature combinations. These results indicate that compositional pretraining and structural distillation provide complementary priors and offer a practical route to robust composition-only prediction in small-data materials informatics. The source code and the pre-trained models are anonymously available at:this https URLand will be released at the official link after acceptance.
summary_zh: 在低数据场景下，材料属性预测任务仍存在较大挑战：大量目标属性仅能获得数量有限的标注样本。当前预测精度最高的模型通常依赖晶体结构信息，限制了其在结构信息有限或不可用的早期筛选阶段的应用。为解决该问题，本文提出DISTAL，一种面向结构无关材料属性预测的双先验框架，将自监督成分预训练与结构感知知识蒸馏相结合。DISTAL首先利用145个成分衍生描述符，在大规模虚拟成分空间中学习可迁移的成分表征，随后将预训练ALIGNN教师模型的结构知识蒸馏到以成分为条件的学生模型中。该设置可在训练阶段利用结构先验，而推理阶段无需输入结构信息。通过将显式成分描述符、预训练隐特征与蒸馏结构特征集成到统一预测流水线中，DISTAL捕获了任意单一表征都无法单独获取的互补信号。在39个基准任务上开展的实验表明，性能最优的多模态配置整合了三类信号，在37个任务上超越了参考基准，在所有参评特征组合中取得了最优的整体性能。该结果表明，成分预训练与结构蒸馏提供了互补先验，为小数据材料信息学场景下实现鲁棒的仅基于成分的预测提供了可行路径。源代码与预训练模型可通过对应链接匿名获取，论文录用后将在官方链接正式发布。

title: CUDA-Harness: Harnessing Agentic CUDA Kernel Generation and Optimization from Natural Language
title_zh: CUDA-Harness：基于自然语言的智能体CUDA内核生成与优化框架
authors: Qi Fan, An Zou, Yehan Ma
abstract: Developing high-performance CUDA kernels demands specialized knowledge in algorithm implementation, correctness validation, and hardware-aware parallel optimization, creating a substantial expertise barrier and making generating CUDA kernels directly from natural language (Text2CUDA) essential. Meanwhile, the general-purpose code generation capability of Large Language Models (LLMs) prompts a series of works exploring LLM-based CUDA kernel generation. They mainly focus on transpilation from high-level frameworks such as PyTorch to CUDA (Torch2CUDA) rather than Text2CUDA, where models must understand the high-level input semantics and handle low-level kernel implementation and validation. Additionally, these methods are vulnerable to reward hacking due to reliance on predefined test inputs. In this paper, we propose CUDA-Harness, a framework for harnessing agentic CUDA kernel generation and optimization from natural language. Specifically, we introduce Intermediate-Structured Generation to connect high-level semantic understanding with low-level kernel generation. To dilute reward hacking in Text2CUDA, we construct Synthesis-Based Verification to provide isolated test data and progressive validation. Furthermore, we propose Feedback-Adaptive Evolution, a kernel evolution strategy that prioritizes correctness while optimizing performance. Finally, through extensive experiments, we demonstrate the effectiveness of CUDA-Harness, with further evaluations illustrating generalization across LLMs, hardware platforms, and to C-to-CUDA transpilation.
summary_zh: 开发高性能CUDA内核需要算法实现、正确性验证与硬件感知并行优化领域的专业知识，存在极高的技能门槛，因此直接从自然语言生成CUDA内核（Text2CUDA）技术具备重要价值。与此同时，大语言模型的通用代码生成能力催生了一系列基于大语言模型的CUDA内核生成研究，但现有工作主要聚焦于从PyTorch等高层框架到CUDA的转译（Torch2CUDA），而非需要模型理解高层输入语义、处理底层内核实现与验证的Text2CUDA场景。此外，这类方法依赖预定义测试输入，容易出现奖励黑客问题。本文提出CUDA-Harness，一款用于实现从自然语言驱动智能体完成CUDA内核生成与优化的框架。具体而言，本文引入中间结构化生成模块，打通高层语义理解与底层内核生成的链路；为缓解Text2CUDA中的奖励黑客问题，构建基于合成的验证模块，提供独立测试数据与渐进式验证机制；进一步提出反馈自适应进化策略，在内核演化过程中优先保障正确性同时优化性能。最终通过大量实验验证了CUDA-Harness的有效性，后续评估表明该框架在不同大语言模型、硬件平台上具备泛化性，还可适配C到CUDA的转译任务。

title: ValueGraph: Value-Signal Guided Graph Pre-training for Contextualized User Representation
title_zh: ValueGraph：面向上下文用户表征的价值信号引导图预训练
authors: Yitong Han, Wei Gao, Yi Zhao, Prasanta Bhattacharya, Fengzhu Zeng 等 (6 人)
abstract: Value signals are aggregated user-level moral representations that capture users' inferred value-related tendencies from their online discourse. User behavior on social media is shaped not only by what users say or whom they interact with, but also by the value signal through which they express attitudes. Existing user representation methods largely miss this value-relevant dimension. We propose ValueGraph, a graph pre-training framework that uses automatically inferred moral-value signals as noisy auxiliary signals for contextualized user representation. From post-reply graphs, ValueGraph learns semantic and structural representations and further aligns users through relative value similarity with contrastive and clustering objectives. Rather than treating inferred values as gold psychological labels, ValueGraph uses them as soft constraints for representation learning. Experiments on stance detection and twitter bot detection show consistent gains over strong text-based, graph-based, and text-only LLM baselines, highlighting value-signal guidance as a useful inductive bias for socially informed user modeling.
summary_zh: 价值信号是聚合级的用户层面道德表征，可从用户的线上发言中推断出其与价值相关的行为倾向。社交媒体上的用户行为不仅受用户发言内容、交互对象的影响，也受其表达态度所依托的价值信号的影响。现有用户表征方法大多遗漏了这一价值相关维度。本文提出ValueGraph（价值信号引导图预训练框架），这是一种图预训练框架，将自动推断出的道德价值信号作为带噪辅助信号，用于生成上下文感知的用户表征。ValueGraph从帖子-回复图中学习语义与结构表征，并通过对比学习目标和聚类目标，基于用户间的相对价值相似度完成用户表征对齐。该框架没有将推断出的价值视为黄金心理学标签，而是将其作为表征学习的软约束。在立场检测和推特机器人检测任务上的实验结果显示，该方法的性能始终优于主流的基于文本、基于图以及仅使用文本的大语言模型基线，证明价值信号引导是面向社会感知用户建模的有效归纳偏置。

title: Zero-Shot Respiratory Sound Classification through LLM-Augmented Audio-Text Alignment
title_zh: 基于大语言模型增强的音文对齐实现零样本呼吸音分类
authors: Mustafa Talha İlerisoy, Hung Manh Pham, Mathias Funk, Mykola Pechenizkiy, Aaqib Saeed
abstract: Self-supervised respiratory encoders lack semantic grounding in clinical domain needed for zero-shot inference, limiting their utility without task-specific labeled data. We propose a framework that aligns these encoders with medical terminology in a shared latent space turning them into a zero-shot-capable foundation model. To address paired data scarcity, we use a medical LLM to synthesize structured reports from metadata, creating dense semantic anchors for contrastive learning. Our training combines a sigmoid-based contrastive loss with encoder's native SSL objective and similarity-aware negative sampling to sharpen pathological boundaries. Across 9 tasks on 6 datasets, our method achieves a 61.3% mean zero-shot AUC, surpassing CLAP (51.4%) and Qwen2-Audio (54.9%) while reaching the highest linear probing AUC (71.6%) with only 43% of data used by full-scale baselines, showing that structured semantic alignment outperforms large-scale, general-purpose models in clinical diagnostics.
summary_zh: 自监督呼吸音编码器缺乏零样本推理所需的临床领域语义基础，在缺少任务特定标注数据的场景下应用受限。本文提出一种框架，将这类编码器与医学术语在共享隐空间中对齐，使其成为具备零样本能力的基础模型。为解决配对数据稀缺问题，我们使用医学大语言模型从元数据中合成结构化报告，为对比学习构建密集语义锚点。训练过程结合了基于sigmoid的对比损失、编码器原生的自监督学习目标以及感知相似度的负采样策略，以强化病理特征的边界区分度。在6个数据集的9项任务上，所提方法的平均零样本AUC达到61.3%，超过CLAP（51.4%）和Qwen2-Audio（54.9%），且仅使用全规模基线方法43%的数据就取得了最高的线性探测AUC（71.6%），证明结构化语义对齐在临床诊断场景下的表现优于大规模通用模型。

title: From Detection to Refusal: Safer LLMs via Circuit-Guided Weight Scaling
title_zh: 从检测到拒绝：基于电路引导权重缩放的更安全大语言模型
authors: Kuan-Lin Chu, Chung-En Sun, Tsui-Wei Weng
abstract: Despite extensive alignment efforts, Large Language Models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to generating unsafe content under adversarial prompting, yet the internal mechanisms by which safety behaviors are implemented remain poorly understood. We study LLM safety from a mechanistic interpretability perspective and characterize a multi-stage *safety circuit* that organizes refusal behavior, consisting of (i) $\textbf{Harmful Detection Heads}$ that respond to harmful inputs, (ii) $\textbf{Safety Neurons}$ that mediate and stabilize safety signals in the residual stream, and (iii) $\textbf{Refusal Heads}$ that translate these signals into safe response generation. Using targeted attention-head and neuron-level interventions, we provide causal evidence consistent with this circuit organization, showing that suppressing upstream Harmful Detection Heads disrupts downstream refusal behavior and that safety neurons mediate this interaction. We validate that this decomposition recurs across multiple LLM architectures and adversarial attack settings, and use simple, architecture-preserving weight scaling as a mechanistic probe to test its functional relevance. Across six LLMs, circuit-guided scaling improves safety rates under attacks by 26.5%, while incurring only a 1.7% accuracy drop across four standard benchmarks. Overall, our results support a circuit-level interpretation of LLM safety and suggest that mechanistic abstractions can reveal stable and transferable patterns underlying aligned behavior.
summary_zh: 尽管学界已经开展了大量对齐工作，大语言模型（LLM）在对抗性提示下仍然容易生成不安全内容，而安全行为的内部实现机制目前仍不明确。本文从机制可解释性视角研究大语言模型安全问题，刻画了调控拒绝行为的多阶段安全电路（safety circuit），该电路由三部分组成：（1）有害检测头（Harmful Detection Heads），用于响应有害输入；（2）安全神经元（Safety Neurons），在残差流中调解并稳定安全信号；（3）拒绝头（Refusal Heads），将上述信号转化为安全回复生成。通过对注意力头和神经元层面的定向干预，我们提供了与该电路结构一致的因果证据：抑制上游的有害检测头会破坏下游的拒绝行为，而安全神经元在二者的交互中起到中介作用。我们验证了该分解结构在多种大语言模型架构和对抗攻击场景下均稳定存在，并采用不改变架构的简单权重缩放操作作为机制探针，测试其功能相关性。在6种大语言模型上的实验显示，电路引导的权重缩放可将攻击场景下的安全率提升26.5%，同时在4个主流基准测试上的准确率仅下降1.7%。整体而言，研究结果支持大语言模型安全的电路级解释，表明机制抽象可以揭示对齐行为背后稳定且可迁移的模式。

title: Towards Agentic Cloud Engineering: Graph and Loop Engineering with a Zero-Trust Agent Harness
title_zh: REAL-Q：基于动态梯度下降的端到端大语言模型量化
authors: Sagar Srinivas Sakhinana, Venkataramana Runkana
abstract: Agentic AI is enabling cloud-based workflows in which autonomous agents reason over operational state, invoke authorized tools, modify software and infrastructure, deploy services, verify execution outcomes, and adapt across long-horizon, multistep tasks. Engineering such workflows requires explicit mechanisms for workflow progression, constrained execution, failure recovery, and verifiable completion. We present Agentic Cloud Workflow Engineering, an agentic AI framework that transforms natural-language agentic cloud-engineering tasks into validated code repositories and verified operational cloud deployments for automating cloud-based agentic workflows. The framework separates three complementary concerns: graph engineering specifies long-horizon workflow progression and verification-dependent transitions; loop engineering provides bounded diagnosis, repair or re-planning, retry, and re-verification; and agent harness engineering enforces zero-trust execution through identity, authorization, policy-scoped capabilities, isolation, and runtime safeguards. Workflow progression and completion require machine-checkable repository, deployment, and runtime evidence, with recovery constrained by explicit operational bounds and termination criteria. We instantiate the framework on Google Cloud and evaluate repository completeness, controlled execution, evidence-gated progression, operational deployment, and bounded recovery. Experimental results show that executions terminate with either a verified operational cloud deployment or an auditable terminal failure under bounded recovery. The framework provides a unified engineering architecture for cloud-based workflows spanning Agentic DevOps, Agentic CloudOps, Agentic SRE/AIOps, Agentic SecOps, Agentic DataOps, Agentic MLOps/LLMOps, AgentOps, Agentic RAG/GraphRAG, and related cloud-engineering domains.
summary_zh: 训练后量化（PTQ）是大语言模型在严格资源约束下部署的核心技术。当前最先进的训练后量化方法采用单一的闭式二阶求解器对每一层进行量化：为了保持解析可处理性，这类方法对全局损失做了大量近似（丢弃跨通道耦合、将输出行分组池化），随后在整层范围内固定得到的海森矩阵，无法在损失景观逐列偏移时对其进行更新，我们将这一现象称为信息失配。本文提出REAL-Q（实时端到端损失对齐大语言模型量化方法），这是一种全新的训练后量化范式，打破了上述折中方案：不再为了便于解析计算而简化优化目标，而是针对全局损失的端到端对齐代理目标，在每一个列块（128列）之后执行细粒度的动态块级梯度下降对其进行优化。通过将该细粒度校正与平滑跨层过渡的滑动窗口机制相结合，REAL-Q有效缓解了网络中的误差传播。在LLaMA-3.1（8B和70B）以及Qwen3（0.6B-32B）模型的W4A16量化设置下，与当前最先进的全局引导方法相比，REAL-Q可将端到端KL散度最高降低约49%。

title: REAL-Q: E2E LLM Quantization via Dynamic Gradient Descent
title_zh: GUI-CC：面向智能体环境的GUI世界模型上下文一致性基准测试
authors: Qian Zhang, Yaoming Li, Zhewen Tan, Yanshu Wang, Heng Lu 等 (12 人)
abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is essential for deploying large language models (LLMs) under strict resource constraints. State-of-the-art PTQ methods quantize each layer with a single closed-form second-order solver: to remain analytically tractable, they heavily approximate the global loss (dropping cross-channel coupling, pooling output rows into groups), and they then freeze the resulting Hessian across the entire layer, with no way to refresh it as the loss landscape shifts column by column--a phenomenon we call information misalignment. We propose REAL-Q (Real-time E2E-loss Aligned LLM Quantization), a novel PTQ paradigm that breaks this compromise: instead of diluting the objective for the sake of analytic tractability, REAL-Q targets an end-to-end-aligned surrogate of the global loss and refines it via fine-grained, dynamic Block-wise Gradient Descent applied after every column block (128 columns). By coupling this fine-grained correction with a sliding window mechanism for smooth cross-layer transitions, REAL-Q effectively mitigates error propagation across the network. On LLaMA-3.1 (8B and 70B) and Qwen3 (0.6B-32B) at W4A16, REAL-Q reduces end-to-end KL divergence by up to ~49% relative to state-of-the-art globally-guided methods.
summary_zh: 图形用户界面（GUI）世界模型目前大多被评估为单步下一屏预测器，但其实际应用场景通常是作为GUI智能体的多步交互环境。这种 mismatch 导致一项核心要求未得到充分测试：生成的状态在被后续交互反复调用时必须保持上下文一致性。本文提出GUI-CC基准，不再将GUI世界模型作为独立的下一屏预测器，而是评估其作为智能体环境的上下文一致性。GUI-CC包含两个互补赛道：离线参考动作赛道，沿真实移动GUI轨迹运行模型；在线智能体循环赛道，让固定探测智能体与模型生成的UI交互。我们基于GUIOdyssey构建了500条离线轨迹任务，覆盖30款移动应用的200项经模拟器验证的在线任务。GUI-CC从转移保真度、转移合理性、上下文一致性、任务进度四个维度开展评估。实验结果显示，合理的单步生成无法保证可靠的环境模拟：当前模型经常生成看似可用的屏幕，却无法保留任务相关上下文，也无法支撑可执行的多步推演。

title: GUI-CC: Benchmarking Contextual Consistency of GUI World Models as Agent Environments
authors: Lin Fu, Zheyuan Yang, Tianhui Zhang, Jinbiao Wei, Guo Gan 等 (8 人)
abstract: GUI world models are increasingly evaluated as one-step next-screen predictors, yet their intended use is often as multi-step environments for GUI agents. This mismatch leaves a key requirement under-tested: generated states must remain contextually consistent when they are repeatedly reused for future interaction. We introduce GUI-CC, a benchmark that evaluates contextual consistency of GUI world models as agent environments rather than isolated next-screen predictors. GUI-CC contains two complementary tracks: an offline reference-action track that rolls models along real mobile GUI trajectories, and an online agent-loop track that lets fixed probing agents interact with model-generated UIs. We construct 500 offline trajectory tasks from GUIOdyssey and 200 emulator-verified online tasks across 30 mobile apps. GUI-CC evaluates transition fidelity, transition plausibility, contextual consistency, and task progress. Experiments show that plausible single-step generation does not guarantee reliable environment simulation: current models often produce usable-looking screens while failing to preserve task-relevant context or support executable multi-step rollouts.

title: Task-Specific Prompt with Global Context for Multi-Task Graph Pre-Training
title_zh: 面向多任务图预训练的带全局上下文的任务特定提示
authors: Zhiyang Qiu, Yangtao Wang, Xiaocui Li, Yanzhao Xie, Siyuan Chen 等 (6 人)
abstract: Graph prompt learning is an effective paradigm to adapt pre-trained graph models to downstream tasks in low-resource scenarios. However, existing multi-task graph pre-training frameworks generally use randomly initialized prompts, leading to poor alignment between the prompt space, pretext objectives and graph structural characteristics. This greatly weakens the task relevance, structural awareness and transferability of prompt representations. To address this challenge, we propose TPGC, a dual-prior prompt initialization solution that explicitly models the synergy between task prior and structural prior. Specifically, the Task-Prior Injection Module first conducts a short homologous multi-task pre-training on an auxiliary graph, enabling prompt initialization to inherit optimization preferences associated with multiple pretext tasks. Built on the task-aware representations, the Structure-Prior Injection Module further extracts transferable global structural context from the auxiliary graph, converting it into layer-wise prompt vectors by aggregating structurally informative node embeddings. Extensive experiments on 6 mainstream benchmarks covering node and graph classification show that TPGC achieves consistently better performance under few-shot settings than state-of-the-art baselines, with fewer downstream tunable parameters and lower runtime. The code is available atthis https URL
summary_zh: 图提示学习是在低资源场景下将预训练图模型适配到下游任务的有效范式。但现有多任务图预训练框架通常使用随机初始化的提示，导致提示空间、前置任务目标与图结构特征之间对齐效果较差，大幅削弱了提示表征的任务相关性、结构感知能力和可迁移性。为解决这一问题，本文提出TPGC，一种双先验提示初始化方案，显式建模任务先验与结构先验的协同效应。具体而言，任务先验注入模块首先在辅助图上执行短周期同源多任务预训练，让提示初始化过程继承与多个前置任务关联的优化偏好。在任务感知表征的基础上，结构先验注入模块进一步从辅助图中提取可迁移的全局结构上下文，通过聚合携带结构信息的节点嵌入，将其转化为逐层提示向量。在覆盖节点分类和图分类任务的6个主流基准上开展的大量实验表明，在少样本设置下，TPGC的性能始终优于现有最先进基线，同时下游可调参数数量更少、运行时间更短。相关代码已公开至对应链接。

title: RAPIDMap: Rapid Multi-Agent Pipeline for Interpretable Disaster Mapping from Satellite and Street-view Imagery
title_zh: RAPIDMap：基于卫星和街景影像的可解释灾害测绘快速多智能体流水线
authors: Yifan Yang, Lei Zou
abstract: Rapid and reliable disaster mapping of impacted areas, damaged infrastructure, and affected populations is essential for emergency response and recovery. However, existing AI-based approaches often require extensive manual annotation, lack cross-hazard generalization, and rely on single-modal observations. To address these challenges, this paper proposes RAPIDMap, a rapid multi-agent pipeline for zero-shot interpretable disaster mapping from satellite and street-view imagery. The framework integrates four intelligent agents: Disaster Perception Agent (DPA), Image Restoration Agent (IRA), Damage Recognition Agent (DRA), and Disaster Mapping Agent (DMA). By combining remote sensing and street-view data, RAPIDMap eliminates the need for manual fine-tuning, generalizes across multiple disaster categories, and generates structured, map-ready disaster intelligence with recovery recommendations.
summary_zh: 快速可靠地完成受灾区域、受损基础设施和受影响人口的灾害测绘，对应急响应与恢复工作至关重要。但现有基于人工智能的方法通常需要大量人工标注，缺乏跨灾害泛化能力，且依赖单模态观测数据。为应对上述挑战，本文提出RAPIDMap，一种快速多智能体流水线，可基于卫星和街景影像实现零样本可解释灾害测绘。该框架集成4个智能体：灾害感知智能体（DPA）、图像修复智能体（IRA）、损毁识别智能体（DRA）和灾害测绘智能体（DMA）。通过结合遥感与街景数据，RAPIDMap无需人工微调，可在多类灾害场景下泛化，生成结构化、可直接用于制图的灾害情报与恢复建议。

title: trajectory-judge: What Outcome-Only LLM Judges Miss on Agent Trajectories
title_zh: trajectory-judge：仅基于输出的大语言模型评判器在智能体轨迹评估中的遗漏问题
authors: Hadi Mohammadi
abstract: Outcome-only evaluation is the production default for LLM agents: show a judge the request and the final reply and ask whether it was handled well. The metric is structurally blind to an agent that reaches the right answer the wrong way. We measure that blind spot where ground truth is known by construction: a deterministic tool-using support-desk environment, a scripted oracle policy that always solves it, and a fault injector that breaks exactly one thing at a known step, stratifying faults by whether the customer-visible outcome survived (silent) or not (loud). Five judges (programmatic rules, outcome-only, step-rubric at two model sizes, and a self-consistency ensemble) are scored on detection, step localisation, fault typing, calibration, and cost over 400 trajectories. The outcome-only judge catches 84% of loud faults but 45% of silent ones while flagging 33% of correct trajectories; a step-rubric judge reaches 77% silent recall with zero false alarms at 3x the cost. No judge reads the final reply: an invented promise appended to an otherwise perfect trajectory evades the rules entirely and the step judge 82% of the time, and self-consistency triples cost while improving nothing. We argue that judge evaluations must stratify recall by outcome survival, and release the environment, the injector, all raw verdicts, and an analysis pipeline that rebuilds every number offline.
summary_zh: 仅基于输出的评估是当前大语言模型智能体的主流生产级评估方案：向评判器展示用户请求和最终回复，判断任务是否被妥善处理。该评估指标存在结构性盲区：智能体可能通过错误路径得到正确结果，这类情况无法被该指标识别。我们在已知真实值的场景下对该盲区进行量化：采用确定性工具调用客服环境、可正确解决所有任务的脚本化预言机策略，以及故障注入器，在已知步骤处精准注入单类故障，并根据用户可见的最终结果是否正常将故障分为隐式故障和显式故障。我们在400条轨迹上对5种评判器（程序规则评判器、仅输出评判器、两种模型尺寸的步骤规则评判器、自一致性集成评判器）的故障检测能力、步骤定位能力、故障分类能力、校准能力和评估成本进行打分。结果显示，仅输出评判器可检测到84%的显式故障，但仅能识别45%的隐式故障，同时会误判33%的正确轨迹；步骤规则评判器的隐式故障召回率可达77%且无虚警，评估成本为前者的3倍。所有评判器都无法识别轨迹中的伪造承诺：在完全正确的轨迹末尾追加虚假承诺后，程序规则会完全失效，步骤规则评判器的漏检率达82%，自一致性方案的成本提升3倍但性能无任何改善。我们认为评判器评估必须按最终结果是否正常分层统计召回率，同时公开了所用环境、故障注入器、所有原始评判结果和可离线复现所有指标的分析流水线。

title: EULER: Exploring Underused Links with Evidence-Checked Return for Multi-Agent Mathematical Discovery
title_zh: EULER：面向多智能体数学发现的带证据校验返回的未充分利用链路探索方法
authors: Ren Zhenzhuo
abstract: Mathematical communities work with different objects, invariants, and tools, so transferring a problem across them is expensive and often skipped. We present EULER, a multi-agent system that takes such a transfer--a bridge--as its unit of search. Around a fixed conjecture, EULER runs direct, adjacent-domain, and distant-domain routes in competition; a bridge keeps its budget only if it supplies an operation the source representation cannot execute and its target-side evidence returns to the original statement along a checked implication. Six ordered stress tests reject invalid bridges before expensive search begins.We evaluate EULER on 120 recent conjectures. The conjectures were frozen before search and screened for contamination, and are drawn from public papers by authors who had recently published in the Journal of Combinatorial Theory, Series A, a leading journal in combinatorics. EULER produced 10 proofs and 3 refutations, plus 45 scoped partial results. Two mechanisms held up under ablation: bridge-specific stress tests cut incorrect conclusions from 9 to 3, and bridge material combined with a target-native operation yielded a positive interaction of +4.2 resolved tasks that neither factor produced alone. Domain distance did not reliably predict success; executable operation gain and valid return did.
summary_zh: 不同数学分支的研究社群使用不同的研究对象、不变量和工具，因此将问题跨领域迁移的成本极高，这类迁移通常被直接跳过。本文提出EULER多智能体系统，将这类跨领域迁移（即桥接）作为核心搜索单元。针对固定猜想，EULER并行运行直接路径、相邻领域路径和远距领域路径三类搜索路径并开展竞争；只有当某条桥接路径可以提供源表征无法实现的操作，且目标侧的证据可以沿经过校验的蕴含关系返回原始命题时，该桥接路径才能保留搜索配额。系统设置6项有序压力测试，在高成本搜索启动前就排除无效桥接路径。我们在120个近期提出的猜想上对EULER进行评估，所有猜想在搜索开始前已被冻结且经过污染校验，均选自《组合理论杂志A辑》（组合数学领域顶刊）近年发表的公开论文。EULER共生成10个证明、3个证否结果，以及45个限定范围的部分结果。消融实验验证了两项核心机制的有效性：桥接专属压力测试将错误结论数量从9个降至3个，桥接材料与目标原生操作的组合实现了+4.2的额外可解任务数，该增益是单独使用任意一项机制都无法实现的。领域距离无法可靠预测任务成功率，可执行操作增益和有效证据返回才是决定任务成败的核心因素。

title: OpenAgentFlow: Enabling System-Wide Safety Boundaries for Heterogeneous AI Agent Fleets
title_zh: OpenAgentFlow：面向异构AI智能体群的全系统安全边界实现
authors: Dongsheng Chen, Xiangyu Zhao, Xin Yao, Xuetao Wei
abstract: AI agents powered by large language models are evolving from isolated assistants into heterogeneous systems in which multiple agents, planners, controllers, and execution backends operate over the same user or enterprise environment. In such settings, safety becomes a system-level action-governance problem: deciding whether concrete agent-generated actions should be committed before they modify shared state. Existing safeguards cover prompts, tool calls, GUI actions, and agent-local behavior, but often leave enforcement fragmented, obscure risks that emerge across multi-step action flows, and provide limited support for auditability and policy evolution.We present OpenAgentFlow, a control-plane/action-plane architecture that enforces safety at the action-commit boundary. It normalizes pending GUI actions, API calls, tool calls, and LLM-generated invocations into a unified AgentEvent stream, routes each event through a shared pre-execution Policy Enforcement Point, and maintains provenance, session state, audit records, and updatable policies in the control plane. This creates a shared governable action stream and allows new rules to take effect without modifying agents, prompts, models, or execution paths.We instantiate OpenAgentFlow on Android. On a 300-case action-event benchmark, it achieves 94.0% accuracy and a 95.3% attack block rate. On a 30-case dynamic-policy suite, it matches expected behavior in 27 cases after new rules are installed. Across 98 traced cases from a 100-case Android emulator suite, it achieves 90.8% raw accuracy and a 92.9% trace-adjusted pass rate across GUI, API, and LLM-planned cases. These results show that OpenAgentFlow provides a practical shared enforcement boundary for heterogeneous AI agent fleets.
summary_zh: 大语言模型驱动的AI智能体正从独立助手演进为异构系统，多个智能体、规划器、控制器与执行后端在同一用户或企业环境中协同运行。在这类场景下，安全问题成为系统级的动作治理问题：即在智能体生成的具体动作修改共享状态前，判断是否允许执行该动作。现有安全防护方案覆盖提示词、工具调用、GUI动作与智能体本地行为，但往往存在执行逻辑碎片化、多步动作流中涌现的风险被掩盖、可审计性与策略迭代支持不足等问题。本文提出OpenAgentFlow，一种控制平面/动作平面架构，在动作提交边界处强制执行安全规则。该架构将待执行的GUI动作、API调用、工具调用与大语言模型生成的调用统一标准化为AgentEvent事件流，将每个事件路由至共享的预执行策略执行点，并在控制平面中维护溯源信息、会话状态、审计记录与可更新策略。该架构构建了可被统一治理的共享动作流，无需修改智能体、提示词、模型或执行路径即可让新规则生效。本文在安卓平台上实现了OpenAgentFlow，在包含300个用例的动作事件基准测试中达到94.0%的准确率与95.3%的攻击拦截率；在30个用例的动态策略测试集中，安装新规则后27个用例的表现符合预期；在安卓模拟器套件的100个用例中筛选出的98个可追踪用例上，覆盖GUI、API与大语言模型规划场景的原始准确率达90.8%，经轨迹调整后的通过率达92.9%。实验结果表明，OpenAgentFlow可为异构AI智能体群提供实用的共享安全执行边界。

title: Behaviorally Grounded User Profiles from the Wild for Personalized Alignment and Multi-Perspective Reasoning
title_zh: 从真实场景中获取行为锚定用户画像以实现个性化对齐与多视角推理
authors: Yuxuan Li, Victor Zhong, Ehsan Kamalloo
abstract: Persona-driven techniques increasingly adapt large language models (LLMs) to diverse contexts. However, existing methods predominantly rely on rigid, synthetic personas that flatten individual variation, rely on stereotypes, and miss the nuanced signals driving actual human preferences. We introduce profile behavioral grounding, a framework for extracting open-ended, high-fidelity user profiles directly from authentic, anonymized social media posts. We evaluate these profiles across two paradigms: train-time personalization via supervised finetuning (SFT) and non-parametric test-time multi-perspective reasoning. Across complex recommendation and open-ended query benchmarks, behaviorally grounded profiles consistently improve base models and outperform synthetic profile baselines, driving stronger parametric alignment and enabling richer, multifaceted reasoning. Our findings establish open-ended, behavior-derived profiles as a highly diverse and effective foundation for the next generation of personalized language systems. Our code base is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 角色驱动技术正越来越多地用于将大语言模型（LLM）适配到不同场景中。但现有方法大多依赖僵化的合成角色，这类角色会抹平个体差异、依赖刻板印象，且缺失驱动人类真实偏好的细粒度信号。本文提出画像行为锚定技术，这是一套可直接从真实匿名社交媒体帖子中提取开放式高保真用户画像的框架。本文在两种范式下对生成的画像进行评估：基于监督微调（SFT）的训练时个性化，以及非参数化的测试时多视角推理。在复杂推荐与开放式查询基准测试中，行为锚定画像可持续提升基础模型表现，性能优于合成画像基线，实现更强的参数化对齐，支撑更丰富的多维度推理。研究结果表明，开放式、从行为数据生成的画像可作为下一代个性化语言系统极具多样性且高效的基础支撑。相关代码库可通过对应公开链接获取。

title: Long-Horizon State Tracking in LLMs: Executing MD5 through a Deep Sequence of Dependent Tool Calls
title_zh: 大语言模型的长时序状态跟踪：通过深度依赖工具调用序列执行MD5计算
authors: Dheeraj Mohandas Pai, Lu Xian
abstract: Long-horizon tasks remain uncommon in large language model (LLM) evaluation, and for a reason: when each step depends on the last, per-step accuracy that looks excellent in isolation decays catastrophically, as errors cascade and the end-to-end failure probability grows sharply with length. Existing agentic benchmarks report end-to-end success but confound this state-tracking difficulty with instruction interpretation, give no control group that isolates it, and are vulnerable to shortcuts such as a hallucinated final answer, so they cannot say why a long run fails. Whether an LLM can carry exact intermediate state across many tool calls at all is itself not well established. We test this cleanly by having the model compute a cryptographic hash, MD5, step by step: a sequence of $196$ dependent tool calls over $64$ rounds while it carries four $32$-bit words $(a,b,c,d)$ in its own context from one call to the next. Interpretation is trivial and, because we implement MD5 from scratch (RFC~1321), we align every call to the ground-truth trace and check the digest to the bit, so any failure is pure bookkeeping. gpt-oss-120b, a mixture-of-experts model with only $\sim$5.5B active parameters per token, at temperature $0$ with a short fixed prompt, carries the full state across all $196$ calls and returns the correct digest on a majority of completed runs. In the strongest setting we replace every primitive tool with a second LLM, so a driver and a worker compute the whole hash from scratch with no exact-arithmetic oracle in the loop. Two ingredients decide success and neither changes the weights: keeping the model's own reasoning in its context each turn, and voting over a thinking-enabled worker to remove its modular-arithmetic slips. We localize the residual failures by origin, separating state-carrying from arithmetic and from serving.
summary_zh: 长时序任务在大语言模型评估中仍较为少见，原因在于：当每一步操作都依赖上一步结果时，单看表现优异的单步准确率会出现灾难性衰减，错误不断累积，端到端失败概率随序列长度急剧上升。现有智能体基准测试仅报告端到端成功率，却将状态跟踪难度与指令解读难度混淆，未设置可单独隔离状态跟踪能力的对照组，且容易被生成虚构最终答案等捷径绕过，因此无法定位长序列运行失败的根本原因。大语言模型究竟能否在大量工具调用过程中准确传递中间状态，这一问题本身尚未得到充分验证。本文通过让模型逐步计算MD5加密哈希的方式开展严格测试：模型需要完成64轮共196次依赖型工具调用，全程在自身上下文内存中传递4个32位字(a,b,c,d)的状态信息。该任务的指令解读难度极低，且由于本文完全按照RFC 1321标准从零实现MD5算法，可将每一次调用与真实轨迹对齐，逐位校验最终摘要，任何失败都纯粹源于状态记录错误。实验使用gpt-oss-120b（一种混合专家模型，每个token仅激活约55亿参数），在温度参数设为0、使用简短固定提示词的条件下，可在全部196次调用中完整传递状态，在多数完成的运行中返回正确的MD5摘要。在最严苛的设置下，本文将所有基础工具替换为第二个大语言模型，由主模型与工作模型全程协作从零计算哈希，流程中不接入精确算术预言机。最终成功由两个不涉及修改模型权重的要素决定：每轮都将模型自身的推理过程保留在上下文内，以及对支持推理的工作模型输出进行投票以消除模运算错误。本文还对剩余失败的成因进行分类，区分了状态传递错误、算术错误与服务故障三类问题。

title: Incremental Risk Assessment of Progressive Elder Financial Scams via Instruction-Tuned Small Language Models
title_zh: 基于指令微调小语言模型的渐进式老年金融诈骗增量风险评估
authors: Parviz Ghafariasl, Weimin Fu, Xiaolong Guo, Shing I. Chang
abstract: Financial scams targeting older adults increasingly occur through text and voice channels such as email, SMS, and phone calls, unfolding over multiple conversational turns that begin with impersonation or casual contact, escalate through trust building and urgency, and culminate in requests for sensitive information or financial transfers. Because risk signals emerge incrementally across turns, effective detection requires models that continuously update risk estimates under resource-constrained deployment settings. We propose a cumulative turn-based risk assessment framework that incrementally aggregates conversational turns and re-estimates risk at each step, enabling dynamic scam monitoring across progressively evolving conversations. A multi-turn dialogue dataset is constructed to cover investment, charity, and tech support scam scenarios, with each dialogue containing two to eight turns and annotated at every cumulative stage with a qualitative risk level, a continuous risk score, an explanatory rationale, and a safety recommendation. Four small language models (Phi-4, LLaMA-3.2, DeepSeek-R1, and Qwen3) are fine-tuned and evaluated under a unified training framework. Fine-tuned small models capture fraud-related linguistic cues and cross-turn escalation patterns while maintaining compact architectures suitable for mobile and resource-constrained deployment settings. Among the evaluated models, Phi-4 and LLaMA-3.2 achieve stronger turn-aware risk estimation performance relative to their parameter scale. These results suggest that structured cumulative modeling can support incremental scam risk assessment in deployment-oriented settings while highlighting the potential of compact language models for privacy-aware and on-device fraud protection.
summary_zh: 针对老年群体的金融诈骗越来越多地通过邮件、短信、电话等文本与语音渠道实施，诈骗过程跨越多轮对话，从身份冒充或日常接触开始，逐步通过建立信任、制造紧迫感升级，最终诱导受害者提交敏感信息或转账。由于风险信号在多轮对话中逐步显现，有效检测需要模型可在资源受限部署环境下持续更新风险估计值。本文提出一种基于对话轮次的累积风险评估框架，可逐步聚合对话轮次，在每一步重新估计风险，实现对逐步演进对话的动态诈骗监测。本文构建了覆盖投资诈骗、慈善诈骗、技术支持诈骗场景的多轮对话数据集，每个对话包含2到8轮交互，在每一个累积阶段都标注了定性风险等级、连续风险得分、解释依据与安全建议。在统一训练框架下对4个小语言模型（Phi-4、LLaMA-3.2、DeepSeek-R1、Qwen3）进行微调与评估。微调后的小模型可捕捉诈骗相关的语言线索与跨轮次升级模式，同时保持轻量化架构，适配移动端与资源受限部署场景。在所有评估模型中，Phi-4与LLaMA-3.2的轮次感知风险估计性能在其参数规模下表现更优。研究结果表明，结构化累积建模可在面向部署的场景下支撑诈骗风险增量评估，同时验证了轻量化语言模型在隐私友好、端侧反诈骗场景中的应用潜力。

title: Discrete-Time MDP Modeling for Multi-Item Capacitated Lot Sizing with Stochastic Demand Timing
title_zh: 需求到达时间随机的多产品带能力约束批量问题的离散时间马尔可夫决策过程建模
authors: Léa Bayati, Mohamed Dahmoune, Melek Rodoplu
abstract: This paper studies a finite-horizon multi-item capacitated lot-sizing problem in which demand quantities are deterministic, while demand-arrival periods are stochastic. Each demand occurs once within a known time window and must be satisfied no later than its deadline. The proposed model makes production and allocation decisions at the demand level, allowing it to represent capacity competition, demand-specific backlog, and allocation-dependent inventory dynamics. The stochastic problem is formulated as a discrete-time Markov decision process (DTMDP), including the state space, feasible actions, transition kernel, and one-period cost function. To isolate the computational effect of stochastic timing, each stochastic instance is first compared with a deterministic counterpart in which each arrival distribution is replaced by its most likely arrival period. This comparison shows that stochastic timing substantially increases the number of states, the number of transitions, solution time, and memory pressure. A genetic algorithm (GA) is then proposed for the stochastic-timing problem. The GA searches over feasible state-feedback policies and evaluates each policy exactly under the DTMDP transition model. Computational experiments on 330 benchmark instances show that the GA remains close to the exact stochastic solution whenever the latter is available, with an average optimality gap of about $3.44\%$. On the difficult benchmark instances, comprising 90 test cases, the GA remains below the $5\%$ optimality-gap threshold and achieves an average optimization speedup of $6.89 \pm 1.41$ at the $95\%$ confidence level. For instances that cannot be solved exactly on the available hardware, an empirical Bellman-time regression is used to estimate the missing exact resolution time and extrapolate the expected GA speedup.
summary_zh: 本文研究有限时域多产品带能力约束批量问题，该问题中需求数量是确定的，但需求到达的时段是随机的。每个需求在已知时间窗口内仅出现一次，且必须不晚于其截止期被满足。本文提出的模型在需求层面制定生产与分配决策，可表征产能竞争、需求专属延迟订单、依赖分配结果的库存动态等特性。该随机问题被建模为离散时间马尔可夫决策过程（DTMDP），明确定义了状态空间、可行动作、转移核与单时段成本函数。为分离随机需求时间带来的计算影响，本文首先将每个随机实例与对应确定性实例进行对比，后者将每个到达分布替换为最可能的到达时段。对比结果表明，随机需求时间会大幅增加状态数、转移数、求解时间与内存压力。随后本文针对该随机需求时间问题提出遗传算法（GA），该算法在可行的状态反馈策略空间内搜索，基于DTMDP转移模型精确评估每个策略的性能。在330个基准实例上的计算实验表明，只要精确随机解可获取，遗传算法的求解结果就与精确解非常接近，平均最优性差距约为3.44%；在包含90个测试用例的高难度基准实例上，遗传算法的最优性差距始终低于5%，在95%置信水平下平均优化加速比达6.89±1.41。对于现有硬件无法精确求解的实例，本文使用经验贝尔曼时间回归方法估计缺失的精确求解时间，外推得到遗传算法的预期加速比。

title: I-CARE: Analysis of interference-related phenomena in a controllable, diverse and representative unlearning setting for text-to-image models
title_zh: I-CARE：面向文生图模型的可控、多样、具代表性的反遗忘场景下干扰相关现象分析
authors: Leonardo Santiago Benitez Pereira, Marcos Escudero Viñolo, Luis Herranz Arribas
abstract: Machine unlearning studies the removal of knowledge from an AI model, making the system forget a concept it previously learned. Despite rapid progress in generative machine unlearning, the unintended degradation of semantically related concepts that should have been retained (henceforth, interference) remains poorly characterized and inconsistently evaluated. This paper introduces I-CARE, a methodology that formalizes interference as a first-class object of study in generative unlearning. Rather than proposing a new benchmark or unlearning algorithm, I-CARE provides formal definitions for tasks, metrics, and templates for reporting results, enabling the systematic and reproducible study of interference across unlearning settings. While our methodology is designed to remain valid as models and unlearning algorithms evolve, decoupling long-term scientific insight from transient empirical results, we present a feasibility demonstration with state-of-the-art algorithms and frequently used datasets. The results demonstrate that I-CARE enables meaningful analysis of interference patterns across multiple unlearning settings, establishing the practical applicability of the framework. The software implementation of the methodology is provided in an open-source framework, together with a web-based graphical interface that enables exploration of the outcomes of this study without requiring direct interaction with the codebase or specialized data analysis tools.
summary_zh: 机器反遗忘技术研究如何从AI模型中移除特定知识，让系统遗忘其之前学习到的某个概念。尽管生成式机器反遗忘领域进展迅速，但本该保留的语义相关概念出现非预期性能下降（下称干扰）这一问题仍缺乏清晰表征与统一评估标准。本文提出I-CARE方法体系，将干扰正式定义为生成式反遗忘中的一级研究对象。I-CARE并未提出新的基准或反遗忘算法，而是为任务、指标与结果报告模板提供正式定义，支持在不同反遗忘设置下开展系统、可复现的干扰研究。该方法体系设计为可随模型与反遗忘算法迭代持续生效，将长期科学结论与临时经验结果解耦。本文结合当前最先进算法与常用数据集开展可行性验证，结果表明I-CARE可在多个反遗忘设置下对干扰模式开展有意义的分析，证明了该框架的实际适用性。该方法的软件实现已作为开源框架发布，配套提供基于网页的图形界面，用户无需直接操作代码库或使用专业数据分析工具即可探索本研究的全部结果。

title: HyperWorld: Hypergraph-Structured State Serialization Improves Learned Textual World Models
title_zh: HyperWorld：超图结构状态序列化改进习得式文本世界模型
authors: Yun-Jian Zhang, Chen-Wei Liang, Tian-Yi Zhang, Jian Ding, Yi-Lun Wu 等 (10 人)
abstract: World models enable language-model agents to predict environment dynamics and plan before acting. In text environments, the model must learn symbolic action effects from serialized state descriptions, but the role of serialization structure remains underexplored. We present HyperWorld, a controlled study of state serialization for learned textual world models. We compare raw observations with three symbolic serializations of the same ground-truth state: independent sentences, pairwise triples, and entity-centered hyperedge units that group multiple related facts around entities and relations. All variants use the same training objective: given a state and an action, predict symbolic effects or judge the action infeasible. Across model scales, data budgets, and in-distribution and out-of-distribution test worlds, hyperedge serialization gives the clearest gains for 0.5B--1.5B models and under distribution shift. Larger models reduce the gap, and pairwise triples can match or slightly exceed hyperedges on in-distribution exact match, but hyperedges achieve the strongest out-of-distribution fact F1 and the best small-to-medium scale trade-off between feasibility detection and effect prediction. In downstream greedy planning, the hyperedge world model also attains the highest success rate among the tested representations. These results show that higher-order state organization is a simple but effective inductive bias for learned symbolic world models, especially when model capacity is limited or test environments differ from training.
summary_zh: 世界模型可让语言模型智能体预测环境动态，在行动前完成规划。在文本环境中，模型必须从序列化状态描述中学习符号化动作的效果，但序列化结构的作用尚未得到充分探索。本文提出HyperWorld，针对习得式文本世界模型的状态序列化开展对照研究。本文将原始观测结果与同一真实状态的三种符号化序列化方式进行对比：独立句子、成对三元组、以实体为中心的超边单元（将围绕实体与关系的多个相关事实聚合为一组）。所有变体使用相同的训练目标：给定状态与动作，预测符号化动作效果或判断动作不可行。在不同模型规模、数据量、分布内与分布外测试环境下，超边序列化在0.5B-1.5B参数模型上以及分布偏移场景下的性能提升最为显著。更大规模的模型可缩小不同序列化方式的性能差距，成对三元组在分布内精确匹配指标上可达到甚至略超超边序列化，但超边序列化在分布外事实F1指标上表现最优，且在中小规模模型下实现了可行性检测与效果预测之间的最佳权衡。在下游贪心规划任务中，超边世界模型在所有测试的表征方式中取得了最高的成功率。研究结果表明，高阶状态组织是习得式符号世界模型简单且高效的归纳偏置，尤其适用于模型容量有限或测试环境与训练环境存在差异的场景。

title: InteractBench: Benchmarking LLMs on Competitive Programming under Unrevealed Information
title_zh: InteractBench：非完全信息场景下大语言模型竞技编程能力基准测试
authors: Jiaze Li, Aocheng Shen, Bing Liu, Boyu Zhang, Xiaoxuan Fan 等 (7 人)
abstract: Competitive programming is increasingly being used to evaluate the algorithmic reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, existing benchmarks primarily focus on full-information tasks where all problem inputs are provided upfront. This overlooks a critical dimension of algorithmic reasoning: the ability of generated programs to operate when key information is not revealed upfront. Interactive problems, a distinctive component of competitive programming, embody this challenge. These problems require programs to engage in multi-round interaction with an interactor (a judge program) under strict protocol constraints and limited query budgets, with new information revealed only in response to queries. To address this gap, we introduce InteractBench, a benchmark comprising 322 high-quality interactive problems curated from Codeforces, AtCoder, IOI, and ICPC. Each problem is packaged with executable local interactors, enabling fully offline evaluation. Unlike existing benchmarks, InteractBench assesses whether model-generated code can acquire information and track state dynamically. Our evaluation reveals a significant interaction gap: even the most advanced reasoning models achieve limited success on interactive problems. Beyond success rates, we propose a fine-grained failure taxonomy to diagnose the root causes of these deficiencies. Although algorithmic logic errors remain dominant, protocol violations and query-budget overruns are frequent. Code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 竞技编程正越来越多地被用于评估大语言模型的算法推理能力。但现有基准测试主要聚焦全信息任务，所有问题输入都在初始阶段全部提供，忽略了算法推理的一个关键维度：生成的程序在关键信息未提前披露时的运行能力。作为竞技编程的独特组成部分，交互式问题正是这类挑战的典型代表：这类问题要求程序在严格协议约束与有限查询预算下，与交互器（评测程序）开展多轮交互，只有在提交查询后才能获取新信息。为填补这一空白，本文提出InteractBench基准测试集，包含从Codeforces、AtCoder、IOI与ICPC中筛选出的322道高质量交互式问题，每道问题都配套可执行的本地交互器，支持完全离线评估。与现有基准不同，InteractBench评估模型生成的代码能否动态获取信息、跟踪状态。评估结果显示当前模型存在显著的交互能力差距：即使是最先进的推理模型在交互式问题上的成功率也十分有限。除了成功率指标外，本文还提出细粒度的故障分类体系，用于定位这类缺陷的根本原因：尽管算法逻辑错误占比最高，但协议违规与查询预算超限的问题也十分频发。相关代码可通过对应公开链接获取。

title: Beyond Scores: Understanding LLM-as-a-Judge Mechanisms in Summarization Evaluation
title_zh: 超越评分：理解摘要评估中大语言模型评委的作用机制
authors: Himil Vasava, Ming Jiang
abstract: LLM-based evaluators of natural language generation (NLG) quality are widely deployed as scoring tools and as automated training signals, yet the internal procedure by which they assign a rating remains poorly understood. We investigate this procedure mechanistically through an eight-attack perturbation taxonomy across the Readability and Adequacy dimensions of NLG quality, a generation pipeline that produces paired clean and corrupt summaries with controlled error intensity and explicit token-level modification maps, and a four-experiment battery of causal tracing, logit-lens vocabulary projection, and attention-head knockout applied to Themis (Llama-3-8B) and Prometheus (Mistral-7B). Both evaluators implement a structured, coherent evaluation pipeline operating in two stages: below layer 15, attention performs local error comparison and routes the result to the final input position; above it, the MLP cascade integrates the signal and writes the rating, with the decision crystallizing in the residual stream at a sharp late layer (L = 26 on Themis, L = 25 on Prometheus). Furthermore, a base-model control at the same scale (Llama-3-8B) reproduces the routing architecture and crystallization but not the stage separation, isolating the two mechanisms that fine-tuning specifically installs, suppression of below-L15 MLP contribution at the last position and a two-layer advance of the crystallization depth, indicating that fine-tuning sculpts an existing substrate rather than building the pipeline from scratch. We release the source code and data atthis https URL
summary_zh: 基于大语言模型的自然语言生成（NLG）质量评估器已被广泛用作评分工具与自动化训练信号，但其分配评分的内部过程仍未被充分理解。本文通过覆盖自然语言生成质量可读性与充分性两个维度的8类攻击扰动分类体系、可生成配对干净/损坏摘要且控制错误强度并提供显式token级修改映射的生成流水线，以及针对Themis（Llama-3-8B）与Prometheus（Mistral-7B）两个模型开展的因果追踪、对数透镜词汇投影、注意力头剔除四类实验，对该评估过程的作用机制开展系统性研究。结果表明，两个评估器都实现了结构化、连贯的两阶段评估流水线：在第15层以下，注意力机制执行局部错误对比，并将结果路由到最终输入位置；在第15层以上，多层感知机级联整合信号并输出评分，决策在靠后层的残差流中快速固化（Themis在第26层固化，Prometheus在第25层固化）。此外，相同规模的基础模型（Llama-3-8B）复现了路由架构与决策固化特性，但不存在阶段分离，这明确了微调专门引入的两类机制：抑制第15层以下最后位置的多层感知机贡献，以及将决策固化深度提前两层，说明微调是在已有基础架构上优化，而非从零构建评估流水线。本文相关代码与数据已通过对应公开链接发布。

title: The Structure of Quantization Damage in LLMs: Why the Next Bit Should Be Spent Globally
title_zh: 大语言模型量化损伤的结构特征：为何额外比特资源应全局分配
authors: Jundong Hu, Shekar Ramachandran
abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is widely used to reduce the cost of serving large language models (LLMs), but its accuracy cost is uneven and is often tuned per model. We study where quantization damage occurs and how to allocate a small additional precision budget. Using causal mixed-precision intervention as ground truth (raise each layer to 8-bit in turn and measure the accuracy it recovers) across 9 open-weight models in 4 architecture families, we test 3 intuitive hypotheses: that quantization damage lives in task circuits, where the model computes, or in weight statistics. None of them predicts which layers benefit from restored precision. Recovery is instead diffuse: for 8 of 9 models, recovering 75% of the gap takes roughly half the layers; the lone exception, Qwen3-8B, is sharply concentrated. At a matched precision budget, spending it globally on finer quantization granularity beats locally repairing the most recoverable layers for all 8 group-128-compatible models (all but OpenLLaMA, whose width rules out group-128), by 21-52 points, including the concentrated Qwen3-8B. We report 2 secondary findings: the residual is budget-limited (8-bit is near-lossless in our evaluation across RTN, GPTQ, and AWQ), and the location of peak recovery correlates with architecture within a family, though not across families. Within this budget setting, global granularity is a better default than selectively protecting critical layers. More broadly, cheap signals that correlate with quantization damage do not necessarily identify where restoring precision improves accuracy; this must be tested with causal intervention.
summary_zh: 训练后量化（PTQ）被广泛用于降低大语言模型的推理服务成本，但量化带来的精度损失分布并不均匀，通常需要针对每个模型单独调优。本文研究量化损伤的发生位置，以及如何分配少量额外精度预算。本文以因果混合精度干预作为真值（逐层将每一层提升为8位精度，测量其可恢复的精度），在4个架构系列共9个开源权重模型上验证3个直观假设：量化损伤存在于任务计算回路中、存在于模型计算位置、或与权重统计特性相关，但三个假设都无法预测哪些层可从精度恢复中获益。精度恢复的分布是分散的：9个模型中有8个仅需激活约一半的层即可恢复75%的精度损失，唯一例外的Qwen3-8B的精度恢复位置高度集中。在相同精度预算下，对所有支持group-128量化的8个模型（除OpenLLaMA外，其模型宽度不支持group-128）全局提升量化粒度的效果优于局部修复最具恢复潜力的层，性能提升幅度达21-52个点，该结论同样适用于精度恢复位置集中的Qwen3-8B。本文还报告两项次要发现：量化精度损失的剩余空间受预算限制（在RTN、GPTQ、AWQ三种量化方案的评估中，8位量化几乎无损），且在同一架构系列内，精度恢复峰值的位置与架构特性相关，但跨系列不存在该相关性。在该预算设置下，全局粒度量化是比选择性保护关键层更优的默认方案。更广泛地说，与量化损伤相关的廉价信号不一定能定位到恢复精度即可提升性能的位置，这类问题必须通过因果干预实验验证。

title: Gradient-Update Mismatch: Rethinking Conflict-Free Training of Physics-Informed Neural Networks
title_zh: 梯度更新失配：对物理信息神经网络（Physics-Informed Neural Networks, PINNs）无冲突训练的再思考
authors: Jing Xiao, Xinhai Chen, Qinglin Wang, Menghan Jia, Zhiquan Lai 等 (8 人)
abstract: Training Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) requires jointly optimizing physics residual and initial/boundary condition loss terms, which often induce conflicting gradients. Gradient surgery methods mitigate this issue by constructing directions from loss-specific gradients to reduce conflict before optimizer transformation. However, even when the constructed direction is conflict-free, this property may not be preserved after optimizer transformation. Let $a_t$ denote the direction constructed by gradient surgery, $u_t$ the optimizer proposal, and $\mathcal{C}_t$ the conflict-free cone induced by the loss-specific gradients. We show that modern optimizers can transform $a_t$ through mechanisms such as historical state, adaptive scaling, preconditioning, or decoupled weight decay, so $a_t \in \mathcal{C}_t$ does not generally imply $u_t \in \mathcal{C}_t$. We refer to this optimizer-induced discrepancy in conflict-freeness between $a_t$ and $u_t$ as Gradient-Update Mismatch (GUM). Accordingly, we propose Gradient-Update Alignment (GUA), which projects $u_t$ onto $\mathcal{C}_t$ to obtain the aligned update $p_t$ and applies $p_t$ to the parameters. When the optimizer maintains internal state, GUA further adjusts this state toward targets reconstructed from the applied update. We conduct extensive experiments and find that GUM is widespread across momentum, adaptive, and curvature-based optimizers, with conflict rates reaching up to 86.3%. Across all PINN settings, GUA achieves conflict-free applied updates and consistently improves various gradient surgery methods, reducing the relative $L_2$ error by up to 98.2% in individual settings. Data and code are available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 训练物理信息神经网络（PINNs）需要联合优化物理残差项与初始/边界条件损失项，该过程往往会产生冲突梯度。梯度手术（Gradient surgery）方法通过构建面向特定损失的梯度方向来减少优化器变换前的冲突，以此缓解该问题。然而，即便构建的方向本身是无冲突的，该属性在经过优化器变换后也可能无法保留。设$a_t$为梯度手术构建的方向，$u_t$为优化器输出的更新方向，$\mathcal{C}_t$为特定损失梯度诱导的无冲突锥。本文证明，现代优化器可通过历史状态、自适应缩放、预条件化或解耦权重衰减等机制对$a_t$进行变换，因此$a_t \in \mathcal{C}_t$通常无法推导出$u_t \in \mathcal{C}_t$。我们将这种由优化器导致的$a_t$与$u_t$之间无冲突性的差异定义为梯度更新失配（Gradient-Update Mismatch, GUM）。据此，本文提出梯度更新对齐（Gradient-Update Alignment, GUA）方法，该方法将$u_t$投影到$\mathcal{C}_t$中得到对齐后的更新$p_t$，并将$p_t$应用于网络参数。当优化器维护内部状态时，GUA还会根据已应用的更新重构目标，对内部状态进行进一步调整。大量实验结果表明，GUM在动量类、自适应类和基于曲率的优化器中广泛存在，冲突率最高可达86.3%。在所有PINN设置下，GUA均可实现无冲突的应用更新，持续改进各类梯度手术方法的效果，在部分设置中可将相对$L_2$误差最高降低98.2%。相关数据和代码可通过对应公开链接获取。

title: NashDreamer: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning for Zero-Sum Imperfect-Information Games
title_zh: NashDreamer：面向零和不完全信息博弈的基于模型强化学习方法
authors: Tomáš Holeček, Viliam Lisý
abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) has achieved remarkable results in single-agent domains, yet its extension to competitive imperfect information games (IIGs) remains underexplored. In multi-agent settings, opponent-induced non-stationarity complicates the learning process, and decentralized model learning faces severe identifiability barriers, which we argue make centralized model learning a mathematical necessity. Building on this analysis, we propose NashDreamer, a principled MBRL framework for two-player zero-sum IIGs. It introduces a centralized Multi-Agent Recurrent State-Space Model (MARSSM) that decouples environment dynamics from the effect of players' strategies on their individual observations. NashDreamer is designed to use arbitrary policy gradient algorithms and inherits their convergence guarantees towards Nash equilibria under an idealized model. Empirical evaluations across four benchmark games demonstrate that NashDreamer substantially improves sample efficiency over model-free baselines early in the training. Finally, we theoretically analyze the architecture's optimization landscape, identifying the vulnerability of the Dreamer family of algorithms to posterior collapse in stochastic environments. We leave it as an open challenge.
summary_zh: 基于模型的强化学习（Model-based reinforcement learning, MBRL）在单智能体场景中取得了优异效果，但其在竞争性不完全信息博弈（Imperfect Information Games, IIGs）中的扩展仍有待深入探索。在多智能体场景下，对手行为导致的非平稳性会使学习过程复杂化，而分布式模型学习面临严重的可识别性障碍，本文论证这一问题使得中心化模型学习成为数学层面的必要选择。基于该分析，本文提出面向双人零和IIGs的原则性MBRL框架NashDreamer。该框架引入中心化多智能体循环状态空间模型（Multi-Agent Recurrent State-Space Model, MARSSM），将环境动力学与玩家策略对各自观测的影响解耦。NashDreamer支持接入任意策略梯度算法，在理想模型条件下可继承算法向纳什均衡收敛的保证。在4个基准博弈上的实证评估结果表明，相较于无模型基线方法，NashDreamer在训练早期的样本效率有显著提升。最后，本文从理论层面分析了该架构的优化景观，指出Dreamer系列算法在随机环境中易出现后验坍缩的固有缺陷，将该问题留作后续开放挑战。

title: Variable Selection for Feature-Based Newsvendor
title_zh: 面向特征驱动报童模型的变量选择方法
authors: Zhaoliang Yuan, Jie Wang
abstract: Feature-based newsvendor models use observable covariates to tailor inventory decisions, aiming to balance holding and shortage costs under demand uncertainty. However, high-dimensional feature sets often hinder interpretability and inflate data collection and implementation costs. This paper studies variable selection for the feature-based newsvendor problem under a hard cardinality constraint on the number of selected features. We formulate the resulting $\ell_0$-constrained empirical newsvendor problem with $\ell_2$-regularization, establish its computational hardness, and develop a mixed-integer second-order cone programming reformulation that strengthens the standard Big-$M$ formulation. To enable scalability beyond exact optimization, we develop a randomized-rounding algorithm with a bi-criteria guarantee and a greedy heuristic. Statistically, we provide theoretical analysis of the resulting sparse policy estimator, including finite-sample estimation error, out-of-sample risk bounds, and support recovery guarantees. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real data illustrate the computational and statistical trade-offs among various baselines. Our results demonstrate that the proposed variable selection framework achieves competitive out-of-sample operational costs while using substantially fewer covariates.
summary_zh: 基于特征的报童模型利用可观测协变量定制库存决策，旨在需求不确定的场景下平衡持有成本与缺货成本。但高维特征集往往会降低模型可解释性，同时大幅提升数据采集与落地成本。本文针对选中特征数量存在严格基数约束的场景，研究特征驱动报童问题的变量选择方法。本文构建带$\ell_2$正则化的$\ell_0$约束经验报童问题，证明其计算复杂度为NP难，并提出一种混合整数二阶锥规划重构方法，对标准Big-M公式进行了强化。为了在精确优化之外实现更高的可扩展性，本文进一步提出具备双准则保证的随机舍入算法与贪心启发式算法。统计层面，本文对得到的稀疏策略估计器开展理论分析，给出了有限样本估计误差、样本外风险边界以及支持恢复保证。在合成数据与真实数据上开展的大量实验对比了各类基线方法的计算与统计权衡，结果表明，本文提出的变量选择框架仅使用远少于对比方法的协变量，即可获得极具竞争力的样本外运营成本表现。

title: Quantum Sparse Autoencoders for Q-Matrix Estimation in Cognitive Diagnosis
title_zh: 面向认知诊断中Q矩阵估计的量子稀疏自编码器
authors: Arif Hassan Zidan, Yi Pan, Bowen Guo, Xiang Li, Yu Bao 等 (8 人)
abstract: Q-matrices play a central role in cognitive diagnosis within educational data mining (EDM), specifying which latent skills each assessment item requires. Data-driven Q-matrix estimation remains challenging when assessments involve many correlated skills and when real response patterns depart from idealized generative assumptions. We introduce a novel quantum sparse autoencoder (QSAE) for Q-matrix estimation, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first application of quantum machine learning (QML) to cognitive diagnosis. Overall, the QSAE embeds each student's binary response vector into a quantum circuit using an encoder, compresses it into a sparse latent representation, and maps that representation to the Q-matrix. We benchmark the QSAE against a classical autoencoder (CAE) across 60 simulated datasets and 9 real-world assessment datasets. The results reveal complementary strengths. Although the CAE partially achieves higher average accuracy under several simulation conditions, the QSAE is substantially more stable across replications, exhibiting lower variance in 49 of the 60 conditions. Moreover, on real assessment data, the QSAE outperforms the CAE on 6 of the 9 datasets. These findings suggest that the principal advancement of QML in this setting is not universal accuracy improvement, but enhanced robustness and capability to explore latent-structure complexity in real datasets.
summary_zh: Q矩阵是教育数据挖掘（Educational Data Mining, EDM）领域认知诊断的核心要素，用于明确每道测评题目所需的潜在技能。当测评涉及大量关联技能、且真实作答模式偏离理想生成假设时，数据驱动的Q矩阵估计仍面临极大挑战。本文提出一种用于Q矩阵估计的新型量子稀疏自编码器（Quantum Sparse Autoencoder, QSAE），据我们所知，这是量子机器学习（Quantum Machine Learning, QML）在认知诊断领域的首次应用。整体架构中，QSAE首先通过编码器将每名学生的二元作答向量嵌入量子电路，将其压缩为稀疏潜在表示，再将该表示映射得到Q矩阵。本文在60个模拟数据集和9个真实测评数据集上将QSAE与经典自编码器（Classical Autoencoder, CAE）进行基准对比，结果显示两类方法具备互补优势：尽管在部分模拟条件下CAE的平均准确率更高，但QSAE在多次重复实验中的稳定性显著更强，60个条件中有49个的方差更低。此外在真实测评数据上，QSAE在9个数据集中的6个上表现优于CAE。上述结果表明，该场景下量子机器学习的核心优势并非普遍提升准确率，而是增强鲁棒性，以及提升对真实数据集潜在结构复杂度的探索能力。

title: Sierpiński--Knopp Wasserstein Distance for Persistence Diagrams and Applications to 2-Wasserstein Approximation
title_zh: 用于持续图的Sierpiński-Knopp（SK）瓦瑟斯坦距离及其在2-瓦瑟斯坦近似中的应用
authors: Sebastien Tchitchek, Julien Tierny
abstract: This paper introduces the Sierpiński-Knopp (SK) Wasserstein distance, a fast metric between persistence diagrams. The SK-Wasserstein distance, denoted $d_{\mathrm{SK}}$, maps diagram points and their diagonal projections to the unit interval via the Sierpiński-Knopp space-filling curve on the upper diagonal triangle. The encoded point sets are then efficiently matched via one-dimensional optimal assignment, in \(O(N\log N)\) steps, yielding an explicit diagonal-aware point assignment between the two input persistence diagrams. We show that the SK-Wasserstein distance controls the classical \(2\)-Wasserstein distance between diagrams, admits an explicit isometric embedding into a Hilbert space, and induces a positive-definite Gaussian kernel, making the resulting geometry directly compatible with Euclidean and kernel-based learning methods. A tighter surrogate dissimilarity, noted \(W_\Gamma\), is also introduced based on the point assignments along the curve. Experiments on 12 scientific collections comprising 227 diagrams show median per-collection speedup of \(d_{\mathrm{SK}}\) over state-of-the-art approximations of \(W_2\) is \(626\times\), while the aggregate speedup over the full benchmark is \(2100\times\). Average-linkage partitions obtained from \(d_{\mathrm{SK}}\) and \(W_\Gamma\) each exactly match the corresponding \(W_2\) partition on 8 of the 12 collections. Hilbert \(k\)-means and Gaussian spectral clustering, both based on \(d_{\mathrm{SK}}\), achieve mean adjusted Rand indices (ARI) of \(0.756\) and \(0.800\), respectively, with respect to the benchmark reference partitions, compared to \(0.750\) obtained by average linkage on \(W_2\). The Gaussian \(d_{\mathrm{SK}}\) kernel supports other kernel-based analysis tasks, as illustrated by its use for contiguous segmentation of ordered diagram collections in our experiments.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种适用于持续图的快速度量：Sierpiński-Knopp（SK）瓦瑟斯坦距离，记为$d_{\mathrm{SK}}$。该方法通过上对角三角形上的Sierpiński-Knopp空间填充曲线，将持续图点及其对角线投影映射到单位区间，随后通过一维最优分配以$O(N\log N)$的复杂度对编码后的点集进行高效匹配，得到两个输入持续图之间显式的、考虑对角线的点分配结果。本文证明，SK瓦瑟斯坦距离可以控制持续图之间的经典2-瓦瑟斯坦距离，支持显式等距嵌入到希尔伯特空间，且可诱导出正定高斯核，因此其对应的几何结构可直接兼容欧氏学习方法与核学习方法。本文还基于沿曲线的点分配结果，引入了更紧的代理相异度度量$W_\Gamma$。在包含227张持续图的12个科学数据集上开展的实验表明，$d_{\mathrm{SK}}$相较于当前最优的$W_2$近似方法，单数据集的中位加速比可达626倍，全基准集的总体加速比可达2100倍。基于$d_{\mathrm{SK}}$和$W_\Gamma$得到的平均链接聚类结果，在12个数据集中各有8个与对应的$W_2$聚类结果完全一致。基于$d_{\mathrm{SK}}$的希尔伯特k均值与高斯谱聚类方法，相对于基准参考聚类的平均调整兰德指数（ARI）分别为0.756和0.800，优于基于$W_2$的平均链接方法得到的0.750。高斯$d_{\mathrm{SK}}$核还可支持其他核分析任务，实验中我们将其用于有序持续图集的连续分割，验证了其可用性。

title: Diffusion as a Training Curriculum for Timestep-Free Iterative Reasoning
title_zh: 将扩散模型作为无时间步迭代推理的训练课程
authors: Mariia Drozdova, Aidan Sirbu, Pietro Miotti, Robert Obryk, Mayalen Etcheverry 等 (7 人)
abstract: Diffusion models and recursive reasoners are both iterative, but they carry information across iterations differently. We add a persistent hidden state to a diffusion denoiser and remove its timestep conditioning, leaving a single shared update that can be run to arbitrary depth. The result is an anytime solver: accuracy keeps improving with inference depth far beyond the rollout lengths and backpropagation window used in training, reaching 99.90% exact solve on Sudoku-Extreme. We also obtain 98.93% solve rate on Maze-Unique. Surprisingly, progressive denoising is unnecessary at inference: holding corruption at its maximum by replacing every non-clue variable with fresh Gaussian noise at each step retains near-perfect solving and converges to stable solutions. This simple noise-injection mechanism enables a single trajectory to efficiently explore the solution space and settle on the correct answer without parallel rollouts, candidate selection, or external verifiers required by prior reasoning models. Nonetheless, ordered annealed corruption remains critical during training, which suggests that diffusion's primary contribution to our anytime solver is not a sampling procedure at inference, but a denoising training curriculum.
summary_zh: 扩散模型与递归推理器均属于迭代式架构，但二者在迭代间传递信息的机制存在显著差异。本文在扩散去噪器中添加持久隐藏状态，移除其时间步条件，仅保留单个共享更新单元，该单元可运行至任意深度。最终得到的任意时间求解器具备如下特性：即便推理深度远超过训练时使用的 rollout 长度与反向传播窗口，准确率仍会随推理深度持续提升，在极端数独数据集（Sudoku-Extreme）上的精确求解率可达99.90%，在唯一迷宫数据集（Maze-Unique）上的求解率可达98.93%。令人意外的是，推理阶段的渐进去噪并非必要：在每一步将所有非线索变量替换为全新高斯噪声，始终保持最大程度的扰动，仍可实现近乎完美的求解，且能收敛到稳定解。这种简单的噪声注入机制可让单条轨迹高效探索解空间，最终得到正确答案，无需现有推理模型所需的并行 rollout、候选选择或外部验证器。尽管如此，训练阶段的有序退火扰动机制仍然至关重要，这表明扩散模型对本文提出的任意时间求解器的核心贡献并非推理阶段的采样流程，而是作为去噪训练课程存在。

title: Edge-Girth as a Structural Edge Feature for Graph Neural Networks
title_zh: 作为图神经网络结构边特征的边围长
authors: Lilian Marey, Charlotte Laclau
abstract: Graph neural networks (GNN) based on message passing are provably no more powerful than the one-dimensional Weisfeiler--Leman colour-refinement test (1-WL): two graphs it cannot tell apart receive identical representations, however deep or wide the network. A common remedy augments node or edge features with precomputed structural descriptors, most often counts of a fixed small subgraph such as triangles or longer cycles, but such counts require committing in advance to the size of the substructure counted, a choice usually made blind to the data. We study a descriptor that avoids this choice. The edge-girth of an edge is the length of a shortest cycle through it, and its multiplicity is the number of such shortest cycles; together they form a per-edge invariant that reports cycles of arbitrary length, computable exactly by a single breadth-first search per edge. Injected into a gated message-passing architecture, EGAGNN, it reaches a test MAE a factor three below the closest gated comparator on the ZINC-12k regression benchmark at 104k parameters; against bounded cycle-counting descriptors under the same architecture, it matches only a dictionary counting cycles up to length eight, using twice as many channels, while a dictionary capped at length four performs no better than no structural information at all. On graph discrimination we prove a matching limitation: on graphs where every edge sees the same number of shortest cycles of the same length, the descriptor becomes constant and any model built on it collapses back to the 1-WL bound. This holds without exception across all 400 pairs of the BREC benchmark: not one of the 90 such pairs is distinguished.
summary_zh: 现有基于消息传递的图神经网络（Graph Neural Networks, GNN）已被证明其表达能力不会超过一维Weisfeiler--Leman颜色细化测试（1-WL）：对于该测试无法区分的两张图，无论网络的深度和宽度多大，得到的表示都完全相同。常见的改进思路是为节点或边特征补充预计算的结构描述符，最常用的是三角形或更长环等固定小型子图的计数，但这类计数方法需要提前指定待计数子结构的大小，该选择通常无法结合数据特性进行优化。本文研究了一种可避免该选择的描述符：边的边围长指的是经过该边的最短环的长度，对应的多重度指的是这类最短环的数量，二者共同构成了边级不变量，可表征任意长度的环，且每条边仅需一次广度优先搜索即可精确计算。将该描述符注入门控消息传递架构EGAGNN后，在ZINC-12k回归基准上仅使用104k参数，得到的测试平均绝对误差（MAE）比性能最接近的门控对比方法低三倍；在相同架构下与有界环计数描述符对比，其表现与通道数为自身两倍、最多计数到长度为8的环的字典相当，而最多计数到长度为4的环的字典的表现与不使用任何结构信息的基线没有差异。针对图区分任务，本文证明了该描述符的对应局限性：当图中所有边经过的最短环长度相同、且对应最短环的数量也相同时，该描述符将变为常量，基于其构建的任何模型的表达能力都会回落至1-WL的边界。该结论在BREC基准的全部400对测试图上完全成立：其中90对满足上述条件的测试图没有一对可以被该描述符区分。

title: TRIAGE: Three-level Routing and Intelligent Agent Guidance for Efficient Execution
