Under a common Weibull shape, a Bayes' rule has at most one positive decision boundary, which is unique when the rule is nonconstant; under unequal shapes, it can have two. We characterise these decision regions, derive the Fisher information for the classifier after adjustment for nuisance parameters in the missingness model, and obtain a decision-boundary expansion of the expected error rate of the plug-in sample rule relative to the Bayes error. The expansion yields classification-specific asymptotic relative efficiency formulas for the one- and two-boundary cases and shows that a positive-definite increase in Fisher information is sufficient, but not necessary, for a smaller first-order expected error rate. Numerical studies and a semi-synthetic analysis based on hard-drive failure data illustrate potential reductions in expected error rate and improvements in decision-boundary estimation from modelling feature-dependent label missingness.
summary_zh: 本文研究基于双分量威布尔混合生成的部分分类样本的半监督分类问题：所有数据的特征均已观测，但部分类标签存在缺失。研究将标签缺失概率建模为分类不确定性的函数，得到与威布尔混合分类器共享参数的特征依赖随机缺失（Missing At Random, MAR）机制。因此，除观测特征和可用类标签外，缺失标签指示符也可提供关于分类器的额外信息。在威布尔形状参数相同的条件下，贝叶斯决策规则最多存在一个正决策边界，当规则为非常数时该边界唯一；在形状参数不等的条件下，贝叶斯决策规则可存在两个正决策边界。本文对这类决策区域进行了特征刻画，在调整缺失模型中的冗余参数后推导了分类器的费希尔信息，并得到了插件样本规则的期望误差率相对于贝叶斯误差的决策边界展开式。该展开式给出了单边界和双边界场景下分类任务专属的渐近相对效率公式，证明费希尔信息的正定增长是一阶期望误差率减小的充分非必要条件。基于硬盘故障数据的数值研究和半合成分析表明，对特征依赖的标签缺失进行建模可有效降低期望误差率，提升决策边界估计精度。

title: Frozen Cores Need Task Signal: Fisher-Whitened Cross-Covariance for Low-Resource LLM Adaptation
title_zh: 冻结核心需要任务信号：用于低资源大语言模型适配的费希尔白化互协方差方法
authors: Wentao Ye, Zhanming Shen, Zhiqing Xiao, Yao Ding, Haobo Wang 等 (6 人)
abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning is usually framed as a question of how many parameters to update. Under a severe trainable-state budget, however, where those coefficients act is equally consequential. We study this choice through frozen-core adaptation: a calibration pass fixes left and right bases for each weight matrix, and fine-tuning optimizes only an $r\times r$ core. This removes the ability of trainable factors to repair a poor initial span and makes subspace quality directly observable. We introduce FCCA, which estimates the signed input--error cross-covariance, whitens it with diagonal Fisher moments, truncates it in the resulting local metric, maps the selected directions back, and applies thin QR to obtain stable core coordinates. Under a matched $r^2$ budget, we compare eight basis constructors on 11 tasks, four model settings, and three seeds. On Qwen2.5-3B, FCCA reaches an 83.0 macro-average, 2.3 points above the next-best matched-budget constructor, and exceeds its unwhitened RawGrad control on all 11 tasks. It ranks first at all three Qwen scales and finishes within 0.13 points of the best method on Llama-3.2-1B. Controlled ablations show gains of 2.7--17.2 points from whitening and identify QR as necessary for stable core optimization in the tested regime. Finally, FCCA comes within 0.32 and 0.23 average points of LoRA and DoRA while optimizing 36.9K rather than roughly 7.4M parameters. These results show that a carefully selected fixed span can recover most of the benefit of movable low-rank factors at a much smaller trainable and optimizer-state cost.
summary_zh: 参数高效微调通常聚焦于需要更新的参数量选择问题，但在可训练状态预算极其有限的场景下，可训练系数的作用位置同样至关重要。本文通过冻结核心适配范式开展相关研究：在校准阶段为每个权重矩阵固定左右基，微调阶段仅优化一个r×r的核心矩阵。该范式消除了可训练因子修复不良初始张成空间的能力，使得子空间质量可被直接观测。本文提出FCCA方法，该方法可估计带符号的输入-误差互协方差，使用对角费希尔矩对其进行白化，在得到的局部度量下进行截断，将选中的方向映射回原空间，再通过薄QR分解得到稳定的核心坐标。在匹配的r²预算下，研究在11项任务、4种模型设置、3种随机种子下对8种基构造器进行了对比。在Qwen2.5-3B模型上，FCCA的宏平均精度达到83.0，比同预算下的次优构造器高出2.3个百分点，且在全部11项任务上的表现均优于未白化的RawGrad对照组。该方法在全部三个Qwen模型规模上均排名第一，在Llama-3.2-1B模型上的表现与最优方法的差距仅为0.13个百分点。受控消融实验表明，白化操作可带来2.7~17.2个百分点的性能提升，同时验证了QR分解是该场景下核心优化保持稳定的必要条件。最终，FCCA仅需优化36.9K参数（远低于LoRA和DoRA所需的约7.4M参数），其平均性能与LoRA、DoRA的差距分别仅为0.32和0.23个百分点。上述结果表明，精心选择的固定张成空间可在远低于可训练参数和优化器状态成本的前提下，复现可移动低秩因子带来的绝大多数性能收益。

title: How Do Language Models Choose Between Context and Memory?
title_zh: 语言模型如何在上下文和记忆之间做出选择？
authors: Benjamin Shih, John Winnicki, Arianna Cao
abstract: When contextual information conflicts with the knowledge stored in model parameters, activation directions can be used to decode and steer which source the model follows. However, steering along a direction does not establish causality: whether the unedited model would naturally use that direction or whether the direction is reusable across tasks. We test these distinctions through counterfactual experiments in unambiguous settings. First, we estimate authority directions from agreement prompts, in which the context and parametric knowledge support the same answer. We then interchange naturally occurring coordinates along these directions between matched prompts that direct the model to prioritize either the supplied context or its parametric knowledge. Across Qwen, Llama, and OLMo models, this intervention reproduces 30-68% of the authority-induced shift in source choice, whereas matched controls reproduce almost none. To test cross-task reuse, we learn authority directions on two tasks separately and see that cross-task transferability closes only 9% of the authority gap while the local direction learned on the given task closes 57%. These results distinguish authority representation, causal use, and cross-task causal reuse, and suggest that authority computations may be task-dependent, rather than reusable across tasks.
summary_zh: 当上下文信息与模型参数中存储的知识发生冲突时，可通过激活方向解码和引导模型选择遵循的信息来源。但沿特定方向的引导无法建立因果关系：无法确认未编辑的原始模型是否会自然使用该方向，也无法确认该方向是否可跨任务复用。本文通过在明确场景下开展反事实实验对上述问题进行验证：首先从一致性提示中估计权威方向，这类提示中的上下文和参数化知识支持相同答案；随后在匹配的提示之间交换沿这些方向的自然坐标，引导模型优先选择提供的上下文或自身的参数化知识。在Qwen、Llama和OLMo系列模型上，该干预操作可复现30%~68%的权威诱导来源选择偏移，而匹配对照组几乎无法复现任何偏移。为测试跨任务复用性，研究在两个独立任务上分别学习权威方向，发现跨任务迁移仅能弥合9%的权威差距，而在当前任务上学习的局部方向可弥合57%的权威差距。上述结果明确区分了权威表征、因果使用和跨任务因果复用三类概念，表明权威计算可能具有任务依赖性，无法跨任务通用。

title: Text Capability Loss in Vision-Language Adaptation: An Attention-Sink Diagnosis
title_zh: 视觉-语言适配中的文本能力损失：基于Attention-Sink（注意力沉底）的诊断
authors: Minsik Choi, Geewook Kim, Young Geun Kim
abstract: Fine-tuning a pretrained LLM into a vision-language model (VLM) can erode the backbone's text capability, with the damage concentrated on tasks that require following exact output rules, such as instruction following, chain-of-thought reasoning graded on a strictly parsed final answer, and similar evaluations with strict graders. We trace this gap to attention-sink corruption: VL fine-tuning perturbs the early sink position that anchors a large fraction of attention probability, and how well the base LLM preserves its sink tracks how much of the affected capability survives adaptation. Building on this view, we introduce Sink Strength, a single scalar computed on the base LLM in a few seconds on a single GPU that predicts post-VL degradation without any VL training. It consistently tracks relative degradation across the six VLM-LLM pairs and multiple format-sensitive tasks. Complementing this diagnostic, we find that post-pretraining QK-RMSNorm injection fails to reproduce the protection of native QK-RMSNorm, while several off-the-shelf weight-merging settings fail to recover the lost capability after VL training. These negative results underscore the value of screening backbones with Sink Strength before VL training and narrow the intervention space toward head-selective training-time protection.
summary_zh: 将预训练大语言模型（LLM）微调为视觉语言模型（VLM）的过程会损害骨干网络的文本能力，这类损伤集中出现在需要遵循严格输出规则的任务中，例如指令遵循、以严格解析最终答案为评分标准的思维链推理，以及其他采用严格评分器的评估任务。本研究将该能力缺口归因于Attention-Sink（注意力沉底）损坏：视觉语言微调会扰动锚定大部分注意力概率的早期沉底位置，基础大语言模型对该沉底结构的保留程度直接决定了适配过程中上述受影响能力的留存比例。基于该结论，本文提出Sink Strength（沉底强度）指标：仅需在单张GPU上花费数秒即可在基础大语言模型上计算得到的标量值，无需任何视觉语言训练即可预测模型在视觉语言适配后的能力退化程度。该指标可稳定表征6组VLM-LLM配对模型在多个格式敏感任务上的相对退化程度。除该诊断方法外，研究还发现预训练后注入QK-RMSNorm（查询-键均方根层归一化）无法复刻原生QK-RMSNorm的保护效果，多种现有权重合并方案也无法恢复视觉语言训练后损失的文本能力。这些负面结果凸显了在视觉语言训练前使用Sink Strength筛选骨干模型的价值，同时将干预方向缩小到面向注意力头的选择性训练时保护策略。

title: Online Self-Weighted Fine-Tuning
title_zh: 在线自权重微调
authors: Haiquan Wen, Yiwei He, Bei Peng, Guangliang Cheng
abstract: Standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) assigns the same explicit loss weight to every expert demonstration, regardless of the model's changing competence over training queries. Reinforcement learning (RL) based methods adapt update strength using model-generated rollouts, but often require substantially more sampling and can be unstable on hard tasks. We propose \textbf{Online Self-Weighted Fine-Tuning (OSW-FT)}, a simple method that augments SFT with online, trajectory-level weighting. For each query, OSW-FT estimates the model's current success rate using a small number of inference-only rollouts and rescales the standard SFT loss accordingly. The optimization direction remains anchored to the expert trajectory, while the update magnitude adapts online. For binary-verifiable reasoning, we connect this weighting to SFT and RL at the gradient level, inspired by variance-reduction principles. The resulting estimator is unbiased for the exact OSW-FT surrogate update for any finite rollout count, and we analyze convergence with respect to the corresponding surrogate objective. Evaluated across Qwen3 series ranging from 0.6B to 4B on multiple challenging benchmarks (e.g., AIME), OSW-FT consistently improves over SFT on small-to-medium scale models. OSW-FT offers a favorable compute-performance trade-off as a practical approach for fine-tuning small-to-medium LLMs on binary-verifiable reasoning tasks with only \textbf{2 online rollouts}.
summary_zh: 标准监督微调（SFT）会为每条专家演示分配相同的显式损失权重，完全不考虑模型在训练查询过程中不断变化的能力水平。基于强化学习（RL）的方法可通过模型生成的轨迹自适应调整更新强度，但通常需要多得多的采样量，且在困难任务上容易出现不稳定问题。本文提出Online Self-Weighted Fine-Tuning (OSW-FT，在线自权重微调)：一种在SFT基础上增加轨迹级在线加权的简单方法。针对每一条查询，OSW-FT仅通过少量仅推理的轨迹估计模型当前的成功率，据此对标准SFT损失进行重缩放。该方法的优化方向始终锚定专家轨迹，同时更新幅度可在线自适应调整。针对可二元验证的推理任务，受方差缩减原则启发，本文在梯度层面建立了该加权机制与SFT、RL的关联。最终得到的估计量对于任意有限轨迹数下的精确OSW-FT代理更新都是无偏的，本文还针对对应的代理目标分析了算法的收敛性。在参数规模从0.6B到4B的Qwen3系列模型上的多个挑战性基准（例如AIME）评估结果显示，OSW-FT在中小规模模型上的表现始终优于SFT。OSW-FT仅需2次在线轨迹采样，即可在可二元验证推理任务上微调中小规模LLM，是一种兼具计算效率与性能优势的实用方案。

title: MaskCode: Mask Transformer for Feedback-Assisted Coding With Linear Block Codes
title_zh: MaskCode：面向线性分组码反馈辅助编码的掩码Transformer
authors: Jonggyu Jang, Hongjae Nam, Vishrant Tripathi, David J. Love, Hyun Jong Yang
abstract: Feedback-based coding schemes have demonstrated substantial performance gains over today's open-loop coding schemes. Unfortunately, these gains are usually achieved in idealized settings with perfect feedback. Over the last few years, machine learning-based schemes have been shown to be promising solutions for implementing feedback-based codes, particularly when combined with short-block-length open-loop error correcting codes (ECCs) in a concatenated coding structure. However, existing ML-based feedback schemes remain agnostic to the outer code's structure, potentially misallocating feedback resources on error patterns already correctable by the outer ECC. To address this, we propose MaskCode, a Transformer-based inner feedback code for concatenated coding systems, which explicitly incorporates structural knowledge of the outer linear block code into the inner feedback encoder design via two synergistic mechanisms: 1) a soft syndrome-based input that informs the encoder about potential parity constraint violations, and 2) a code-aware attention mask derived from the Tanner graph. We further show that end-to-end training with a differentiable belief propagation (BP) decoder offers no additional gain, as MaskCode's structure-aware design already internalizes the structural knowledge of the outer code; in fact, backpropagation through the iterative BP decoder introduces gradient explosion, which degrades rather than improves performance. Extensive evaluations on BCH and LDPC outer codes demonstrate that MaskCode consistently outperforms all baselines, achieving up to 1.5 dB SNR gain.
summary_zh: 基于反馈的编码方案相比当前的开环编码方案已展现出显著的性能提升，但这类增益通常仅在具备完美反馈的理想场景下才能实现。近年来，基于机器学习的方案被证明是实现反馈编码的极具潜力的解决方案，尤其是将其与短块长开环纠错码（ECC）结合为级联编码结构时效果更突出。但现有基于机器学习的反馈方案完全不感知外码的结构，可能将反馈资源错误地分配给外纠错码本身就可以纠正的错误模式，造成资源浪费。为解决该问题，本文提出MaskCode：面向级联编码系统的基于Transformer的内反馈码，通过两种协同机制将外层线性分组码的结构知识显式融入内反馈编码器设计：1）基于软伴随式的输入，向编码器传递潜在的奇偶校验违规信息；2）从Tanner图推导得到的码感知注意力掩码。本文进一步证明，搭配可微置信传播（BP）解码器的端到端训练无法带来额外增益，因为MaskCode的结构感知设计已经内化了外码的全部结构知识；事实上，通过迭代BP解码器的反向传播会引入梯度爆炸问题，反而会降低而非提升性能。在外码为BCH和LDPC的大量评估实验中，MaskCode的表现始终优于所有基线方法，最高可实现1.5dB的信噪比增益。

title: Prediction-Assisted Pricing and Admission for LLM APIs with Stochastic Token Consumption
title_zh: 面向令牌消耗随机的LLM API的预测辅助定价与准入机制
authors: Patrick Wong
abstract: An LLM application often sells or internally allocates several service products: a small or premium model, a short or long token cap, and possibly multiple posted prices. The operational decision is not merely which model answers a prompt. A price changes purchase probability, a token cap changes both user value and the tail of resource consumption, and accepted requests compete for shared compute and premium-model capacity. Demand and output length are initially uncertain, while an offline model may provide useful but imperfect predictions.We formulate sequential pricing and admission with stochastic resource consumption. Each arriving request belongs to an observable segment. The platform chooses a product--price pair or makes no offer; purchase, revenue, and resource use are then random. An offline predictor supplies a uniform, validated error radius for every segment--product cell. We propose Prediction-Clipped UCB (PCUCB), which intersects the offline prediction interval with an online confidence interval, evaluates products using resource shadow prices, and reserves a sample-path envelope before commitment. The prior gives a fast start when accurate, while online learning protects the platform when predictions are coarse.The analysis is modular. On a simultaneous confidence event, regret against a buffered fluid benchmark is bounded by a pacing term plus the cumulative diameter of the intersected intervals. For $J$ segment-product cells and prediction radius $\varepsilon$, this yields \[\widetilde O\left(\sqrt{T}+(1+\bar\Lambda)\min\{T\varepsilon,\sqrt{JT}\}\right), \] where $\bar\Lambda$ bounds operational shadow prices. Thus the algorithm smoothly interpolates between an almost full-information regime and learning from scratch. Hard feasibility holds on every sample path through reservation envelopes.
summary_zh: LLM应用通常会售卖或内部分配多种服务产品：小模型或高级模型、短令牌上限或长令牌上限，以及多种挂牌价格。平台的运营决策远不止为提示词分配对应模型这一项：价格会改变用户的购买概率，令牌上限会同时影响用户价值和资源消耗的尾部分布，已接受的请求会竞争共享算力和高级模型的容量。需求和输出长度在初始阶段是不确定的，离线模型可以提供有用但并不完美的预测。本文针对随机资源消耗场景下的序列定价与准入问题建立了形式化模型：每个到达的请求属于一个可观测的分段，平台可以选择产品-价格对或者不提供服务，后续的购买行为、收入和资源使用都是随机变量。离线预测器可以为每个分段-产品单元提供统一的、经过验证的误差半径。本文提出Prediction-Clipped UCB (PCUCB，预测截断上置信界)算法，该算法将离线预测区间与在线置信区间取交集，使用资源影子价格评估产品价值，在做出承诺前预留样本路径包络。当离线预测准确时，先验信息可以让算法快速启动，当预测精度较低时，在线学习机制可以为平台提供保障。本文的分析采用模块化思路：在同步置信事件下，算法相对于带缓冲流体基准的后悔值由一个步长项和交集区间的累积直径共同界定。对于J个分段-产品单元和预测半径ε，该后悔值的上界为\(\widetilde O\left(\sqrt{T}+(1+\bar\Lambda)\min\{T\varepsilon,\sqrt{JT}\}\right)\)，其中\(\bar\Lambda\)是运营影子价格的上界。因此该算法可以在几乎完全信息场景和从零开始学习的场景之间实现平滑过渡，同时通过预留包络保证所有样本路径上的硬可行性约束都成立。

title: Patterning in Practice: Debiasing Reward Models with Susceptibilities
title_zh: 实践中的模式化方法：基于敏感度的奖励模型去偏
authors: George Wang, Elizabeth Donoway, Daniel Murfet
abstract: Reward models trained on human preferences are known to suffer from length, formatting, and other stylistic biases. In this paper we use patterning, which reweights each preference pair according to its measured effect on posterior expectation values of benchmark losses (its susceptibility), to debias a Gemma 2 9B Instruct reward model trained on Skywork-Reward-Preference v0.2. We obtain $+14.2 \pm 1.2$ pp on RM-Bench Hard, the split where style cues point against correctness (mean $\pm$ s.e.\ over 5 seeds), with overall RM-Bench accuracy preserved, comparable to the strongest Hard-split gain reported by the closest published comparator (SteerRM, $+13.2$ pp). We demonstrate in a simple case that the reweighting is interpretable by tracing a side effect of the intervention (a regression on a safety subset of RM-Bench) to a small class of training pairs, which we confirm by ablation. The weights also transfer: those computed on Gemma 2 9B debias Gemma 2 2B and 27B with no recomputation, and transfer partially to Llama 3.1 8B. This is the first application of patterning, a program grounded in singular learning theory, beyond small models and synthetic tasks.
summary_zh: 基于人类偏好训练的奖励模型普遍存在长度、格式以及其他风格类偏差。本文使用模式化（patterning）方法，根据每条偏好对基准损失后验期望值的影响（即其敏感度）对偏好对进行重加权，对基于Skywork-Reward-Preference v0.2数据集训练的Gemma 2 9B Instruct奖励模型进行去偏处理。在风格线索与正确性指向相反的RM-Bench Hard测试集上，模型性能提升了14.2±1.2个百分点（5次随机种子实验的均值±标准误），同时整体RM-Bench准确率保持不变，该提升幅度与已发表的同类最优对比方案SteerRM报告的+13.2个百分点相当。本文通过简单案例证明该重加权机制具备可解释性：将干预带来的副作用（RM-Bench安全子集上的性能下降）追溯到一小部分训练对，并通过消融实验验证了该结论。计算得到的权重还具备可迁移性：在Gemma 2 9B上计算得到的权重无需重新计算即可为Gemma 2 2B和27B去偏，还可以部分迁移到Llama 3.1 8B模型。这是模式化方法（基于奇异学习理论构建的技术框架）首次在小模型和合成任务之外的场景中得到实际应用。

title: MUGEN: Generating Unlearnable Graph Examples for Multiple Learning Tasks
title_zh: 规范双层规划
authors: Ziyan Liu, Chengshuai Zhao, Huan Liu
abstract: Graph data across diverse domains can expose valuable relational information to unauthorized representation learning, creating a pressing need for protection against such misuse. Unlearnable examples offer a data-level defense by perturbing a training release so that models trained on it fail to generalize to clean data. Existing methods generate unlearnable graph examples for only a specified downstream task. Consequently, a release protected against one task may remain learnable for other plausible uses, including node classification, graph classification, and link prediction, which the data owner cannot anticipate. We introduce MUGEN, to our knowledge the first framework for generating unlearnable graph examples that jointly protect all enabled tasks. From one clean dataset, MUGEN produces a single feature-perturbed release that protects every enabled task through a shared GNN encoder and task-specific heads. We devise a Task-Aligned Separability Objective (TASO), which leverages task prediction and classwise separability to strengthen unlearnability and its transfer across GNN backbones and enabled tasks. We further introduce Type-Adaptive Perturbation (TAP), which tailors perturbation optimization to node-attribute type, with direct search over feasible hard flips that accept only loss-improving updates for discrete node attributes and customized gradient-based updates for continuous node features, thereby enabling strong unlearnability across both settings. Experiments across five benchmarks, four backends and three learning paradigms demonstrate that MUGEN generates transferable unlearnable graph examples across GNN backbones and all three tasks, and remains effective under adversarial training and data augmentation.
summary_zh: 双层优化是层级决策问题的自然建模语言，但应用现有数值求解器通常需要大量人工分析和重格式化工作。本文提出disciplined bilevel programming (DBLP，规范双层规划)符号框架，允许用户以接近数学公式的高可读性高层方式指定并求解乐观双层问题。对于上层问题满足规范非线性规则、下层问题为凸且满足规范参数化规划规则的问题，DBLP可以自动将下层问题规范化为锥形式，利用锥形式Karush-Kuhn-Tucker条件构造等价的单层重格式化问题。该框架对得到的互补约束进行松弛，使用间隙连续过程近似求解一系列光滑非线性问题。本文在开源Python包BLVPY中实现了DBLP，该包是CVXPY面向双层规划的扩展。本文通过多个应用领域的一系列双层优化问题验证了BLVPY的建模和求解能力。该框架和实现允许用户仅用几行代码即可指定并求解双层优化问题，无需具备双层建模和数值优化的专业知识。

title: Verdict Instability of OOD Scores under Reference Resampling
title_zh: 参考重采样下OOD分数的判决不稳定性研究
authors: Donghoon Lee, Shinjin Kang
abstract: Post-hoc out-of-distribution detectors are fitted on a finite reference set, so every score they produce is an estimate. If we had chosen a different set, some verdicts would have moved. We measure that movement by resampling the reference set and recording the bootstrap standard deviation of the score, which we call verdict instability. It admits a closed form with no fitted parameters. The instability of a verdict is the within-class dispersion of the assigned class along the query's direction, divided by the square root of that class's reference count. That count is what separates verdict instability from the geometry of the score distribution, and it is identifiable only under class imbalance. Instability grows with the local dispersion. Far-OOD queries lie along the low-variance directions of an anisotropic embedding, so every distance-based score we test assigns its highest values to the verdicts that are most reproducible. Only estimators of local dispersion carry the sign a practitioner expects. We give a rule that predicts this sign for any score from a single label-free correlation, and abstention driven by a wrong-signed score turns out worse than abstention at random on every dataset we test.
summary_zh: 事后离群分布（OOD）检测器是在有限参考集上拟合得到的，因此其输出的每一个分数都是估计值。如果选择不同的参考集，部分判决结果就会发生变化。本文通过重采样参考集、记录分数的自助法标准差来衡量这种变化，将该指标定义为判决不稳定性。该指标存在不含拟合参数的闭式解：判决的不稳定性等于查询样本方向上所属类的分配类内离散度除以该类参考样本数量的平方根。该样本数量将判决不稳定性与分数分布的几何特征区分开，且仅在类别不平衡场景下可识别。不稳定性随局部离散度的增大而升高。远域OOD查询位于各向异性嵌入的低方差方向上，因此本文测试的所有基于距离的分数都会将最高值分配给可复现性最强的判决。只有局部离散度的估计量才能给出从业者预期的符号。本文给出了仅基于单个无标签相关性即可预测任意分数符号的规则，实验证明在所有测试数据集上，基于错误符号分数触发的弃权机制表现甚至比随机弃权更差。

title: HarmoCore: Functional Latent Diffusion for Sparse Reconstruction of Oscillatory Wave Fields
title_zh: HarmoCore：面向振荡波场稀疏重建的函数隐空间扩散模型
authors: Lihao Chen, Xinyu Zhang, Panqi Chen, Lei Cheng, Ting Zhang 等 (7 人)
abstract: Reconstructing oscillatory wave fields from scattered sensors is a severely underdetermined inverse problem. Beyond the challenges of general physical-field reconstruction, wave responses are complex-valued, frequency-sensitive, and highly oscillatory, while costly simulation and sensing often leave only extreme-sparse observations. Existing low-rank, operator, and diffusion approaches are largely designed for real-valued, smoother fields; dense pixel-space diffusion is particularly inefficient for oscillatory complex fields and difficult to scale to 3D. We propose HarmoCore, which places a generative prior in a compact, continuous, and structured wave-field latent. HarmoCore represents joint real--imaginary channels with Functional Tucker cores over shared continuous spatial bases, learns a frequency-conditioned core diffusion prior, and performs Diffusion Posterior Sampling directly in core space. At fixed sensor coordinates, the multilinear decoder induces an explicit likelihood guidance operator, avoiding dense pixel-space correction. Optional target-equation residual guidance further promotes physical consistency. Experiments on 2D Helmholtz, 2D synthetic wave fields, and 3D Helmholtz show substantial gains under 1%--2% sensing while remaining practical in three dimensions.
summary_zh: 从分散传感器重建振荡波场是一个严重欠定的逆问题。除了通用物理场重建面临的挑战之外，波响应还具备复数值、频率敏感、高度振荡的特性，而高昂的仿真和传感成本通常只能提供极端稀疏的观测数据。现有低秩方法、算子方法和扩散方法大多针对实数值、更平滑的场设计，稠密像素空间扩散尤其不适用于振荡复场，且难以扩展到3D场景。本文提出HarmoCore，将生成先验放置在紧凑、连续、结构化的波场隐空间中。HarmoCore通过共享连续空间基上的函数Tucker核表示实部-虚部联合通道，学习频率条件化的核扩散先验，直接在核空间执行扩散后验采样。在固定传感器坐标下，多线性解码器可以生成显式的似然引导算子，避免稠密像素空间校正。可选的目标方程残差引导可以进一步提升物理一致性。在2D亥姆霍兹方程、2D合成波场和3D亥姆霍兹场景下的实验结果显示，在仅1%~2%传感率的条件下该方法性能提升显著，且在三维场景下仍然具备实用性。

title: DK-GBMKKM: Dynamic Kernel-Space Granular-Ball Multiple Kernel $k$-Means Clustering
title_zh: DK-GBMKKM：动态核空间粒度球多核k均值聚类
authors: Xiaoyu Lian, Yuchao Zhang, Shuyin Xia, Siqi Zhong, Xuzhao Xiang
abstract: Multiple kernel $k$-means integrates complementary nonlinear similarities by learning a combination of base kernels. Its pointwise optimization, however, is sensitive to noisy and boundary samples and repeatedly operates on sample-scale kernel matrices. Granular-ball representations organize local sample groups into mesoscopic units, but granular balls generated once in the input space may be inconsistent with the fused-kernel geometry that evolves during multiple kernel learning. We propose dynamic kernel-space granular-ball multiple kernel $k$-means (DK-GBMKKM). The method generates granular balls in the current fused kernel space and alternates kernel-weight learning with granular-ball membership updates, allowing the representation to adapt to changes in the fused-kernel geometry. A sample-size-weighted granular-ball kernel is further constructed to preserve the contributions of balls of different sizes, and its positive semidefiniteness and related equivalence properties are established. Experiments on 12 public datasets demonstrate the strong overall clustering performance of DK-GBMKKM. The code has been open-sourced for reproducibility:this https URL.
summary_zh: 多核k均值通过学习基础核的组合，整合互补的非线性相似度。但其逐点优化的方式对噪声样本和边界样本敏感，且需要反复操作样本级核矩阵。粒度球表示将局部样本组组织为介观单元，但在输入空间中一次性生成的粒度球可能与多核学习过程中不断演化的融合核几何结构不一致。本文提出动态核空间粒度球多核k均值（DK-GBMKKM）方法：该方法在当前融合核空间中生成粒度球，交替执行核权重学习和粒度球成员更新，使得表示可以自适应融合核几何结构的变化。本文进一步构建了样本规模加权的粒度球核，保留不同大小粒度球的贡献，并证明了其半正定性和相关等价性质。在12个公开数据集上的实验结果证明DK-GBMKKM具备优异的整体聚类性能。相关代码已开源以支持可复现性：对应链接见原文。

title: Disciplined Bilevel Programming
authors: Hao Zhu, Joschka Boedecker
abstract: Bilevel optimization provides a natural modeling language for hierarchical decision problems. However, applying existing numerical solvers usually requires substantial manual analysis and reformulation. In this paper, we introduce disciplined bilevel programming (DBLP), a symbolic framework that allows users to specify and solve optimistic bilevel problems in a high-level, human-readable way that is close to the mathematical formulation. For problems with a disciplined nonlinear upper problem and a convex lower problem satisfying the disciplined parameterized programming rules, DBLP automatically canonicalizes the lower problem into conic form and constructs an equivalent single-level reformulation using the conic Karush-Kuhn-Tucker conditions. We relax the resulting complementarity constraint and use a gap continuation procedure to approximately solve a sequence of smooth nonlinear problems. We implement DBLP in the open-source Python package BLVPY, an extension of CVXPY for bilevel programming. We demonstrate the modeling and solution capabilities of BLVPY on a range of bilevel optimization problems from several application domains. The proposed framework and implementation allow users to specify and solve bilevel optimization problems within a few lines of code, without prior expertise in bilevel modeling and numerical optimization.

title: BeamRMX: Radiation-Pattern-Driven Learning for Generalizable Beam Radio Map Prediction and Beam Management
title_zh: BeamRMX：辐射方向图驱动的面向泛化性波束无线电地图预测与波束管理的学习框架
authors: Yue Zhang, Xiucheng Wang, Wenshuo Chen, Nan Cheng
abstract: The evolution toward sixth-generation (6G) wireless networks is driving larger antenna arrays and highly directional multi-beam transmission, making accurate knowledge of beam-dependent spatial coverage important for beam management and environment-aware network operation. Radio maps (RMs) provide such a representation, yet conventional RM prediction assumes omnidirectional or transmitter-level radiation. In beamformed multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems, one propagation scene instead gives rise to many configuration-dependent beam radio maps (BeamRMs), creating challenges in beam representation and generalization. Existing methods either condition prediction on beam descriptors or use beam maps as auxiliary inputs to generic architectures. We propose BeamRMX, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first dedicated framework to treat the spatial radiation pattern as the primary BeamRM query and learn how scene geometry transforms it into the received power field. XBase learns multiscale interactions between the radiation query and scene geometry, while an optional Evidence Adapter uses a few cross-configuration BeamRMs from the same scene. Matched-domain and zero-shot experiments show consistent gains over deterministic and diffusion baselines, including mean absolute error reductions of 26.1\% on unseen scenes and 47.8\% on an unseen configuration. Cross-configuration evidence further improves reconstruction and intra-sector beam refinement.
summary_zh: 面向第六代（6G）无线网络的演进催生了更大规模的天线阵列与高定向性多波束传输技术，使得精准掌握波束相关的空间覆盖特性对波束管理与环境感知网络运行至关重要。无线电地图（Radio Map, RM）可提供这类表征能力，但传统无线电地图预测方法均假设全向辐射或仅考虑发射机层面的辐射特性。在波束成形多输入多输出（MIMO）系统中，同一场景会生成大量与配置相关的波束无线电地图（BeamRM），给波束表征与泛化能力带来挑战。现有方法要么将预测过程条件化在波束描述符上，要么将波束地图作为通用架构的辅助输入。本文提出的BeamRMX是目前已知首个专门将空间辐射方向图作为核心BeamRM查询项、学习场景几何如何将其转换为接收功率场的专用框架。其中XBase模块学习辐射查询与场景几何之间的多尺度交互，可选的证据适配器（Evidence Adapter）可复用同一场景下少量跨配置的BeamRM数据。匹配域实验与零样本实验结果表明，该方法相比确定性基线与扩散模型基线取得了一致的性能提升：在未见过的场景下平均绝对误差降低26.1%，在未见过的配置下平均绝对误差降低47.8%；跨配置证据进一步提升了重建精度与扇区内波束优化效果。

title: Topological Steering
title_zh: Topological Steering（拓扑引导）
authors: Benoît Guérand, Tan Minh Nguyen
abstract: With the rapid rise of large language models (LLMs), controlling undesirable model behaviors has become increasingly important. Existing behavioral control methods typically intervene directly in activation or feature space, but such approaches can be sensitive to outliers, distributional shifts, noise, and other local perturbations. Motivated by Topological Data Analysis (TDA), which captures global rather than purely local structure, we propose Topological Steering, a new framework for steering LLM behavior through the topological representation of activation spaces. Using persistence diagrams, our method connects activation-based steering with TDA and enables more robust behavioral control. We show that Topological Steering consistently modifies LLM behavior across multiple model families and model sizes.
summary_zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展，控制模型的非预期行为变得愈发重要。现有行为控制方法通常直接在激活空间或特征空间进行干预，但这类方法对离群点、分布偏移、噪声及其他局部扰动十分敏感。受可捕获全局结构而非纯局部结构的拓扑数据分析（Topological Data Analysis, TDA）启发，本文提出Topological Steering这一全新框架，通过激活空间的拓扑表征引导大语言模型行为。该方法利用持续图将基于激活的引导与拓扑数据分析相结合，实现了鲁棒性更强的行为控制。实验结果表明，Topological Steering可在多种模型系列与不同模型规模下持续稳定地修改大语言模型的行为。

title: CRAFT: Fine-Tuning Pre-hoc Explainability in AI-native 6G RAN
title_zh: CRAFT：原生AI 6G无线接入网（RAN）中事前可解释性的微调方法
authors: Pranshav Gajjar, Vijay K Shah
abstract: The next generation of mobile networks is envisioned as fully AI-native, with AI-RAN architectures embedding small language models (SLMs) to perform reasoning over real-time telemetry. The state-of-the-art training paradigms for telecom LLMs, exemplified by RANSTRUCT-style supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on curated instruction data, are limited to post hoc rationalization. Here, the explanations, when produced at all, are generated after or independently of the decision, leaving the decision process unauditable. Pre-hoc reasoning, where a causal reasoning trace is produced before the output label, is preferable, and the broader LLM reasoning literature has made real progress toward it via RL methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Here we observe that transplanting this recipe into the telecom setting runs into a cold-start barrier: SLMs either learn to output the desired format or learn to predict the label, but rarely both. We identify this barrier and propose CRAFT, which stands for Cold-start Reasoning Alignment via Fine-Tuning, a data-centric method to autonomously generate a verified dataset of (input, trace, label) triplets. CRAFT fine-tunes SLMs on this verified data using low-rank adaptation (LoRA), requiring substantially less compute and wall-clock time than GRPO-based methods. On the TRACTOR and IC xApp telecom datasets, CRAFT achieves up to 86.5% and 94.6% for accuracy and F1 with no parse failures, while direct GRPO and SFT+GRPO fail to exceed 28% and 53.5% F1 with multiple parse failures. We further show that CRAFT-initialized policies serve as a robust foundation for subsequent GRPO fine-tuning, as under diverse reward functions the performance remains consistent with no parse failures. Finally, we demonstrate that CRAFT consumes 59% less energy than GRPO-based baselines, making it a sustainable path to deployable, auditable AI in 6G RAN.
summary_zh: 下一代移动网络被构想为完全原生AI架构，AI-RAN（无线接入网）架构将嵌入小语言模型（SLM），基于实时遥测数据完成推理任务。当前面向电信领域大语言模型的主流训练范式（以RANSTRUCT风格在精选指令数据集上开展的监督微调SFT为代表）仅支持事后合理化：即便生成了解释内容，解释也在决策完成后生成或独立于决策过程，导致决策流程不可审计。事前推理可在输出标签前生成因果推理轨迹，是更理想的方案，现有大语言模型推理领域已通过组相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization, GRPO）等强化学习方法取得了相关进展。本文发现将这类方案迁移到电信场景会遭遇冷启动障碍：小语言模型要么学会输出期望格式，要么学会预测标签，很难同时实现两个目标。本文明确了该障碍的成因并提出CRAFT方法，全称为Cold-start Reasoning Alignment via Fine-Tuning（基于微调的冷启动推理对齐方法），这是一种以数据为核心的方法，可自动生成经过验证的（输入、轨迹、标签）三元组数据集。CRAFT使用低秩适配（Low-Rank Adaptation, LoRA）在该验证数据集上微调小语言模型，所需的计算资源与时钟时间远低于基于GRPO的方法。在TRACTOR与IC xApp电信数据集上，CRAFT的准确率与F1值最高可达86.5%与94.6%，且无解析失败问题；而直接GRPO方法与SFT+GRPO方法的F1值最高不超过28%与53.5%，且存在多次解析失败。本文进一步验证，经CRAFT初始化的策略可作为后续GRPO微调的鲁棒基础，在多种奖励函数下均可保持性能稳定且无解析失败。最后实验表明，CRAFT的能耗比基于GRPO的基线低59%，是6G RAN中部署可审计AI的可持续路径。

title: Real-Time Neuromorphic Spectrum Intelligence Simulator
title_zh: 实时神经形态频谱智能模拟器
authors: Navaneetha Krishnan Kamalakannan
abstract: We present the Real-Time Neuromorphic Spectrum Intelligence Simulator (RT-NuSIS), a modular framework to study spiking neural network (SNN) and memristor-inspired agents for dynamic spectrum access under constrained energy budgets and adversarial conditions. RT-NuSIS couples leaky integrate-and-fire neuronal dynamics, memristive synaptic models, physics-informed energy-harvesting models (triboelectric and RF), and adversary models including jamming and Byzantine behavior. We formalize the simulator mathematically, prove boundedness, present a mean-field adversary threshold, analyze per-step complexity, and provide a reproducible benchmark harness for energy-per-inference, latency, and robustness metrics. The codebase is modular, deterministic by seed, and designed for large-scale event-driven simulations.
summary_zh: 本文提出实时神经形态频谱智能模拟器（Real-Time Neuromorphic Spectrum Intelligence Simulator, RT-NuSIS），这是一个模块化框架，用于研究在受限能量预算与对抗场景下面向动态频谱接入的脉冲神经网络（Spiking Neural Network, SNN）与忆阻启发智能体。RT-NuSIS整合了泄漏积分放电神经元动力学、忆阻突触模型、物理信息能量收集模型（摩擦电与射频类型）以及包含干扰与拜占庭行为在内的对抗模型。本文对该模拟器进行了数学形式化定义，证明了其有界性，给出了平均场对抗阈值，分析了单步复杂度，并提供了可复现的基准测试框架用于评估单推理能耗、延迟与鲁棒性指标。该代码库采用模块化设计，基于种子可实现确定性运行，专为大规模事件驱动仿真设计。

title: Manifold-Aware General Coded Computing for Straggler-Resilient Distributed Computing
title_zh: 面向抗掉队节点分布式计算的流形感知通用编码计算方法
authors: Parsa Moradi, Mohammad Ali Maddah-Ali
abstract: Existing coded-computing designs do not explicitly exploit the intrinsic structure of the input data. In communication systems, statistical structure and redundancy are often removed through source coding (or compression) before channel coding is applied. This principle, however, does not transfer directly to coded computation. In many computational tasks, particularly in machine learning, the structure of the data is precisely what the computation seeks to exploit to infer outputs or learn meaningful patterns. Consequently, coded-computing schemes should preserve and leverage this structure in their code design, rather than ignoring or eliminating it through source coding.This observation motivates a different perspective on code construction. In many channel-coding schemes, such as Reed-Solomon codes, coded symbols are generated by evaluating a low-dimensional algebraic representation at selected points. In contrast, many high-dimensional datasets naturally concentrate near low-dimensional manifolds. In this paper, we exploit this intrinsic geometry by designing coded samples that follow the natural manifold of the data, rather than imposing an artificial low-dimensional structure unrelated to the data distribution. Inspired by graph-based manifold learning, we propose a manifold-aware encoding strategy for general coded computing (GCC). Experiments on neural network inference and high-dimensional polynomial evaluation demonstrate that the proposed strategy consistently and significantly reduces the mean squared recovery error under straggling compared with standard GCC.
summary_zh: 现有编码计算设计并未显式利用输入数据的内在结构。在通信系统中，统计结构与冗余通常会在信道编码前通过信源编码（或压缩）去除，但该原则无法直接迁移到编码计算场景。在大量计算任务（尤其是机器学习任务）中，数据的内在结构恰恰是计算过程用于推断输出、学习有效模式的核心要素。因此，编码计算方案应当在编码设计中保留并利用这类结构，而非通过信源编码忽略或消除它。基于该观察，本文从全新视角开展编码构造：在诸如里德-所罗门码等信道编码方案中，编码符号通过在选定点处评估低维代数表征生成；而大量高维数据集天然集中在低维流形附近。本文利用该内在几何特性，设计遵循数据天然流形分布的编码样本，而非强加与数据分布无关的人工低维结构。受图流形学习启发，本文提出面向通用编码计算（General Coded Computing, GCC）的流形感知编码策略。在神经网络推理与高维多项式评估任务上的实验表明，与标准通用编码计算方案相比，该策略可在存在掉队节点的场景下持续显著降低恢复均方误差。

title: GenONet: A Generative operator Network for High-Resolution Precipitation Nowcasting
title_zh: GenONet：面向高分辨率降水临近预报的生成算子网络
authors: Mohammad Kian Golkar, Luciano Alves de Oliveira, Mohammad Khanjani
abstract: High-resolution precipitation nowcasting is critical for reducing the impacts of severe weather but remains difficult because of rapid storm evolution. Deep learning models have shown great promise for this task, but their predictive skill often deteriorates over longer forecast horizons. This leads to increasingly blurry forecasts that fail to capture the complex, non-linear evolution of storm systems. In order to address these limitations, we introduce Spatio-Temporal U-DeepONet (GenONet), a novel architecture for long-range precipitation forecasting up to 3 hours, specifically designed to produce sharp and physically consistent results. GenONet's architecture pioneers the use of a Deep Operator Network (DeepONet) as a generator within a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) framework for this task. The DeepONet learns the continuous-time dynamics of precipitation, ensuring stability over long forecast horizons. Adversial training against a spatio-temporal discriminator compels the model to produce sharp, coherent forecasts, while a physics-informed loss regularizer, derived from the Moisture Conservation Equation, improves physical plausibility in our ablation setting. Quantitative evaluations show that our model achieves consistently higher scores on most of the metrics, especially for highintensity events and at longer lead times. Qualitatively, GenONet produces structurally coherent forecasts that maintain their integrity, whereas baseline models degrade into indistinct patterns. Finally, an ablation study confirms the benefit of this physics-informed loss, highlighting the strength of combining operator learning with adversarial training.
summary_zh: 高分辨率降水临近预报对降低极端天气影响至关重要，但受风暴快速演化特性限制，该任务实现难度较大。深度学习模型在该任务上展现出巨大潜力，但预测性能通常会随预报时效延长而下降，导致预报结果越来越模糊，无法捕捉风暴系统复杂的非线性演化过程。为解决上述局限，本文提出时空U型深度算子网络（Spatio-Temporal U-DeepONet, GenONet），这是一种专为最长3小时的长时效降水预报设计的全新架构，可生成清晰且符合物理一致性的预报结果。GenONet首次在生成对抗网络（Generative Adversarial Network, GAN）框架中使用深度算子网络（Deep Operator Network, DeepONet）作为生成器。DeepONet学习降水的连续时间动力学特性，保障长预报时效下的稳定性；针对时空判别器的对抗训练可迫使模型生成清晰连贯的预报结果；由水分守恒方程推导的物理信息损失正则项可进一步提升预报结果的物理合理性，相关消融实验验证了其作用。定量评估结果表明，该模型在绝大多数指标上得分更高，尤其在强降水事件与长预报时效场景下优势显著。定性分析显示，GenONet生成的预报结果结构连贯、特征完整性高，而基线模型的输出会退化为模糊的无区分度模式。最后消融研究验证了物理信息损失的增益效果，证明了算子学习与对抗训练结合的优势。

title: DeSyR: A Decoupled Symbolic Recovery Framework with PINN-Guided Structure Search and Physics-Informed Coefficient Refinement
title_zh: DeSyR：融合物理信息神经网络（PINN）引导结构搜索与物理信息系数优化的解耦符号恢复框架
authors: Pancheng Niu, Jun Guo, Qiaolin He, Jingcai Guo, Yanchao Shi
abstract: Recovering compact explicit solutions from neural approximations is challenging when imperfect teacher data guide symbolic topology search and coefficient estimation. We present DeSyR, a decoupled symbolic recovery framework for differential equations. A physics-informed neural network guides repeated searches to construct candidate topologies with provisional constants. Once a topology is fixed, its coefficients are refined solely from the governing equation and prescribed constraints, followed by gated selection and verification. For linear fixed-topology parameterizations, we characterize teacher-error inheritance and show that finite-weight mixed data--physics fitting retains an $O(\beta^{-1})$ teacher-dependent contribution when the teacher error projects onto the model space. Under well-posedness, representability, zero-residual attainment, and discrete determinacy, physics-only refinement conditionally recovers exact coefficients; for nonlinear parameterizations, the corresponding guarantees are local. DeSyR is evaluated on 15 differential-equation problems across 18 configurations covering high-order, space--time, multidimensional, nonlinear, and coupled systems. A candidate-level audit yields a 99.23% convergence rate among free-parameter refits, while every selected refinement involving free coefficients converges. Configuration-level median refined relative $L_2$ errors are $2.31\times10^{-14}$ or lower. In same-topology comparisons, refinement reduces error by eight to fourteen orders of magnitude. These results show that an approximate neural teacher can guide topology discovery without imposing its error scale on final recovered coefficients, provided a target-capable topology is retained and physics-only refinement converges.
summary_zh: 当非完美的教师数据引导符号拓扑搜索与系数估计时，从神经近似结果中恢复紧凑显式解的难度很大。本文提出面向微分方程的解耦符号恢复框架DeSyR，由物理信息神经网络引导多次搜索，生成带有临时常数的候选拓扑。拓扑确定后，仅基于控制方程与预设约束对系数进行优化，随后通过门控选择完成验证。针对线性固定拓扑参数化场景，本文刻画了教师误差的继承特性，证明当教师误差投影到模型空间时，有限权重混合数据-物理拟合会保留与教师相关的O(β⁻¹)量级贡献。在适定性、可表征性、零残差可达性与离散确定性条件下，仅基于物理的优化可条件性恢复精确系数；针对非线性参数化场景，对应的保证为局部性质。本文在覆盖高阶、时空、多维、非线性与耦合系统的18种配置下的15个微分方程问题上对DeSyR进行测试，候选层自由参数重拟合的收敛率达99.23%，所有涉及自由系数的选定优化过程全部收敛；配置层优化后的相对L₂误差中位数不超过2.31×10⁻¹⁴。在相同拓扑的对比实验中，优化过程可将误差降低8到14个数量级。上述结果表明，只要保留具备目标拟合能力的拓扑且仅基于物理的优化收敛，近似神经教师即可引导拓扑发现，且不会将自身的误差量级传递到最终恢复的系数中。

title: Why Multi-Layer Message Passing Works: Completeness Theory for Graph Neural Network Interatomic Potentials
title_zh: 多层消息传递的有效性原理：图神经网络原子间势的完备性理论
authors: Pingbing Ming, Han Wang
abstract: We prove that the Hypergraph Neural Network, an invariant architecture with 3-body message passing, is a universal approximator for potential energy surfaces. Our main contribution is a multi-layer completeness theory. We show that $L$ layers of message passing on sparse, cutoff-based graphs achieve the same representational power as having access to the full $L$-hop neighborhood, provided the configurations are generic, satisfy an overlap condition and a connectivity condition. This provides the first rigorous justification for the common practice of using multi-layer message passing with a per-layer cutoff smaller than the physical interaction range, the setting used by virtually all practical graph neural network based machine-learned interatomic potentials. As immediate consequences, we show that both DPA3 and CHGNet architectures inherit universal approximation.
summary_zh: 本文证明了具备三体消息传递的不变架构超图神经网络是势能面的通用近似器。本文的核心贡献是提出了多层完备性理论：在配置满足通用条件、重叠条件与连通性条件的前提下，基于稀疏截断图的L层消息传递可获得与访问完整L跳邻域完全等价的表征能力。该结论首次为业界广泛采用的实践方案提供了严格理论支撑：几乎所有基于图神经网络的机器学习原子间势都采用了每层截断范围小于物理相互作用范围的多层消息传递设置。作为直接推论，本文证明DPA3与CHGNet架构均具备通用近似能力。

title: Learning Task-Specific Antibody Representations via Function-Aware Masking
title_zh: 通过功能感知掩码学习任务特异性抗体表征
authors: Ayan Goel, Thomas A. Walton, Amirali Aghazadeh
abstract: Antibody-specific language models pretrained via masked language modeling (MLM) learn representations that are critical for downstream sequence design and property prediction tasks. Yet, the corruption process itself is rarely leveraged as a source of inductive bias during pretraining. While preferentially masking complementarity-determining regions (CDRs) improves binding-related predictions, antibodies possess diverse biological priors over a variety of functions. Herein, we introduce function-aware masking, a family of pretraining algorithms that align mask placement with specific functional priors (e.g., from IMGT annotations or structure predictions) to shape the learned representation space. We show that these specialist masking strategies significantly improve performance on their respective objectives, yielding up to a 14% gain on structure-related tasks and up to a 5.9x improvement on CDR-related tasks. To further improve performance across multiple functional axes, we develop hybrid masking strategies that integrate multiple priors, balancing reconstruction over binding, structural, and biophysical objectives. Our results demonstrate that informed mask placement provides a parameter-free mechanism for imposing functional inductive biases in antibody language model training.
summary_zh: 基于掩码语言建模（Masked Language Modeling, MLM）预训练的抗体专用语言模型学习到的表征对下游序列设计与性质预测任务至关重要，但现有方法很少将掩码过程本身作为预训练阶段的归纳偏置来源。虽然优先掩码互补决定区（Complementarity-Determining Regions, CDR）的策略可提升结合相关预测任务的性能，但抗体在各类功能上具备多样的生物先验知识。本文提出功能感知掩码方法，这是一类预训练算法，可将掩码位置与特定功能先验（例如来自IMGT注释或结构预测的先验）对齐，从而塑造学习到的表征空间。实验表明，这类专用掩码策略可显著提升对应目标任务的性能：结构相关任务性能最高提升14%，CDR相关任务性能最高提升5.9倍。为进一步在多个功能维度上提升性能，本文开发了整合多类先验的混合掩码策略，可在结合、结构与生物物理目标的重建任务间实现平衡。研究结果表明，合理设计掩码位置是抗体语言模型训练中无需额外参数即可引入功能归纳偏置的有效机制。

title: VATO: A Vortex-Force-Aware Transformer Operator for Unsteady Separated Aerofoil Flows
title_zh: VATO：面向非定常分离翼型流动的涡力感知Transformer算子
authors: Xingxin Yang, Zhan Zhang, Yichen Li, Juan Li
abstract: Accurate prediction of unsteady separated flows is challenging because the aerodynamic loads depend on nonlinear separation and vortex-shedding dynamics. Although high-fidelity CFD resolves these mechanisms, its cost limits repeated use in design and control. Standard field-level surrogate training, however, does not distinguish the flow regions that contribute most strongly to the aerodynamic loads. We introduce VATO (Vortex-Force-Aware Transformer Operator), which couples the Vortex Force Map (VFM) method to a geometry-aware neural operator through two complementary mechanisms. VATO-S adds training-only supervision of the local VFM force-contribution field, with no increase in model size or inference cost. VATO-A uses VFM contribution and sensitivity fields to prioritise force-relevant source locations for residual cross attention. The methods are evaluated on unsteady CFD data for double-edged-plate aerofoils over 54 trajectories from nine geometries. Over lead times of 1-20~ms, VATO-S reduces velocity, pressure, and vorticity errors by 10.4\%, 1.0\%, and 15.6\%, respectively, while VATO-A achieves reductions of 15.8\%, 7.5\%, and 31.2\%. VATO-S gives the lowest VFM-derived drag error, whereas VATO-A gives the lowest pressure-derived lift and drag errors. Over lead times extending 50\% beyond the training range, VATO-A retains a 26.9\% reduction in vorticity error and larger improvements in all four force readouts, despite reduced gains in velocity and pressure. These results show that force-aware operator learning can improve both flow-field prediction and aerodynamic functional accuracy in unsteady separated flows.
summary_zh: 非定常分离流动的精准预测难度很大，原因是气动载荷与非线性分离、涡脱动力学特性高度相关。虽然高保真计算流体力学（CFD）可解析这类机制，但其高昂的计算成本限制了其在设计与控制场景中的反复使用。而标准的流场层面代理模型训练无法区分对气动载荷贡献最大的流动区域。本文提出VATO（Vortex-Force-Aware Transformer Operator，涡力感知Transformer算子），通过两种互补机制将涡力图（Vortex Force Map, VFM）方法与几何感知神经算子相结合：VATO-S仅在训练阶段引入局部VFM力贡献场的监督，不会增加模型尺寸与推理成本；VATO-A利用VFM贡献场与敏感场，为残差交叉注意力优先选择与力相关的源位置。本文在9种几何形状的54条轨迹对应的双边板翼型非定常CFD数据上对方法进行验证，在1~20ms的预报时效内，VATO-S的速度、压力与涡量误差分别降低10.4%、1.0%与15.6%，VATO-A的三类误差分别降低15.8%、7.5%与31.2%。VATO-S的VFM推导阻力误差最低，而VATO-A的压力推导升力与阻力误差最低。在超出训练范围50%的预报时效下，尽管速度与压力的性能增益有所下降，VATO-A仍可实现26.9%的涡量误差降低，且四类力输出的性能提升幅度更大。上述结果表明，力感知算子学习可同时提升非定常分离流动的流场预测精度与气动功能量的预测精度。

title: A hybrid quantum-classical neural network for learning to route
title_zh: 用于路由学习的量子-经典混合神经网络
authors: Marcus Rolf Peter Ritt, Alexsandro Santos da Rosa Júnior, Marcos Vinicius Reballo, Cesar Augusto do Amaral, Fernando Augusto Caletti de Barros
abstract: This work studies hybrid quantum-classical neural networks for learning routing heuristics. Specifically, this paper asks whether small quantum neural networks can replace parameter-heavy modules inside a competitive attention-based routing model while maintaining solution quality. For the capacitated vehicle routing problem, encoder feed-forward replacement emerges as the most promising design: it reduces the number of model parameters by 56.6% while keeping the hybrid model close to the classical neural baseline at small and medium instance sizes, although the gap grows for larger instances. This work also compares to classical routing algorithms, which remain highly competitive and often superior on the fixed Euclidean test sets. Our results therefore do not indicate quantum advantage or solver dominance, but identify encoder feed-forward replacement as a viable hybrid-module compression strategy for neural combinatorial optimization.
summary_zh: 本研究探索面向路由启发式学习的量子-经典混合神经网络。具体而言，本文验证小型量子神经网络能否在保证求解质量的前提下，替换主流注意力路由模型中参数量庞大的内部模块。针对带容量车辆路径问题，编码器前馈层替换是最具应用前景的设计方案：该方案可将模型参数量降低56.6%，在中小规模实例下混合模型性能与经典神经基线模型接近，仅在大规模实例下性能差距有所扩大。本研究还与经典路由算法进行了对比，结果显示经典路由算法在固定欧氏测试集上仍具备极强竞争力，性能往往更优。因此本研究结果并未验证量子优势或量子求解器的主导性，但证实编码器前馈层替换是面向神经组合优化的可行混合模块压缩策略。

title: AdaptNTK: Adaptive Uncertainty Quantification and Active Learning for Neural Network Potentials
title_zh: AdaptNTK：面向神经网络势的自适应不确定性量化与主动学习
authors: Prajwal Ananth, Shuwen Yue
abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials bridge the gap between quantum chemical precision and classical computational speed, enabling molecular dynamics simulations with first-principles accuracy. Their reliability is often improved through active learning, which iteratively expands the training set by identifying uncertain, out-of-distribution configurations. Existing uncertainty-quantification methods often involve a trade-off between computational cost and reliability, and generally cannot account for redundancy as an acquisition batch is assembled. Here, we introduce AdaptNTK, a single-model framework that measures uncertainty as a regularized Mahalanobis distance in empirical neural tangent kernel (NTK) feature space. With the NTK features fixed during acquisition, the uncertainty depends on the acquired configurations but not their reference labels. This allows the uncertainty to be updated recursively after each selection without retraining, reducing redundancy within an acquisition batch. On held-out rMD17 data, AdaptNTK achieves the highest mean correlations with force errors (Spearman 0.68, Pearson 0.71) and matches a three-member ensemble in error retention. In active learning experiments, AdaptNTK achieves the lowest force errors across rMD17 and Transition-1X, with particularly strong performance on transition-state configurations in Transition-1X. AdaptNTK provides a 2.6-fold speedup per Transition-1X cycle relative to the ensemble, providing efficient single-model uncertainty estimation with sequential updates for data-efficient active learning.
summary_zh: 机器学习原子间势填补了量子化学精度与经典计算速度之间的空白，可实现具备第一性原理精度的分子动力学模拟。这类模型的可靠性通常通过主动学习提升：主动学习通过识别不确定的、分布外的构型迭代扩展训练集。现有不确定性量化方法通常需要在计算成本与可靠性之间做权衡，且在构建采集批次时通常无法处理样本冗余问题。本文提出AdaptNTK，这是一种单模型框架，将不确定性度量定义为经验神经正切核（Neural Tangent Kernel, NTK）特征空间中的正则化马氏距离。由于采集过程中NTK特征保持固定，不确定性仅依赖于已采集构型，而不依赖其参考标签。这使得每次选择样本后无需重新训练即可递归更新不确定性，减少采集批次内的样本冗余。在留出的rMD17数据集上，AdaptNTK与力误差的平均相关性最高（斯皮尔曼相关系数0.68，皮尔逊相关系数0.71），误差留存性能与三模型集成方法相当。在主动学习实验中，AdaptNTK在rMD17和Transition-1X数据集上均实现了最低的力误差，在Transition-1X的过渡态构型上表现尤为突出。与集成方法相比，AdaptNTK在Transition-1X的每轮实验中速度提升2.6倍，可提供高效的单模型不确定性估计与序列更新能力，支撑数据高效的主动学习。

title: Are Near-Tied LLM Rankings Robust to Family-DIF-Guided Benchmark Recomposition?
title_zh: 大语言模型的近并列排名对Family-DIF（跨模型家族差异项目功能）引导的基准重组是否具备鲁棒性？
authors: Qiaoyuan Zheng, Yiqu Yang
abstract: Small leaderboard gaps are often interpreted as evidence that one language model is better than another, but their sign may depend on which benchmark items are included. We test this using item-level responses from five benchmarks and a family-label-free spectral approximation to multidimensional item-response theory (MIRT). In owner-disjoint folds, one owner half identifies items with low residual differential item functioning across model families (low-DIF); the resulting frozen, source- and easiness-balanced weights score models in the other half, while equally short matched-random subtests control for generic subtest variation. Full-benchmark and low-DIF rankings remain strongly correlated ($\tau_b=.900$--$.948$). Yet in four of five benchmarks, 30.9--47.1\% of cross-family pairs initially within one percentage point reverse order, exceeding their matched-random medians by 16.9--28.6 percentage points (all $p=.001$). The fifth benchmark shows no reliable excess ($-0.9$ points, $p=.689$). The pattern survives all pre-specified population perturbations, and residual item--family signatures replicate across owner halves; however, no family shows a consistent advantage across benchmarks. Thus, globally stable rankings can still leave individual near-tie orderings sensitive to benchmark composition, and sub-one-point leaderboard gaps should be accompanied by evidence that the implied ordering is composition-robust.
summary_zh: 排行榜上的微小差距通常被解读为某一语言模型性能优于另一模型的证据，但排名的正负性可能取决于基准集中包含的具体条目。本文使用5个基准集的条目级响应数据，以及无家族标签的多维项目反应理论（Multidimensional Item Response Theory, MIRT）谱近似方法开展验证。在按模型所有者划分的互不重叠折集中，其中一半所有者的数据用于识别跨模型家族残差差异项目功能（Differential Item Functioning, DIF）较低的条目；生成的兼顾源域与难度平衡的固定权重用于对另一半数据中的模型打分，同时使用等长匹配随机子测试控制通用子测试变异的影响。全基准排名与低DIF排名仍保持强相关性（τ_b=0.900~0.948）。但在5个基准集中的4个里，初始差距在1个百分点以内的跨模型配对中，有30.9%~47.1%的配对排名发生反转，该比例比匹配随机子测试的中位数高出16.9~28.6个百分点（所有p值均为0.001）。第5个基准集未表现出显著的超额反转比例（-0.9个百分点，p=0.689）。该模式在所有预先指定的总体扰动下均保持成立，且残差条目-家族特征在不同所有者折集中可复现；但没有任何一个模型家族在所有基准集上表现出一致优势。因此，全局稳定的排名仍可能让个体近并列排序对基准集组成敏感，排行榜上小于1个百分点的差距需要附带证据证明所得排序对基准组成具备鲁棒性。

title: Fractal dimension predicts quantum kernel collapse in angle-encoded data
title_zh: 分形维度可预测角度编码数据中的量子核坍缩现象
authors: Ana Paula Appel
abstract: Angle-encoded quantum kernels on tabular data collapse when the feature map is wider than the intrinsic dimension of the data. We propose the correlation fractal dimension D2 as an a priori qubit budget: encode D2 coordinates chosen by FD-ASE instead of the PCA-95% width or all E attributes. On nine data sets and a statevector simulator (n= 32), a one-layer ZZ fidelity kernel at q=D2 stays geometrically alive while the same kernel at the PCA-95% width has already collapsed. The budget is map-dependent: product-state and IQP maps overshoot it; a second ZZ layer undershoots it. Packed dense-angle and re-uploading encodings still live at the fractal q, but not when PCA-95% features are stacked onto those qubits. Shrinking the angle bandwidth moves the ZZ knee later; stretching it kills the kernel earlier. On IBM Quantum (ibm_fez, 256 shots, n=8) the one-layer ZZ kernel at the fractal width matches the exact kernel (MAE 0.021); past that width both hardware and simulator have collapsed. The ceiling is a property of the map-data pair at a stated bandwidth, not of the classical table alone.
summary_zh: 针对表格数据的角度编码量子核，当特征映射的维度大于数据的内在维度时会发生坍缩。本文提出使用关联分形维数D2作为先验量子比特预算：通过FD-ASE算法选择D2个坐标进行编码，而非采用主成分分析95%累计贡献率（PCA-95%）准则的维度或全部E个属性。在9个数据集和状态向量模拟器（n=32）上的实验显示，当量子比特数q等于D2时，单层ZZ保真度核始终保持几何有效，而采用PCA-95%维度的同类型核已经发生坍缩。该预算与特征映射相关：乘积态映射和IQP映射所需量子比特数超过该预算，第二层ZZ层所需量子比特数低于该预算。采用密集角度打包和重上传编码时，在分形维度对应的量子比特数下量子核仍有效，但如果将PCA-95%特征堆叠到这些量子比特上，核就会坍缩。缩小角度带宽会推迟ZZ核的坍缩拐点，扩大角度带宽则会加速核坍缩。在IBM Quantum设备（ibm_fez，256采样数，n=8）上，采用分形维度的单层ZZ核性能与精确核相当（平均绝对误差MAE=0.021）；超过该维度后，硬件和模拟器上的核均发生坍缩。该上限是特定带宽下映射-数据对的固有属性，并非仅由经典表格数据决定。

title: Context Window Failures in Relational Foundation Models
title_zh: 关系基础模型中的上下文窗口失效问题
authors: Denis Oliveira Correa, Francisco Galuppo Azevedo
abstract: Recent Relational Deep Learning architectures have been proposed as foundation models for multi-table relational data, yet they impose constrained neighborhood budgets that force row truncation when an entity has many related records. We introduce Animus, a synthetic financial dataset in which predicting customer income requires aggregating up to tens of thousands of transactions. On the raw representation, three recently proposed models (RT, Griffin, RelGT) achieve $R^2 \le 0.18$; a single, routine, temporal pre-aggregation step recovers $R^2$ up to $0.65$. This questions whether current relational foundation models are ready for high-cardinality real-world data.
summary_zh: 近期提出的关系深度学习架构可作为面向多表关系数据的基础模型，但这类模型设置了受限的邻域预算，当某个实体关联大量记录时必须对行数据进行截断。本文构建了合成金融数据集Animus，在该数据集中预测客户收入需要聚合多达数万条交易记录。在原始表示下，3种最新提出的模型（RT、Griffin、RelGT）的R²值均不超过0.18；仅通过一步常规的时间预聚合操作，即可将R²值提升至0.65。该结果表明当前的关系基础模型尚未做好应对高基数真实世界数据的准备。

title: Can LLMs Use Relational Transformer Embeddings?
title_zh: 大语言模型能否使用关系Transformer嵌入？
authors: Francisco Galuppo Azevedo, Clarissa Lima Loures
abstract: Injecting frozen relational-encoder embeddings as soft tokens into a large language model (LLM) is a conceptually appealing fusion strategy: the encoder handles multi-table structure, the LLM handles language and reasoning, and no lossy text serialization is required. We test this hypothesis concretely by injecting embeddings from a frozen Relational Transformer (RT) into Qwen3.5-4B via a learned MLP projection and LoRA adaptation, trained first with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on chain-of-thought reasoning traces and then with group-based reinforcement learning (GSPO). We evaluate across 10 binary classification tasks on 6 relational databases from RelBench, under four supervision regimes: single-task (ST), within-dataset (WD), cross-dataset (CD), and all-task (ALL). The hybrid model does not consistently outperform standalone RT: it is frequently below random, highly sensitive to serialization format and relational-token budget, and unstable under RL training. We report these negative results and analyze the failure modes, arguing that soft-token fusion requires stronger alignment objectives and schema-aware design before it can serve as a reliable route to relational prediction.
summary_zh: 将冻结的关系编码器嵌入作为软令牌注入大语言模型（LLM）是一种极具吸引力的融合策略：关系编码器处理多表结构，LLM处理语言与推理任务，且无需进行有损的文本序列化。本文通过实验对该假设进行验证：将冻结的关系Transformer（Relational Transformer, RT）输出的嵌入通过可学习的多层感知机投影和低秩适配（LoRA）注入Qwen3.5-4B模型，先在思维链推理轨迹上通过监督微调（SFT）训练，再通过基于组的强化学习（GSPO）训练。本文在RelBench的6个关系数据库上的10个二分类任务中，在4种监督设置（单任务ST、数据集内WD、跨数据集CD、全任务ALL）下开展评估。结果显示，该混合模型的性能无法持续超过独立RT模型：其性能经常低于随机猜测水平，对序列化格式和关系令牌预算高度敏感，且在强化学习训练过程中不稳定。本文报告了这些负面结果并分析了失效模式，指出软令牌融合方法需要更严格的对齐目标和模式感知设计，才能成为关系预测的可靠实现路径。

title: Group Adaptive Clipping Policy Optimization
title_zh: 组自适应裁剪策略优化
authors: Sheng Jia, Xiao Wang, Shiva Prasad Kasiviswanathan, Rein Houthooft
abstract: Group relative policy optimization for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically uses a fixed importance-sampling (IS) ratio clipping boundary across all rollouts. We identify a key limitation: rare correct rollouts on harder problems and abundant correct rollouts on easier problems are clipped at comparable rates, despite contributing very different learning signals. Rollouts with low group success exhibit larger IS ratios and carry stronger gradient signal for exploration and solving new problems, yet are disproportionately suppressed by fixed clipping.To address this, we propose Group Adaptive Clipping Policy Optimization (GAPO), a plug-in modification to GRPO methods that adapts the clipping boundary to the rollout advantage. GAPO is motivated by a reverse-KL trust-region perspective, which suggests that rollouts with larger learning signal should receive proportionally greater update headroom. GAPO requires no reward shaping and preserves the standard PPO/GSPO surrogate while adapting only the clipping threshold. Across Qwen and Llama models, GAPO consistently improves both Pass@1 and Pass@k over fixed clipping and advantage-shaping baselines on math reasoning and coding benchmarks where the pass rates by the base model are relatively low.
summary_zh: 面向可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的组相对策略优化方法通常在所有轨迹上使用固定的重要性采样（IS）比率裁剪边界。本文指出该方法存在一个核心缺陷：难度较高问题中的稀有正确轨迹与难度较低问题中的大量正确轨迹，尽管其提供的学习信号差异极大，却会以相近的速率被裁剪。组成功率较低的轨迹具备更大的IS比率，可为探索和求解新问题提供更强的梯度信号，却会被固定裁剪机制过度抑制。为解决该问题，本文提出组自适应裁剪策略优化（Group Adaptive Clipping Policy Optimization, GAPO），这是一种可即插即用集成到GRPO方法中的改进方案，可根据轨迹的优势值自适应调整裁剪边界。GAPO的设计基于反向KL信任域视角：该视角表明，携带更强学习信号的轨迹应当获得成比例的更大更新空间。GAPO无需奖励塑造，仅调整裁剪阈值，保留了标准PPO/GSPO的替代损失函数。在Qwen和Llama系列模型上的实验显示，在基线模型通过率较低的数学推理和代码生成基准上，与固定裁剪和优势塑造基线相比，GAPO可同时持续提升Pass@1和Pass@k指标。

title: Physiological Information Reliability: Cross-Layer Adaptive Resource Allocation for Cardiovascular Sensing
title_zh: 生理信息可靠性：面向心血管传感的跨层自适应资源分配
authors: Navaneeth Krishnan Kamalakannan, Janakiraman Kamalakannan, Harinisri Velmurugan
abstract: Cardiovascular sensing systems must preserve clinically useful information despite signal degradation, wireless losses, energy constraints, and edge-computation latency. We introduce Physiological Information Reliability (PIR), a cross-layer framework that represents physiological information value jointly with wireless, energy, and computation states and uses a contextual bandit to adapt sensing and communication decisions. We integrate multimodal ECG/PPG signal-quality estimation with physiological information value and an adaptive network-coding layer under burst-erasure conditions. Across controlled multiseed experiments, PIR-LinUCB demonstrates a promising low-energy operating point while maintaining medical latency constraints and competitive physiological estimation performance relative to fixed and heuristic policies. We analyze the resulting accuracy-energy-latency trade-offs and identify limitations of proxy PIV estimation and simulated communication dynamics. These results provide an initial computational demonstration of physiological-information-aware resource allocation and motivate future clinical and real-channel validation.
summary_zh: 心血管传感系统必须在信号衰减、无线传输丢包、能量约束和边缘计算延迟的影响下，仍保留具备临床价值的信息。本文提出生理信息可靠性（Physiological Information Reliability, PIR）框架，这是一种跨层框架，可联合表征生理信息价值与无线、能量、计算状态，使用上下文赌博机算法自适应调整传感与通信决策。本文将多模态心电图（ECG）/光电容积脉搏波（PPG）信号质量估计与生理信息价值相结合，在突发擦除场景下集成自适应网络编码层。在多组受控实验中，PIR-LinUCB在满足医疗延迟约束、保持与固定策略和启发式策略相当的生理估计性能的同时，实现了极具竞争力的低能耗运行点。本文分析了该框架下精度-能耗-延迟三者的权衡关系，指出了代理生理信息价值估计和模拟通信动态的局限性。该结果为生理信息感知资源分配提供了初步计算验证，为后续临床和真实信道场景下的验证工作奠定了基础。

title: Accelerating Chemical Kinetics for Exoplanet Atmospheres using Neural Networks
title_zh: 基于神经网络加速系外行星大气化学动力学计算
authors: Isaac Malsky, Xi Zhang, Tiffany Kataria, Matthew Graham, Ziyu Huang 等 (8 人)
abstract: Observations increasingly reveal the coupled radiative, chemical, and dynamical processes that shape exoplanet atmospheres. Interpreting these atmospheres requires models that can capture this complexity. However, multidimensional models remain fundamentally limited by computational cost, and answering key questions requires simulating the governing physical mechanisms at speeds classical methods cannot achieve. As a result, models often rely on simplifying approximations, such as equilibrium chemistry, even when those assumptions miss important effects. There is a pressing need for fast and accurate chemical kinetics solvers to model planetary atmospheres. Here we present a machine learning local-box chemical kinetics solver for exoplanet atmospheres using a residual flow-map architecture. We demonstrate that this surrogate model is several orders of magnitude faster than a classical solver, achieving microsecond-scale inference while retaining percent-level accuracy. The surrogate model covers a parameter space that spans $T=300$-$3000$ K, $P=10^{-6}$-$10^{4}$ bar, $\Delta t=10^{-3}$-$10^{8}$ s, and compositions ranging from $10^{-2}$ to $10^{3}$ times solar in both C/O ratio and metallicity. Our model outperforms several commonly used machine learning architectures and performs robustly under the extreme stiffness characteristic of atmospheric chemistry. The machine learning framework presented here is a flexible and efficient approach to emulating state-to-state flow-map problems that commonly arise in numerical simulations.
summary_zh: 越来越多的观测结果揭示了塑造系外行星大气的辐射、化学和动力耦合过程。要对这些大气现象进行解读，需要能够捕捉该复杂度的模型。但多维模型的性能始终受限于计算成本，求解关键科学问题需要以经典方法无法实现的速度模拟核心物理机制。因此现有模型通常依赖平衡化学这类简化近似，即便这类假设会遗漏重要效应。当前亟需快速且准确的化学动力学求解器来模拟行星大气。本文提出一种面向系外行星大气的机器学习本地盒化学动力学求解器，采用残差流映射架构。实验表明该代理模型的速度比经典求解器快数个数量级，可实现微秒级推理，同时保持百分比级的精度。该代理模型覆盖的参数空间范围为：温度300~3000K，压强10^-6~10^4 bar，时间步长10^-3~10^8 s，碳氧比和金属丰度的取值范围均为太阳值的10^-2~10^3倍。本文提出的模型性能优于多种常用机器学习架构，在大气化学特有的极端刚性场景下仍表现稳健。该机器学习框架为模拟数值模拟中常见的态到态流映射问题提供了一种灵活高效的实现方案。

title: How Temporal Correlations Shape Memory in Linear Recurrent Neural Networks
title_zh: 时间相关性如何塑造线性循环神经网络的记忆能力
authors: Arnol Manuel Fokam, Fasseu Sieyondji Akpevwoghene, Edem Fiifi Dawson
abstract: The linear recurrent neural network (LRNN) is a simple model for studying how much memory a network builds up as it trains. For uncorrelated inputs, earlier work found that training itself settles the network between keeping the past and reacting only to the present. Real sequences are correlated, and we solve the learning dynamics exactly for correlated inputs. In the solution, keeping the past carries a cost. The whole effect of correlation lands on that cost. This cost reduces to the earlier one when inputs are uncorrelated and grows once they are positively correlated. Three findings follow. (1) Correlation reshapes the course of learning, not only its end. Memory builds, overshoots, and is partly removed, and the settled network keeps less of the past. (2) Memory switches off at a threshold set by one number, how much each input resembles the one just before it. Neither sequence length nor longer-range correlation moves this threshold. Memory is worth keeping only when the task needs the previous input more than the current input already supplies it through correlation with the past. (3) The best network changes too. Zero error demands a feedthrough, a path that passes the current input straight to the network's output and remembers nothing, and training builds it unprompted when given one spare hidden dimension. Our work turns one property of the input into a prediction of whether a network learns memory and explains why correlated data turns recurrent networks into change detectors.
summary_zh: 线性循环神经网络（LRNN）是研究网络在训练过程中可构建的记忆容量的简化模型。针对无关联输入，现有研究发现训练过程会让网络在保留过去信息和仅响应当前输入之间达到平衡。真实序列存在相关性，本文针对关联输入场景精确求解了其学习动力学。该解显示，保留过去信息需要付出代价，而相关性的全部影响都作用于该代价：当输入无关联时代价退化为已有研究的结果，当输入正相关时代价会升高。本文得到三项结论：（1）相关性不仅影响学习的最终状态，还会重塑学习过程：记忆容量先增长、超调，之后被部分移除，最终收敛的网络保留的过去信息更少。（2）记忆会在由单一参数（相邻输入的相似程度）决定的阈值处完全关闭，序列长度和长程相关性均不会改变该阈值。只有当任务对前序输入的需求超过当前输入通过与过去的相关性所能提供的信息量时，保留记忆才有价值。（3）最优网络结构也会发生变化：零误差要求存在前馈通路，即一条将当前输入直接传递到网络输出、不做任何记忆的路径，当存在一个空闲隐藏维度时，训练过程会自动生成该通路。本研究通过输入的一项属性预测网络是否会习得记忆能力，解释了为什么关联数据会让循环神经网络转变为变化检测器。

title: DynaNDE: Dynamic Near-Data Expert Scheduling for Batched MoE Inference
title_zh: DynaNDE：面向批量MoE（混合专家模型）推理的动态近数据专家调度框架
authors: Xiaoyang Lu, Belthangady Akash Vi Narayana Pai, Xian-He Sun
abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable efficient scaling of large language model (LLM) inference but suffer from substantial data-movement overhead when deployed on neural processing unit (NPU)-based systems. Near-Data Processing (NDP) provides a promising way to mitigate this bottleneck via cooperative NPU-NDP execution. However, existing NPU-NDP MoE systems do not fully account for hardware heterogeneity, dynamic expert-level concurrency, and temporal expert reuse during batched inference. This paper presents DynaNDE, a dynamic near-data expert scheduling framework that exploits NPU-NDP collaboration to accelerate batched MoE inference. DynaNDE introduces an analytical performance model that captures hardware heterogeneity, data-movement costs, and communication-computation overlap in cooperative NPU-NDP execution. Guided by this model, DynaNDE determines per-layer expert scheduling across the NPU and NDP while accounting for expert-level concurrency. DynaNDE also incorporates a reuse-aware runtime that avoids redundant parameter movement when experts reside in NPU memory. Experimental results show that DynaNDE achieves substantial throughput improvements over the state-of-the-art NPU-NDP MoE serving framework, with average speedups of 2.6$\times$ and 2.2$\times$ for the prefill and decoding stages, respectively.
summary_zh: 混合专家（MoE）模型能够实现大语言模型（LLM）推理的高效扩展，但在基于神经网络处理器（NPU）的系统上部署时会产生大量数据移动开销。近数据处理（NDP）通过NPU-NDP协同执行可有效缓解这一瓶颈。然而现有NPU-NDP架构的MoE系统未能充分考虑批量推理过程中的硬件异构性、动态专家级并发性和时间维度的专家复用特性。本文提出DynaNDE，一种利用NPU-NDP协作加速批量MoE推理的动态近数据专家调度框架。DynaNDE引入了分析性能模型，可捕获NPU-NDP协同执行过程中的硬件异构性、数据移动开销和通信-计算重叠特性。在该模型的指导下，DynaNDE在兼顾专家级并发性的前提下，确定每一层专家在NPU和NDP上的调度策略。DynaNDE还集成了复用感知运行时模块，当专家存储在NPU内存中时可避免冗余的参数移动。实验结果表明，与当前最先进的NPU-NDP架构MoE服务框架相比，DynaNDE的吞吐量得到显著提升，预填充阶段和解码阶段的平均加速比分别达到2.6倍和2.2倍。

title: A Multi-Branch Feature Fusion Approach for Health Misinformation Detection and Propagation
title_zh: 面向健康虚假信息检测与传播特性分析的多分支特征融合方法
authors: Mkululi Sikosana, Sean Maudsley-Barton, Oluwaseun Ajao
abstract: This paper presents a multi-branch fusion framework for detecting and characterising the propagation of health misinformation in online social networks (OSNs). Grounded in the Elaboration Likelihood Model (ELM) and the Theory of Planned Behaviour (TPB), the model fuses transformer-based semantics with rhetorical cues, stance representations, and psychologically motivated proxies in a unified multi-task architecture. In addition to binary classification, we introduce the Cognitive Propagation Score (CPS), an interpretable post-hoc auxiliary score computed from psychologically motivated, text-derived cues capturing argument complexity, emotional intensity, and content-derived virality potential, to support diffusion-risk reasoning when engagement ground truth is incomplete or unavailable. Experiments on three benchmark datasets, Constraint, COVID--19\_FNIR, and Monkeypox, show strong classification performance, achieving ROC--AUC up to 0.9999 on COVID--19\_FNIR, while propagation-oriented ranking achieves near-perfect agreement when engagement-derived supervision is available (Monkeypox, Spearman's $\rho = 0.9952$) and similarly high ranking alignment under proxy-based supervision on COVID--19\_FNIR ($\rho = 0.9954$). Compared with representative literature baselines, the fusion model improves detection on Constraint and COVID--19\_FNIR, while Monkeypox remains more challenging, reflecting domain- and signal-specific differences. Ablation analysis further indicates that psychological and rhetorical branches provide complementary gains beyond semantic embeddings. Overall, the framework bridges cognitive theory and neural modelling to improve transparency and to support scalable misinformation monitoring, with future work required to validate CPS against human-centred diffusion judgements.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种多分支融合框架，用于检测在线社交网络（OSNs）中的健康虚假信息并刻画其传播规律。该模型基于精细加工可能性模型（ELM）和计划行为理论（TPB），将Transformer语义特征、修辞线索、立场表征和心理学驱动代理特征融合到统一的多任务架构中。除二分类任务外，本文还提出了认知传播得分（CPS），这是一种可解释的事后辅助得分，由心理学驱动的文本衍生线索计算得到，可捕获论证复杂度、情绪强度和内容衍生的传播潜力，在交互行为真实值不完整或不可用时支持传播风险推理。在Constraint、COVID--19_FNIR和Monkeypox三个基准数据集上的实验显示，该模型分类性能优异，在COVID--19_FNIR数据集上的ROC-AUC最高可达0.9999；在有交互行为监督的情况下，面向传播的排序结果几乎完全一致（Monkeypox数据集上的Spearman ρ=0.9952），在COVID--19_FNIR数据集的代理监督下也实现了极高的排序对齐度（ρ=0.9954）。与代表性基线模型相比，该融合模型在Constraint和COVID--19_FNIR数据集上的检测性能有所提升，而Monkeypox数据集上的性能提升相对有限，反映出不同领域和信号的特性差异。消融实验进一步表明，心理学分支和修辞分支在语义嵌入的基础上可带来互补的性能增益。总体而言，该框架打通了认知理论与神经建模的关联，提升了模型透明度，可支持可扩展的虚假信息监测，后续还需基于以人为中心的传播判断对CPS的有效性进行验证。

title: A convolutional framework for detecting event-driven dynamics in energy price series
title_zh: 面向能源价格序列中事件驱动动力学检测的卷积框架
authors: Caixia Xu, Piotr Fryzlewicz
abstract: This paper develops a general convolutional neural network (CNN) framework for detecting heterogeneous event-driven dynamics in univariate time series windows. We show that the induced CNN class exactly represents classifiers based on range, maximum drawup, maximum drawdown and slope change, and uniformly approximates realised volatility and autoregressive explosiveness on compact domains. We further establish error bounds for representative rules in finite samples and an oracle inequality for learning across them. Simulations show that the proposed model can match or outperform classifiers based on individual statistics as the training sample grows. In an application to six daily energy price series, a hierarchical CNN distinguishes event windows and event families. Applied without retraining to observations withheld after 20 February 2026, the fitted model identifies predominantly geopolitical dynamics in several oil and refined product series around the outbreak of the 2026 Iran war, while distinguishing a contemporaneous natural gas spike associated with weather.
summary_zh: 本文开发了一种通用卷积神经网络（CNN）框架，用于检测单变量时间序列窗口中的异构事件驱动动力学。研究表明，该类CNN可精确表征基于区间、最大上涨幅度、最大下跌幅度和斜率变化的分类器，并且可在紧域上一致逼近已实现波动率和自回归爆炸特性。本文进一步为有限样本下的代表性规则建立了误差边界，以及跨规则学习的神谕不等式。仿真结果表明，随着训练样本量增长，所提模型的性能可匹配或优于基于单变量统计量的分类器。在对6组日度能源价格序列的实际应用中，层级CNN可区分事件窗口和事件类别。将训练好的模型在未参与训练的2026年2月20日之后的观测数据上直接应用（无需重新训练），可识别出2026年伊朗战争爆发前后若干原油及成品油序列中主要由地缘政治驱动的动力学特征，同时区分出同期由天气因素导致的天然气价格峰值。

title: NeuroPriv: Adversarial Representation Learning for Privacy in Wearable EEG Systems
title_zh: NeuroPriv：面向可穿戴脑电系统隐私保护的对抗表征学习
authors: Sarmistha Sarna Gomasta, Bhawana Chhaglani, Prashant Shenoy
abstract: Wearable EEG systems may expose sensitive information beyond their intended health function, creating substantial risks to neuroprivacy. In this work, we show that commonly used EEG features can reveal participant identity and demographic attributes in addition to supporting the intended cognitive task. Wearable EEG is increasingly being explored for cognitive monitoring, neurological assessment, and longitudinal digital-health applications, yet many systems assume that transmitting compact spectral or spatial features instead of raw EEG provides sufficient privacy protection. Using EEGMAT as a motivating case study, we find that compact EEG features achieve a balanced accuracy of 0.788 for cognitive-state classification while enabling gender, age, and subject-identity inference with balanced accuracies of 0.858, 0.789, and 0.692, respectively. We further show that privacy-aware representation learning preserves task performance at 0.781 while reducing these inference accuracies to 0.563, 0.467, and 0.206. These findings motivate purpose-limited representations and explicit privacy auditing in wearable neurohealth systems.
summary_zh: 可穿戴脑电（EEG）系统可能泄露超出其健康功能范畴的敏感信息，给神经隐私带来重大风险。本研究发现，常用的脑电特征除了支持预期的认知任务外，还可泄露参与者的身份和人口统计学属性。当前可穿戴脑电正逐步应用于认知监测、神经评估和纵向数字健康场景，但许多系统假设传输压缩的频谱或空间特征而非原始脑电数据就足以提供充分的隐私保护。以EEGMAT为案例研究发现，压缩脑电特征在认知状态分类任务上的平衡精度可达0.788，同时可分别以0.858、0.789和0.692的平衡精度推断性别、年龄和受试者身份。研究进一步表明，隐私感知表征学习可将任务性能维持在0.781，同时将上述推断精度分别降至0.563、0.467和0.206。这些研究结果表明，可穿戴神经健康系统需要引入面向功能限定的表征方案和显式的隐私审计机制。

title: Neural means and kernel corrections for operator learning
title_zh: 面向算子学习的神经网络均值与核修正方法
authors: Yitzchak Shmalo
abstract: We combine neural network means with exact Matérn kernel regressions of their residuals and of their learned features, and evaluate the pairing on two public emulation problems with published baselines: the structural-mechanics benchmark of de Hoop et al. and the OCO-2 radiative-transfer emulator of Lamminpää et al. On structural mechanics the combination reaches 4.55% test error, matching the best published architecture, and 5.38% against a published 6.49% in the low-data regime. On OCO-2 it improves on the published Gaussian-process emulator on that problem's own test points, outright on two of the three spectral bands; the same kernel that trails the network tenfold on the raw state overtakes it on the network's features, and we measure why (the target's squared native-space norm drops about fortyfold at fixed effective dimension) and prove the mechanism. Where the two families tie instead, the residuals of every architecture we train correlate above 0.86 and their shared component is flat in diversity and sample size, which reads the published plateau as a property of the data. Supporting results include a second-moment identity that predicts stacking outcomes from measured correlations, an optimal-recovery certificate, and a distribution-free coverage band, the only uncertainty signal that survives our tests.
summary_zh: 本文将神经网络均值与针对其残差和学习特征的精确Matérn核回归相结合，在两个已公开基线的公开仿真问题上对该组合方案进行评估：de Hoop等人提出的结构力学基准问题，以及Lamminpää等人提出的OCO-2辐射传输仿真器问题。在结构力学问题上，该组合方案的测试误差达到4.55%，与已公开的最优架构性能持平；在小数据场景下测试误差为5.38%，优于已公开的6.49%的结果。在OCO-2问题上，该方案在该问题的测试点上性能优于已公开的高斯过程仿真器，在三个光谱带中的两个上实现了全面提升；在原始状态下性能比神经网络差10倍的核函数，在神经网络学习得到的特征上性能反超神经网络，本文测算了背后的原因（固定有效维度下目标在原生空间的平方范数下降了约40倍）并证明了该机制。在两类方法性能持平的场景下，本文训练的所有架构的残差相关系数均高于0.86，其共享分量在多样性和样本量维度上保持平稳，说明已公开的性能平台期是数据本身的特性。支撑性研究结果包括二阶矩恒等式（可基于测得的相关系数预测堆叠结果）、最优恢复证明，以及无分布覆盖带——这是唯一通过全部测试的不确定性信号。

title: Hidden relationships in a document-derived property graph: top-k chunk embeddings and inverse-distance weighting over a dynamically evolving ontology
title_zh: 文档衍生属性图中的隐藏关联：top-k块嵌入与动态演化本体上的逆距离加权
authors: Bilge Kaan Karamete, Hunter Casten
abstract: Large language models extracting knowledge graphs from text capture only explicitly stated facts, often leaving semantically related entities disconnected across documents. We present an additive, engine-neutral second pass that discovers these latent ties without altering extracted facts. Each document is chunked and embedded once; top-k nearest- neighbor queries across existing chunks yield candidate node pairs via entity membership maps. Candidate pairs are scored using Shepard inverse-distance weighting with a rescaled chord distance metric, avoiding the threshold-collapsing flaw of affine cosine scoring behind a k-NN gate. Un-gated per-pair accumulators form a commutative monoid, ensuring the pipeline is strictly order-independent and scales incrementally without recomputing prior documents. Implemented across FalkorDB, Kinetica, ArangoDB, and Neo4j, our method shows that 768- and 240-dimensional embeddings retain 92% and 72% edge fidelity against a 3072-D baseline while achieving a 25x faster top-k formulation.
summary_zh: 从文本中提取知识图谱的大语言模型只能捕获显式陈述的事实，往往导致跨文档的语义关联实体相互断开。本文提出了一种与引擎无关的加法式二次处理方法，可在不修改已提取事实的前提下发现这些潜在关联。每个文档被分块并完成一次嵌入；通过实体成员映射，跨现有块的top-k近邻查询可生成候选节点对。采用Shepard逆距离加权和重缩放弦距离度量对候选对进行打分，避免了k-NN门控背后仿射余弦打分的阈值塌陷缺陷。无门控的逐对累加器构成交换幺半群，确保流水线严格与顺序无关，可实现增量扩展而无需重新计算历史文档。该方法在FalkorDB、Kinetica、ArangoDB和Neo4j上完成部署，实验结果表明，与3072维基线相比，768维和240维嵌入可分别保留92%和72%的边保真度，同时top-k计算速度提升25倍。

title: Towards unsupervised representation learning for quantum data: quantum models with inference and generation
title_zh: 面向量子数据无监督表征学习的探索：具备推理与生成能力的量子模型
authors: Robin Lorenz, Eric Brunner, Marcello Benedetti
abstract: With quantum sensors, simulators and networks emerging, a future of quantum technology may produce quantum states as data---that is, coherently rather than as classical measurement records---thus motivating the study of suitable quantum generalisations of modern machine learning, including the automated, unsupervised extraction of useful representations. Two ingredients are central to the latter: inference, mapping observations to latent representations, and generation, mapping latent states back to synthetic data. Both are related to each other and to joint distributions for training models by the chain-rule of classical probability theory. The fact that quantum states however lack such universal, standard factorisation property thus poses a challenge. Here we develop a conceptual and mathematical framework for unsupervised representation learning from quantum data. Models are joint quantum states over visible and latent systems; state-over-time maps provide a notion of factorisation into a marginal state and inference (generation) channel; models with inference (generation) are ambiguous states---states for which such factorisation obtains---subject to a further consistency condition on extended inference maps as data extension. These stipulations are restrictive: we show that non-trivial models must feature non-linear such maps to the extended space. For three representative state-over-time maps, we completely characterise the ambiguous states, uncovering a hierarchy tied to the positive-partial-transpose (PPT) criterion from entanglement theory. Notably, the Leifer-Spekkens construction supports inference and generation exactly for model classes of PPT states, thus allowing genuinely quantum visible-latent correlations. We also formulate quantum counterparts of exact and approximate inference training, explore weaker notions of data extension and sketch a future research programme.
