summary_zh: 随着量子传感器、模拟器和网络的兴起，未来量子技术可能生成以量子态形式存在的数据（即相干态而非经典测量记录），推动现代机器学习的量子泛化研究，包括自动无监督提取有用表征的相关研究。无监督表征学习的两个核心要素是推理（将观测映射到潜在表征）和生成（将潜在态映射回合成数据），二者相互关联，并且通过经典概率论的链式法则与模型训练的联合分布相关联。但量子态不具备这种通用的标准分解特性，带来了新的挑战。本文开发了一套面向量子数据无监督表征学习的概念与数学框架。所提出的模型是可见系统和潜在系统上的联合量子态；时序态映射提供了分解为边缘态和推理（生成）通道的定义；具备推理（生成）能力的模型是模糊态——即满足上述分解条件的态，同时还需满足扩展推理映射作为数据扩展的一致性条件。这些约束条件十分严格：研究表明非平凡模型必须具备到扩展空间的非线性映射。针对三类代表性时序态映射，本文完整刻画了对应的模糊态，揭示了与纠缠理论中正部分转置（PPT）准则相关的层级关系。值得注意的是，Leifer-Spekkens构造可精确支持PPT态模型类的推理和生成，实现真正的量子可见-潜在关联。本文还构造了精确和近似推理训练的量子对应形式，探索了更宽松的数据扩展定义，并展望了未来的研究方向。

title: Deterministic LLM Inference Across GPU Kernels: Power-of-Two INT8 Quantization Scales and the Limits of Tolerance-Based Conformance
title_zh: 跨GPU内核的确定性大语言模型推理：2次幂INT8量化缩放与基于容差的一致性验证的局限性
authors: Teng-Ruei Chen
abstract: Conformance suites for quantized GEMM kernels ask whether two implementations agree within a tolerance. We measure what such a suite can detect. Injecting nine faults into a reference INT8 pipeline over 8,232 layer--fault--regime cells of Qwen3-1.7B, we find that every one of five epilogue faults -- scale precision, double rounding, multiplication order, output truncation, fused ordering -- moves the output by at most a single bfloat16 spacing, and by exactly one whenever it moves it at all, across 5,880 cells. A tolerance of one spacing is therefore blind to the entire class by construction: four of the five faults are detected by no check in the suite, and the fifth only under power-of-two scales. Faults that violate the accumulator's exactness preconditions, or that break operand sharing, are detected without exception, and a null fault never fires. What a tolerance-based suite of this shape establishes is therefore narrower than interchangeability: that the preconditions hold, that operands are shared, and that differences stay within one spacing. The power-of-two constraint that exposes the one detected fault is also deployable. Requantizing every weight scale to its nearest power of two makes CUTLASS and Triton agree bitwise at every linear layer (196/196 and 252/252, against 8/196 and 10/252 under the checkpoints' own scales) and yields byte-identical generated token sequences at 1.7B, 8B and 14B (8/8 prompts, against 0/8 at all three). Observed perplexity point estimates are +0.32%, -0.28% and +0.48%; the 90% intervals cover zero at the two smaller sizes but not at 14B, reaching +0.71% and +0.76%. A previously reported +157% perplexity for this intervention was an artifact of a probe that rewrote scales without requantizing the weights; separating the effects attributes 99.8% of it to the resulting weight--scale mismatch rather than to the power-of-two constraint itself.
summary_zh: 面向量化GEMM内核的一致性验证套件用于判断两个实现在给定容差范围内是否一致，本文测算了这类验证套件的实际检测能力。在Qwen3-1.7B模型的8232个层-故障-场景单元中，向参考INT8流水线注入9类故障后发现，5类尾端故障（缩放精度、双重舍入、乘法顺序、输出截断、融合顺序）在5880个单元中最多只会使输出偏移一个bfloat16间隔，一旦发生偏移就恰好偏移一个间隔。因此容差设为一个间隔的验证方案从原理上就无法检测整类故障：5类故障中有4类无法被套件中的任何检查点检测到，剩下1类故障也仅在缩放因子为2次幂时才能被检测到。违反累加器精确性前提、或破坏操作数共享的故障可被全部检测到，无故障场景永远不会触发告警。因此这类基于容差的验证套件所能保证的特性远小于可互换性：仅能保证前提条件成立、操作数共享、差异不超过一个间隔。可检测故障的2次幂约束也可实际部署。将所有权重缩放因子重新量化到最近的2次幂后，CUTLASS和Triton在每一个线性层上都能实现比特级一致（在196个层上分别达到196/196和252/252，而使用原始缩放因子时仅为8/196和10/252），并且在1.7B、8B和14B模型上生成的token序列完全字节一致（8个提示全部符合，而使用原始缩放因子时全部3个模型的8个提示均无法达到一致）。观测到的困惑点估计值变化为+0.32%、-0.28%和+0.48%；90%置信区间在两个小模型上覆盖0点，但在14B模型上不覆盖，区间上限分别达到+0.71%和+0.76%。此前报道的该干预措施导致困惑度上升157%是探测程序未对权重重新量化就修改缩放因子造成的假象，效应归因显示其中99.8%的性能损失来自权重-缩放因子不匹配，而非2次幂约束本身。

title: Do LLMs Know Your Neighborhood? Auditing LLM Priors for Neighborhood-Level Mobility Prediction and Structural Alignment
title_zh: 大语言模型是否了解你的社区？面向社区级移动预测与结构对齐的大语言模型先验审计
authors: Saad Mohammad Abrar, Eesha Kurella, Arnav Dadarya, Naman Awasthi, Kazi Tasnim Zinat 等 (6 人)
abstract: Human mobility is central to urban planning, transportation, public health, and emergency response, yet fine-grained trajectory data are often proprietary, restricted, and privacy-sensitive. Large language models (LLMs) offer a potential alternative by generating plausible mobility traces and predicting individual movement, but their ability to infer aggregate neighborhood-level mobility remains unclear. We evaluate zero-shot LLMs on Census Block Group-level mobility prediction across four U.S. metropolitan areas using anonymized Cuebiq data to construct point-level, trajectory-level, and temporal mobility outcomes, paired with sociodemographic and built-environment predictors. We compare LLM predictions with supervised baselines and introduce a directional alignment analysis to test whether LLM-implied predictor effects agree with empirical OLS and Jonckheere-Terpstra trends. Supervised models achieve 0.580 average accuracy, compared with 0.435 for the best LLM, with spatial extent outcomes showing the strongest predictability but also the largest LLM-baseline gaps. Directional analysis shows that LLMs often rely on coarse, stable predictor-level priors that remain similar across outcomes and cities, including asymmetric treatment of protected-group predictors. Overall, LLMs can partially recover aggregate mobility patterns from urban context, but their predictions should not be treated as structurally grounded without auditing empirical alignment and potential bias.
summary_zh: 人类移动性是城市规划、交通、公共卫生和应急响应的核心基础，但细粒度轨迹数据通常属于专有数据，受到访问限制且存在隐私敏感问题。大语言模型（LLM）可生成合理的移动轨迹并预测个体移动行为，有望成为替代方案，但大语言模型推断聚合级社区移动性的能力尚不明确。本文使用匿名Cuebiq数据构建点级、轨迹级和时间维度的移动性结果，结合社会人口和建成环境预测变量，对美国四个大都市区的人口普查区块组级移动预测任务开展大语言模型零样本性能评估。将大语言模型预测结果与监督基线模型进行对比，引入方向对齐分析方法检验大语言模型隐含的预测变量效应是否与经验OLS和Jonckheere-Terpstra趋势一致。监督模型的平均精度为0.580，而性能最优的大语言模型仅达到0.435，空间范围类结果的可预测性最高，但大语言模型与基线的性能差距也最大。方向分析表明，大语言模型通常依赖粗粒度、稳定的预测变量级先验，这类先验在不同结果和城市间保持相似，包括对受保护群体预测变量的不对称处理。总体而言，大语言模型可从城市上下文信息中部分恢复聚合移动模式，但如果不对其经验对齐程度和潜在偏差进行审计，其预测结果不能被视为具备结构合理性。

title: Lightweight Adaptation of EEG Foundation Models for Stroke Motor Imagery Decoding: Domain Shift and Subject-Level Robustness
title_zh: 面向脑卒中运动想象解码的脑电基础模型轻量适配：域偏移与受试者级鲁棒性研究
authors: Anh T. Nguyen, Zihua Sun, Michelle J. Johnson
abstract: Motor imagery (MI) electroencephalography (EEG) decoding could support post-stroke rehabilitation, but models developed on healthy cohorts may not transfer reliably to pathological EEG. We evaluated whether Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) can efficiently adapt three pretrained EEG foundation models (i.e., LaBraM-base, REVE-base, and REVE-large) for binary left- versus right-hand MI decoding. Frozen-backbone head-only baselines and LoRA adaptation were evaluated using subject-wise five-fold cross-validation on the PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Dataset and a binary subset of the UET175 dataset comprising 30 stroke participants. On EEGMMIDB, LoRA increased accuracy to 0.822 for LaBraM-base and 0.957 for REVE-base. On UET175, all head-only models performed near chance. With LoRA, LaBraM-base remained near chance (0.499$\pm$0.009), whereas REVE-base reached 0.847$\pm$0.194 and outperformed REVE-large (0.806$\pm$0.178), indicating that increased model capacity alone did not improve stroke-domain adaptation. The strongest stroke configuration, REVE-base LoRA, was further evaluated using within-cohort leave-one-subject-out cross-validation (LOOCV), showing 0.952 mean accuracy, but subject-wise accuracy ranged from 0.586 to 1.000, revealing a small low-performing tail. Zero-shot transfer from EEGMMIDB to UET175 remained near chance (0.464$\pm$0.072). These findings show that healthy-benchmark performance does not ensure transfer to stroke EEG. Translation of EEG foundation models to pseudo-online or real-time rehabilitation BCIs should therefore include target-domain adaptation and subject-level assessment of temporal informativeness, spatial sensitivity, and physiological discriminability.
summary_zh: 运动想象（MI）脑电（EEG）解码可支撑脑卒中后康复，但在健康人群数据集上训练的模型无法可靠迁移到病理脑电场景。本文评估低秩适配（LoRA）能否高效适配三个预训练脑电基础模型（LaBraM-base、REVE-base和REVE-large），实现左右手二分类运动想象解码。在PhysioNet脑电运动/想象数据集和包含30名脑卒中受试者的UET175数据集二分子集上，采用受试者五折交叉验证对仅冻结骨干网络训练分类头的基线方案和LoRA适配方案进行对比。在EEGMMIDB数据集上，LoRA将LaBraM-base的准确率提升至0.822，将REVE-base的准确率提升至0.957。在UET175数据集上，所有仅训练分类头的模型性能接近随机猜测水平；采用LoRA后，LaBraM-base的性能仍接近随机水平（0.499±0.009），而REVE-base的准确率达到0.847±0.194，性能优于REVE-large（0.806±0.178），说明单纯提升模型容量无法改善脑卒中域适配效果。针对性能最优的配置REVE-base LoRA进一步采用队列内留一受试者交叉验证（LOOCV）评估，平均准确率达0.952，但受试者间准确率分布在0.586到1.000之间，存在少量低性能尾部样本。从EEGMMIDB到UET175的零样本迁移性能仍接近随机水平（0.464±0.072）。这些研究结果表明，在健康基准数据集上的优异性能无法保证模型可迁移到脑卒中脑电场景。脑电基础模型向伪在线或实时康复脑机接口（BCI）落地时，必须包含目标域适配步骤，同时开展受试者级的时间信息量、空间敏感度和生理区分度评估。

title: Exact Global MCMC with Denoising Diffusion
authors: Mitch Hill
abstract: This work shows that diffusion models learned with standard denoising loss can provide effective global MCMC proposals for complex high-dimensional target densities. The method is motivated by the observation that sequentially applying a forward and reverse diffusion process defines a Markov chain with a target stationary distribution for an ideal denoiser trained on samples of the target distribution. This observation can be made exact for any denoiser by applying a Metropolis-Hastings step whose acceptance ratio includes the density of the forward and reverse paths of a discrete time SDE approximation. We therefore propose to train denoising diffusion models on locally convergent MALA samples to learn global MCMC proposals. We call the composition of the global denoiser-based path sampler and a local MALA sampler Denoising Diffusion Monte Carlo (DDMC). Experiments show that DDMC can provide global proposals with high acceptance across a variety of complex target densities. Our results offer preliminary evidence that the established scaling behavior of standard diffusion training transfers directly to exact sampling from high-dimensional unnormalized densities.

title: Elite-Weighted Supervised Fine-tuning for Goal-Directed Molecular Optimization
authors: Shiyun Wa, Yifei Wang, Anna G. Green, Simone Sciabola, Ye Wang
abstract: Goal-directed optimization is essential for steering molecular generators to propose candidates with desired properties. However, it is often implemented with policy-gradient reinforcement learning, which requires a generation-trajectory log-probability whose form depends on the model architecture and generation procedure. This makes an optimizer difficult to reuse across architectures and conditional generative designs. Supervised fine-tuning needs none of that machinery, but its update is driven by a fixed dataset, so the reward never enters the update. We introduce Elite-Weighted Supervised Fine-tuning (EW-SFT), which uses reward to guide elite selection of high-scoring molecules, and updates the model by its own pretraining loss on that set. Ablations show that reward information is passed primarily through elite selection, rather than through continuous weighting within the selected set. Because the update consumes only scored molecules and the model's native loss, the same rule applies across autoregressive, masked-diffusion, and discrete-flow generators, and across de novo, motif-extension, and linker-design tasks. Under a fixed budget of 3D shape alignment oracle calls on two kinase reference compounds, EW-SFT consistently outperforms the corresponding native optimizers. It further improves goal-directed optimization under a 2D similarity oracle on four held-out references and achieves comparable performance on a sample-efficiency benchmark without a trajectory-level RL formulation. These results demonstrate that EW-SFT is a unified and effective optimizer across molecular generators, design constraints, references, and oracles.

title: Synthetic Worlds for Temporal Evaluation and Knowledge Updating in LLMs
authors: Jonathan Zheng, Zirui Shao, Alan Ritter, Wei Xu
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) rely on static pretraining corpora, causing their knowledge to become outdated over time. Existing approaches for evaluating knowledge edits either suffer from rapid contamination or rely on counterfactual edits that conflict with rigid existing knowledge. In this work, we propose a synthetic, simulation-driven framework for studying knowledge insertion in LLMs. We introduce {\sc ParallelEvents}, a benchmark of fictional yet realistic future worlds that generates coherent event trajectories for controlled evaluation, avoiding contamination while preserving consistency. Building on this dataset, we develop {\sc Synapse}, a training framework that uses model-generated data to update model parameters via mid-training and instruction tuning. This synthetic pipeline enables scalable knowledge integration without costly human-curated data. Empirically, {\sc Synapse} outperforms existing methods by 14.23\%, demonstrating that simulation-based synthetic training leads to robust and coherent knowledge insertions.

title: Generative artificial intelligence for reliable mechanistic reasoning for corrosion
authors: Bharath M N, R K Singh Raman, Alankar Alankar
abstract: Corrosion accounts for approximately 4% of global GDP, and reliable prediction is essential for timely mitigation. Machine learning effectively predicts corrosion rates from composition, microstructure, and environmental variables, but cannot explain the underlying mechanisms. A reliable approach in safety-critical materials engineering requires not only accurate retrieval but also mechanistically defensible reasoning, a capability that existing factuality metrics cannot assess. This work presents a domain-adapted retrieval-augmented generation framework for corrosion knowledge synthesis, demonstrated on magnesium alloy corrosion. Three open-weight language models (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B, Mistral-7B) are fine-tuned on 3,309 expert-verified question-answer pairs from 840 peer-reviewed papers and integrated with a hybrid dense-lexical retrieval pipeline. Retrieval augmentation produces Token F1 gains of 143-194%, with system faithfulness of 0.964 and context recall of 0.988. Blind external validation on newly published literature and in-house electrochemical data confirms trend-level generalisation. Reason Map, a proposition-graph framework, is further introduced; it independently constructs directed evidence graphs from generated answers and retrieved literature, enabling systematic detection of causal direction inversions and unsupported inferential leaps that flat factuality metrics cannot expose. The modular architecture can be applied across domains, offering a generalizable blueprint for trustworthy AI-assisted knowledge synthesis to circumvent corrosion, which can also be applied to other engineering domains.

title: Local Reference Geometry Residual Augmentation for Imbalanced Time Series Classification
authors: Chuanhang Qiu, Yanran Xu, Yue Wang, Anthony Bagnall
abstract: Imbalanced time series classification is often addressed by changing the training distribution, objective, logits, or final threshold. These interventions address important biases, yet leave a representation-level question unmeasured: after minority support is reduced, does a learned feature space remain locally reliable around minority regions? We identify a training-local geometry failure: under imbalance, minority cases can lie in sparse, rest-dominated, or mixed feature-space neighborhoods, even when the representation retains useful global class structure. To diagnose and repair this failure, we propose Local Reference Geometry (LRG), a lightweight post-hoc feature augmentation module applied between a fixed feature extractor and the classifier head. Using training features only, LRG measures local exposure and class-mixture risk, then augments each fixed feature with a standardized signed displacement from nearby training geometry and an LDA-projected residual summary. On controlled UCR/Bake Off Redux imbalance benchmarks, paired raw-versus-LRG comparisons show gains for learned, pretrained, and fixed representations, including when LRG is combined with training-level interventions and post-encoder classifier corrections. Ablations show that the gain comes from the signed local residual appended to the original feature, rather than from generic prototype distances, affinity features, scalar statistics, or VLAD-style codes. Further analyses support the proposed local-geometry failure hypothesis: minority neighborhoods become increasingly rest-exposed under imbalance, training-local risk identifies error-prone regions, and LRG gains concentrate in those high-risk regions.

title: Safin-1: Safety from Within through Memory-Native State Evolution
authors: Ming Zhang, Kaisen Yang, Shu Yu, Ermo Hua, Zhekai Chen 等 (18 人)
abstract: Long-horizon complex tasks require foundation models to accumulate information, maintain internal states, and adapt over extended interactions. Safety should be an intrinsic property of the model itself, rather than a behavioral constraint relying solely on external safeguards or post-hoc alignment such as supervised fine-tuning. This motivates Safety from Within, where safety-relevant capabilities are represented and invoked through the model's native computation. We present Safin-1, a family of foundation models realizing this principle through memory routing and state evolution. Safin-1 is built on Memory-Anchor Routing across Context History (MARCH), a network architecture that maintains structured memory states and selectively retrieves relevant historical information through content-conditioned routing. It supports test-time adaptation of persistent capability states without repeatedly modifying the backbone, enabling controlled specialization over a shared foundation. We investigate this interface on downstream safety tasks through a Safety State, demonstrating effective state-based adaptation with substantial safety improvements. More broadly, the routed-state interface unifies contextual memory and persistent capability adaptation within the model's native computation, reframing memory from a passive record of prior context into an active substrate for maintaining and evolving model behavior. Evaluations across general capabilities, long-context understanding, retrieval, and efficiency further validate Safin-1. These findings provide a path toward safety as a state-native and adaptively maintainable capability. This work is only an initial architectural exploration of Safety from Within, and substantial further work is needed to realize this broader vision.

title: Foundation models for electricity price forecasting and battery arbitrage: Can they replace market-specific forecasting models?
authors: Arkadiusz Lipiecki, Rafał Weron
abstract: Foundation models promise accurate forecasts with little or no task-specific training, but whether they can replace models designed specifically for electricity price forecasting remains unclear. We compare nine variants from five foundation model families, evaluated in zero-shot mode, with two state-of-the-art electricity price forecasting benchmarks in Germany, Poland, and Spain over 2021-2025. Their performance is assessed in terms of point and probabilistic forecasting accuracy, as well as economic value in battery energy storage arbitrage. Only the TabPFN models consistently and significantly outperform the benchmarks across all three markets and all statistical measures. However, this statistical dominance does not translate directly into economic dominance: TabPFN performs best under unlimited bids and riskier quantile-based strategies, whereas the Distributional Deep Neural Network benchmark is more profitable when risk tolerance is lower. Thus, foundation models cannot universally replace market-specific models, and their value depends on both model architecture and the decision problem.

title: Stochastic complexity of vectors containing cluster structure
authors: Daniel Nicorici, Olli Yli-Harja, Jaakko Astola
abstract: This paper studies the problem of computing the stochastic probability (shortest code length) of the encoded vectors containing cluster structure using Normalized Maximum Likelihood (NML) model. This is of great theoretical and practical importance in data clustering based on Minimum Description Length (MDL) principle, such as for estimating the best number of clusters and best cluster structure for the data. Straightforward computation of the shortest code length of the vector containing cluster structure based on the NML model requires polynomial time with respect to the size of the vector and number of clusters. We show that this is a tractable problem by introducing a recursion formula for the efficient computation of normalizing constant from the NML model. The time complexity of the new formula is linear opposed to previous polynomial time with respect to the size of the vector and number of clusters.

title: Convergence issues in Relational Concept Analysis based on AOC-posets
authors: Xavier Dolques, Agnès Braud, Alain Gutierrez, Marianne Huchard, Florence Le Ber
abstract: Formal Concept Analysis (FCA) is an approach for conceptual classification building and rule discovery from a binary table describing a set of objects by a set of attributes. Extensions have been proposed to deal with non-binary and more complex data, such as Relational Concept Analysis (RCA) for multi-relational data. RCA aims to highlight groups of objects characterized by their relationships with other groups of objects. The richer and more complex nature of the underlying data allows RCA to produce richer results than FCA, at the expense of higher computational and interpretive complexity. The most commonly used conceptual classification structure in FCA is the concept lattice. However, in many applications, concept lattice substructures, such as AOC-posets, are preferred over the full lattice, either to mitigate combinatorial blow-up or to focus on the most informative parts of the structure. Indeed, in an AOC-poset, only concepts introducing an object or an attribute are represented, which makes AOC-posets smaller and easier to compute and use than concept lattices. Although RCA was originally defined on concept lattices, it can also be instantiated on AOC-posets. RCA is iterative and its convergence is guaranteed in the lattice-based setting, but this guarantee is lost when using AOC-posets. In this paper, we investigate this loss of convergence in detail. We show why convergence is no longer guaranteed in the general case, identify conditions under which it can still be ensured, and discuss how a dataset can be transformed to recover convergence. We also propose a convergent variant of the process, which preserves the AOC-poset structure: relational attributes, once created, are never removed, which guarantees convergence at the price of attributes that may refer to concepts absent from the final structures.

title: AgentProv: Auditing Agentic LLM API Providers via Tool-use Policy Probes
authors: Xun Wang, Bihe Zhao, Michael Backes, Franziska Boenisch, Adam Dziedzic
abstract: Commercial LLM APIs advertise a specific foundation model, but the served backbone may be silently substituted, quantized, or wrapped, for example to save deployment costs. All existing audits decide backbone identity from the text-output channel, which is structurally fragile for agentic APIs because modern serving stacks (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Cloudflare Workers AI, LangGraph) discard text and expose only structured actions when the model calls a tool, and provider-injected system prompts can distort text distributions enough that text-channel tests falsely accuse honest providers of substituting the claimed model. We observe that recent agentic post-training internalizes tool-use directly into the weights, opening a new audit channel that the serving stack still exposes and that is largely invariant to deployment context. We introduce Agentic Provenance (AgentProv), the first action-based identity audit for agentic LLM APIs: AgentProv fingerprints a deployed model through its categorical tool-call distribution and decides identity via an MMD permutation test. AgentProv catches every substituted model (100% on 630 evaluated checkpoint pairs), while holding the false-positive rate under system-prompt injection at 7% (vs. 67% for MET and 53% for RUT). On third-party API endpoints, AgentProv's disagreements with MET are consistent with an independent token-count side-channel that detects provider-injected system prompts.

title: Dense Weak Hiding: Closing Complexity Gaps in Nonconvex and PL Finite-Sum Optimization under Individual Smoothness
title_zh: 密集弱隐藏（Dense Weak Hiding）：个体平滑性条件下非凸与PL有限和优化的复杂度差距弥合
authors: Yuxing Peng, Zhiqing Tang, Weijia Jia
abstract: Under individual smoothness, the optimal incremental first-order oracle (IFO) complexity of nonconvex finite-sum optimization has remained open. Known algorithms use $O(n+\sqrt{n}\,\Delta L_{\max}/\varepsilon^2)$ calls, while prior lower bounds miss a factor of $\sqrt{n}$. We prove the matching lower bound for randomized IFO algorithms whose component indices and query points may depend on the complete preceding transcript and private randomness. This determines the minimax IFO complexity up to universal constants under both individual and mean-squared smoothness.Under the global Polyak-Lojasiewicz (PL) condition, the standard PAGE guarantee is not tight when $\kappa_{\mathrm{ms}}<\sqrt{n}$. Restarted PAGE attains $O(n+n\log(\Delta/\varepsilon)/(1+\log(\sqrt{n}/\kappa_{\mathrm{ms}})))$ for $1\leq\kappa_{\mathrm{ms}}\leq\sqrt{n}$, and $O(n+\kappa_{\mathrm{ms}}\sqrt{n}\log(\Delta/\varepsilon))$ for $\kappa_{\mathrm{ms}}\geq\sqrt{n}$. We prove matching lower bounds under individual smoothness for every $\kappa_{\max}\geq 3$; the same hard instances also give the mean-squared lower bounds. In the small-$\kappa_{\max}$ range, their average objective is globally strongly convex.Our lower bounds use dense weak hiding. A fixed sign table spreads each hidden direction across the components. Each queried row carries little information, while the exact row average preserves the full signal after rescaling. A bounded radial map handles arbitrary query points, and a smooth gate makes unopened links invisible to both function values and gradients. Balancing the rows needed to reveal one stage with the number of stages allowed by individual smoothness yields the missing $\sqrt{n}$ factor.
summary_zh: 在个体平滑性条件下，非凸有限和优化的最优增量一阶神谕（Incremental First-order Oracle, IFO）复杂度长期处于未知状态。现有算法的调用复杂度为$O(n+\sqrt{n}\,\Delta L_{\max}/\varepsilon^2)$，而此前的下界结果缺失了一个$\sqrt{n}$因子。本文针对随机IFO算法证明了匹配的下界，这类算法的分量索引与查询点可依赖完整的历史记录与私有随机性，由此确定了个体平滑性与均方平滑性条件下的极小极大IFO复杂度（仅差通用常数系数）。在全局Polyak-Lojasiewicz（PL）条件下，当$\kappa_{\mathrm{ms}}<\sqrt{n}$时，标准PAGE算法的性能保证并不紧致。重启PAGE算法在$1\leq\kappa_{\mathrm{ms}}\leq\sqrt{n}$时可达到复杂度$O(n+n\log(\Delta/\varepsilon)/(1+\log(\sqrt{n}/\kappa_{\mathrm{ms}})))$，在$\kappa_{\mathrm{ms}}\geq\sqrt{n}$时可达到复杂度$O(n+\kappa_{\mathrm{ms}}\sqrt{n}\log(\Delta/\varepsilon))$。本文针对任意$\kappa_{\max}\geq 3$，在个体平滑性条件下证明了匹配的下界，对应的困难实例同样可推导得到均方平滑性条件下的下界；在$\kappa_{\max}$较小时，困难实例的平均目标函数满足全局强凸性。本文的下界证明采用了密集弱隐藏技术：固定符号表将每个隐藏方向分散到各个分量中，每个被查询的行几乎不携带有效信息，而行均值经过缩放后可保留完整信号；有界径向映射可处理任意查询点，平滑门函数可让未开启的链路对函数值与梯度均不可见。通过平衡揭示单个阶段所需的行数与个体平滑性允许的阶段总数，最终推导出此前缺失的$\sqrt{n}$因子。

title: ES-AHD: An Evolution Strategy Framework for Automatic Heuristic Design
title_zh: ES-AHD：面向自动启发式设计的进化策略框架
authors: Yutao Lai, Kezhao Lai, Hai-Lin Liu, Yuping Wang, Ping Guo
abstract: In this paper, we introduce ES-AHD, a novel framework that fundamentally integrates Evolution Strategy (ES) into Large Language Model (LLM)-driven Automatic Heuristic Design (AHD). Existing evolutionary approaches predominantly rely on random, individual-level mutation, leading to blind search and an imbalance between exploration and exploitation. To address these issues, ES-AHD introduces two core mechanisms. First, Semantic Recombination via LLMs discards traditional point-to-point reproduction. By leveraging the LLM's contextual reasoning to explicitly extract core insights from top-performing individuals, the algorithm establishes a promising semantic search direction. This transforms random code mutation into targeted, center-guided sampling inspired by ES. Second, Stochastic Covariance Adaptation via Temperature Sampling dynamically addresses the exploration-exploitation dilemma. By mapping the covariance matrix in ES to the LLM's sampling temperature, the framework employs a stochastic random walk mechanism with momentum. This approach primarily shrinks the search radius for micro-level code refinement, while retaining the critical ability to occasionally sample higher temperatures to escape semantic local optima. Ultimately, ES-AHD provides a highly directional, robust, and efficient search paradigm, significantly accelerating the generation of high-quality heuristic algorithms. The source code is available at:this https URL.
summary_zh: 本文提出ES-AHD这一全新框架，将进化策略（Evolution Strategy, ES）深度融入大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）驱动的自动启发式设计（Automatic Heuristic Design, AHD）流程。现有进化方法大多依赖随机的个体层级变异，存在搜索盲目、探索与利用失衡的问题。为解决上述问题，ES-AHD引入两项核心机制：第一，基于大语言模型的语义重组机制摒弃了传统的点对点繁殖模式，利用大语言模型的上下文推理能力从表现优异的个体中显式提取核心洞察，构建有前景的语义搜索方向，将随机代码变异转化为受进化策略启发的、以中心为引导的定向采样；第二，基于温度采样的随机协方差自适应机制动态解决探索-利用困境，通过将进化策略中的协方差矩阵映射为大语言模型的采样温度，框架采用带动量的随机游走机制，主要缩小微代码优化的搜索半径，同时保留偶尔采样更高温度以逃离语义局部最优的关键能力。最终ES-AHD提供了高定向性、鲁棒且高效的搜索范式，可显著加速高质量启发式算法的生成。相关源代码可访问对应公开链接获取。

title: StudentSim: Training LLM-based Student Simulators
title_zh: StudentSim：训练基于大语言模型的学生模拟器
authors: Ke Yang, Chenglong Wang, Michel Galley, Chandan Singh, Jeevana Priya Inala 等 (7 人)
abstract: AI tutors are most useful when they adapt to each student's strengths, weaknesses, and preferred guidance, but evidence about which guidance works for which student is sparse, slow, and costly to collect from real learners. Student simulators can provide this signal as a proxy, yet existing approaches are limited: state-tracking models fit student behavior but struggle to process explanations or corrections, while LLM role-play follows guidance fluently but does not reliably match the competence of the student being imitated. We present StudentSim, a training framework that turns sparse per-student data into individualized simulators through pooled training followed by per-student specialization. The resulting simulators both mirror a student's own responses and update them under tutor guidance. We also introduce StudentSimEval, a standardized protocol covering 60 students across chess, second-language English writing, and mathematics, using public learner datasets with de-identified records shared for research. StudentSimEval measures behavioral fidelity (F), or how well a simulator matches a student's responses, and guidance responsiveness (R), or how readily it updates under tutor guidance, with all methods fit and evaluated on the same records. Across all three domains, StudentSim outperforms GPT-5.4 on both metrics. In chess, StudentSim reaches F=0.51 and R=0.91, compared with 0.23 and 0.72 for GPT-5.4 and 0.45 and 0.27 for Maia2. As a proof of concept, using StudentSim as a reward model for tutor reinforcement learning produces a chess tutor that expert humans rate as more accurate, better-guided, and more personalized than a no-RL baseline and a tutor trained against a GPT-5.4 simulator reward. Code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 人工智能辅导系统只有适配每个学生的优势、劣势与偏好指导方式时才能发挥最大作用，但从真实学习者中采集“何种指导适配何种学生”的相关证据存在数据稀疏、效率低、成本高的问题。学生模拟器可作为代理提供这类信号，但现有方案存在明显局限：状态跟踪模型可拟合学生行为，但难以处理解释或修正内容；大语言模型角色扮演方案可流畅遵循指导，但无法可靠匹配被模拟学生的真实能力水平。本文提出StudentSim这一训练框架，通过集中训练后执行学生专属微调，将稀疏的单学生数据转化为个性化模拟器，生成的模拟器既可以复刻学生自身的响应模式，也能在辅导者的指导下更新响应。本文还提出StudentSimEval这一标准化评估协议，覆盖国际象棋、二语英语写作、数学三个领域的60名学生，采用经过去标识化处理的公开学习者数据集开展研究。StudentSimEval从行为保真度（F，即模拟器匹配学生响应的程度）与指导响应性（R，即模拟器在辅导者指导下更新自身行为的意愿程度）两个维度开展评估，所有方法均在相同数据集上完成训练与评估。在全部三个领域中，StudentSim在两项指标上的表现均优于GPT-5.4：在国际象棋场景下，StudentSim的F值为0.51、R值为0.91，对比之下GPT-5.4的两项指标为0.23和0.72，Maia2的两项指标为0.45和0.27。作为概念验证实验，将StudentSim作为辅导系统强化学习的奖励模型训练得到的国际象棋辅导器，经人类专家评估，其准确度、指导质量与个性化程度均优于无强化学习基线、以及基于GPT-5.4模拟器奖励训练的辅导器。相关代码可访问对应公开链接获取。

title: Closing Cost-Quality Gap in Document VLMs: Difficulty-Aware Data Curation and Quality-Adjusted Deployment Economics
title_zh: 缩小文档视觉语言模型（VLM）的成本-质量差距：难度感知数据策管与质量调整部署经济性
authors: Maksim Evdokimov, Matvey Ivanov, Dmitrii Tsiupin, Olga Tsymboi, Anatolii Potapov 等 (6 人)
abstract: Extracting structured fields from hundreds of millions of documents annually remains costly in regulated industries: bespoke OCR cascades cover only a fraction of workflows, privacy rules preclude external models, and existing open-source VLMs that clear quality thresholds cost more to serve than human annotation. We present a deployed document-understanding system built on a Mixture-of-Experts VLM (35B total, 3B active), fine-tuned on in-house production data mixed with open-domain documents curated by a Difficulty-Aware pipeline for layout diversity, fact-extractability, and cross-model consistency. Fitting on a single H100 and serving heterogeneous workflows via prompting, the model leads all deployable (non-reasoning) baselines up to an order of magnitude larger. A quality-adjusted cost analysis, with confirmation and correction costs calibrated from production telemetry, shows it reduces expected costs by over 80% against the human baseline and by more than 50% against the best competing open-source model, while larger baselines remain economically unviable.
summary_zh: 在监管严格的行业中，每年从数亿份文档中提取结构化字段的成本始终居高不下：定制化OCR级联方案仅能覆盖部分工作流，隐私规则限制了外部模型的使用，而现有达到质量阈值的开源视觉语言模型（VLM）的服务成本甚至高于人工标注成本。本文提出一套已落地的文档理解系统，该系统基于总参数量350亿、激活参数量30亿的专家混合视觉语言模型构建，使用内部生产数据与经过难度感知流水线策管的开放域文档混合微调，策管流程重点保障布局多样性、事实可提取性与跨模型一致性。该模型可在单张H100显卡上完成微调，通过提示词即可适配异构工作流，性能超过所有参数量最高达其10倍的可部署（非推理类）基线模型。基于生产遥测数据校准确认与修正成本后开展的质量调整成本分析显示，该系统相比人工基线可降低80%以上的预期成本，相比最优的同类开源模型可降低50%以上的预期成本，而参数量更大的基线模型在经济层面仍不具备落地可行性。

title: From Production Traffic to Post-Training: Building a Self-Hosted LLM That Covers the Corporate Request Mix
authors: Olga Tsymboi, Dmitrii Stoianov, Ramil Latypov, Danil Taranets, Daniil Dryabin 等 (14 人)
abstract: Data-residency constraints force enterprises to self-host LLMs, but continuous adoption of newer models without decommissioning their predecessors expands the serving fleet, fragmenting a finite GPU pool. We consolidate traffic from over 200 internal applications onto a single model by closing quality gaps identified through production error analysis along three axes: instruction following, function-calling, and internal task distribution. Quality is tracked by offline benchmarks stratified to production traffic and scored by deterministic verifiers or calibrated LLM judges. Rather than optimising all objectives jointly, which introduces cross-domain reward interference, we train a separate GRPO expert per axis and merge them via two-stage SLERP. Each expert's reward exposes a distinct failure mode, namely semantic collapse, over-calling, and verbosity hacking, each requiring a domain-specific fix. In non-reasoning mode the recipe surpasses a ${\sim}7\times$ larger by total parameters baseline on the in-house Arena with 69.6 to 65.8, instruction following with 0.85 to 0.83, and function-calling with 0.79 to 0.77, while lifting general dialogue benchmarks. The model absorbs 50% of platform traffic, 116M requests per month, at a fraction of the serving cost.

title: A systematic Approach to constructing a Chance-and-Risk Matrix for Semiconductor Supply Chains
title_zh: 构建半导体供应链机遇与风险矩阵的系统化方法
authors: Ema Salkić, Alexander Fichtl, Philipp Ulrich, Hans Ehm, Marta Bonik 等 (6 人)
abstract: Semiconductor supply chains face escalating risks from geopolitical tensions, geographic concentration, and rapid technological shifts, yet no scalable system continuously extracts, structures, and prioritizes risk intelligence from public corporate disclosures. We present an end-to-end pipeline that retrieves corporate documents for semiconductor companies and uses large language models (LLMs) to extract the risks and opportunities they describe. It organizes these into a knowledge graph linking each item to its category, sources, and related events, then merges duplicates and ranks them with a three-layer mechanism combining an algorithmic formula, an LLM relevance adjustment, and expert validation. Applied to five companies across the value chain, the pipeline produces 76,207 scored items, of which an independent check finds 92.6% valid. The automated rankings match expert judgment at an average Spearman correlation of 0.55 for risks and 0.72 for opportunities, and the resulting matrices identify trade restrictions as the dominant cross-company risk.
summary_zh: 半导体供应链正面临地缘政治紧张、产业地理集中、技术快速迭代带来的持续升级风险，但目前尚无可扩展的系统能够持续从公开企业披露信息中提取、结构化风险情报并完成优先级排序。本文提出一套端到端流水线，可检索半导体企业的公开文档，利用大语言模型提取文档中描述的风险与机遇，将其组织为知识图谱，把每个条目关联到对应类别、信息源与相关事件，随后合并重复条目，通过融合算法公式、大语言模型相关性调整、专家验证的三层机制完成条目排序。将该流水线应用于半导体价值链上的5家企业后，共生成76207条带评分的条目，独立校验显示其中92.6%的条目有效。自动排序结果与专家判断的平均斯皮尔曼相关系数在风险维度为0.55，在机遇维度为0.72，最终生成的矩阵识别出贸易限制是所有企业共同面临的首要风险。

title: SDARE-Bench: Evaluating Large Language Models on Conversational Stigma Detection and Response in Dyadic and Group Dialogue
title_zh: SDARE-Bench：评估大语言模型在二元对话与群组对话场景下的污名检测与响应能力
authors: Stephanie Fong, Yiwen Jiang, Zimu Wang, Hongxi Yang, Yaling Shen 等 (15 人)
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in advice seeking and decision making that may affect social judgements. Despite stigma's profound effects on people and communities, benchmarks remain scarce. Existing general-domain evaluations typically rely on static prompts and fixed-format tasks, overlooking conversational contexts and audience effects in everyday communication. To address these gaps, we introduce SDARE-Bench, the first scenario-based benchmark evaluating both stigma detection and open-ended response generation in LLMs, comprising 1,138 dyadic queries and 1,388 group dialogue. Empirical results across 8 LLMs consistently demonstrate poor identification of stigma components, especially in group dialogues. In open-ended response generation, stigma expression was substantially higher in group settings than in dyadic, with weaker resistance to stigma and more unrealistic advice. Responses were evaluated using a classifier trained on 1,392 human annotated responses. In constructed group pressure settings, stigma expression rates further increased to a striking average of 97.5%. Our findings identify stigma response as a recurring LLM safety vulnerability, especially in socially complex conversational contexts.
summary_zh: 大语言模型正越来越多地应用于可能影响社会判断的咨询与决策场景中，尽管污名现象对个人与社群存在深远影响，但目前相关基准评估数据集仍十分稀缺。现有通用领域评估大多依赖静态提示词与固定格式任务，忽略了日常交流中的对话上下文与受众效应。针对这一缺口，本文提出SDARE-Bench这一首个基于场景的基准数据集，可同时评估大语言模型的污名检测能力与开放式响应生成能力，数据集包含1138条二元对话查询与1388条群组对话样本。在8个主流大语言模型上开展的实证结果一致显示，现有模型对污名组成部分的识别能力较差，在群组对话场景下表现尤为明显；在开放式响应生成任务中，群组场景下生成内容的污名表达程度远高于二元对话场景，模型对污名的抵抗能力更弱，生成的不切实际建议也更多。研究使用在1392条人工标注响应上训练的分类器对生成结果开展评估，在构造的群体压力场景下，模型生成内容的污名表达率平均高达97.5%。研究结果表明，污名响应是大语言模型普遍存在的安全漏洞，在社会关系复杂的对话场景下问题尤为突出。

title: Knowledge Distillation During Mid-Training Favors Reasoning over Factual Recall
title_zh: 训练中期的知识蒸馏更偏向提升推理能力而非事实回忆能力
authors: Jacqueline He, Howard Yen, Shuyue Stella Li, Margaret Li, Hanqing Zeng 等 (12 人)
abstract: Logit-based knowledge distillation (KD) is used to train smaller language models (LMs) via supervision from stronger teachers, but whether its benefits are consistent across training stages remains unclear. Through controlled experiments, we find that forward Kullback-Leibler (KL) distillation--the standard KD formulation--with post-trained teachers behaves fundamentally differently during mid-training, an intermediate phase of self-supervised learning on curated corpora. Surprisingly, while forward KD simultaneously improves reasoning and factual recall during pre-training relative to standard next-token prediction (NTP), it instead slows factual recall acquisition during mid-training despite continued reasoning gains. We trace this stage dependence to an asymmetry in teacher confidence across data domains and the student's evolving knowledge state: teachers are more confident on procedural than knowledge-intensive data, while students acquire low-entropy factual knowledge earlier in training. To mitigate this imbalance, we propose Switch Distillation, a simple mid-training objective that distills on tokens where the teacher is confident, using teacher predictive entropy as a lightweight routing signal, and otherwise falls back to cross-entropy. Switch Distillation consistently outperforms existing distillation objectives across teacher sizes. Relative to standard NTP, it achieves 1.61-1.71x the reasoning performance and 1.13-1.19x the knowledge and commonsense performance while preserving 96.7-96.8% of factual recall. Crucially, these benefits persist after post-training: Switch Distillation closes the factual recall gap while maintaining 1.25-1.32x and 1.13-1.20x gains in reasoning and knowledge and commonsense, respectively.
summary_zh: 基于对数概率的知识蒸馏（KD）通过更强的教师模型提供监督信号来训练小规模语言模型，但该方法在不同训练阶段的收益是否一致此前尚不明确。通过对照实验，本文发现采用预训练后教师模型的前向KL散度蒸馏（即标准知识蒸馏范式），在自监督学习的中间阶段（训练中期）的表现与常规模式存在本质差异。令人意外的是，与标准的下一词预测（NTP）相比，前向KL蒸馏在预训练阶段可同时提升推理能力与事实回忆能力，但在训练中期阶段，尽管推理能力仍持续提升，事实回忆能力的获取速度却会下降。本文将这种阶段依赖性归因于教师模型在不同数据域上的置信度不对称性、以及学生模型知识状态的动态演化：教师模型在过程类数据上的置信度高于知识密集型数据，而学生模型在训练早期就已掌握低熵的事实知识。为缓解这一失衡问题，本文提出Switch Distillation这一简单的训练中期目标函数，仅在教师模型置信度高的token上执行蒸馏，将教师模型的预测熵作为轻量级路由信号，其余场景下回退到交叉熵损失。Switch Distillation在不同参数量的教师模型上的表现均优于现有蒸馏目标函数：与标准下一词预测相比，其推理性能达到后者的1.61-1.71倍，知识与常识性能达到后者的1.13-1.19倍，同时保留了96.7%-96.8%的事实回忆能力。关键的是，上述收益在训练后阶段依然存在：Switch Distillation在弥合事实回忆差距的同时，推理能力仍保持1.25-1.32倍的提升，知识与常识能力仍保持1.13-1.20倍的提升。

title: AutoConcept: Training-Free Concept-Guided Reranking for Metadata-Available Composed Image Retrieval
title_zh: AutoConcept：面向元数据可用的组合图像检索的免训练概念引导重排序方法
authors: Tianyu Wang, Tianjiao Wu
abstract: Composed image retrieval (CIR) retrieves a target image from a reference image and a text modification. This paper studies metadata-available CIR reranking, where a fixed CIR model first returns a candidate pool and gallery metadata is then used for second-stage concept-guided scoring. We introduce AutoConcept, a training-free reranker that converts concept evidence into an interpretable memory. AutoConcept filters noisy concepts, activates query-relevant positive constraints with an auxiliary negative penalty, and combines base retrieval scores with metadata-based concept-candidate alignment through inference-time calibration. On FashionIQ, AutoConcept yields significant early-rank improvements over WeiMoCIR and consistent plug-in gains on LinCIR candidate pools. Metadata-aware controls show that structured concept memory adds signal beyond direct query-text and extracted-attribute matching, while a query-only variant further supports the effectiveness of concept-level reranking. A supplementary real-human concept-label study indicates that the same memory interface can consume participant-provided evidence. These results position AutoConcept as an interpretable concept-memory reranker for product-style CIR galleries with available metadata.
summary_zh: 组合图像检索（CIR）任务基于参考图像与文本修改描述检索目标图像，本文研究元数据可用场景下的组合图像检索重排序问题：即首先通过固定的组合图像检索模型返回候选集，随后利用图库元数据在第二阶段开展概念引导打分。本文提出AutoConcept这一免训练重排序器，可将概念证据转化为可解释的记忆模块。AutoConcept过滤噪声概念，通过辅助负向惩罚激活与查询相关的正向约束，在推理阶段完成校准，将基础检索得分与基于元数据的概念-候选对齐结果融合。在FashionIQ数据集上，AutoConcept相比WeiMoCIR可显著提升高排名区间的检索性能，在LinCIR生成的候选集上也可获得稳定的即插即用性能增益。元数据对照实验表明，结构化概念记忆可提供超出直接查询文本匹配、提取属性匹配的额外信号，仅使用查询信息的变体模型也进一步验证了概念层级重排序的有效性。配套的人类概念标注研究显示，该记忆接口也可使用参与者提供的自定义证据。上述结果表明AutoConcept是面向带可用元数据的商品类组合图像检索图库的可解释概念记忆重排序器。

title: HarnessDev: Can LLMs Create and Evolve Their Own Agent Harness?
title_zh: HarnessDev：大语言模型能否创建并迭代自身的智能体运行框架？
authors: Yuhao Wu, Jingyuan Zhang, Jiajun Shi, Xinping Lei, Qingshui Gu 等 (19 人)
abstract: As agents move from research prototypes to deployed tools, their capability increasingly depends on model-external execution infrastructure, commonly termed the agent harness. Changing this harness while holding model weights fixed can substantially alter task performance. Current agent evaluations typically report downstream performance under a chosen harness, leaving a model's ability to develop the harness itself comparatively underexplored. We introduce HarnessDev, a benchmark that shifts the unit of evaluation from task outputs to runnable infrastructure. HarnessDev covers two stages. In Creation, the agent starts from a minimal seed and a small number of cases, then builds a complete execution system. In Evolution, it starts from its own created harness and iteratively revises it using downstream execution feedback, with the goal of improving benchmark performance. We then evaluate each constructed harness on capability (task success on held-out benchmarks) and efficiency (execution-token cost). The reported Creation results cover six creator LLMs, four domains, and five downstream benchmarks totaling 2,207 unique downstream instances, with hidden evaluation tasks withheld from development. We find that generated harnesses remain substantially behind mature human-engineered references on code and on search and research, while matching or exceeding the selected references on writing and machine-learning experimentation, with large variation in execution cost. Evolution produces some performance gains, but they are unstable and transfer only partially to held-out tasks. Experiments with a fixed runtime model further show that the gains depend strongly on the model executing the harness, indicating limited transfer across models.
summary_zh: 随着智能体从研究原型转向落地工具，其性能越来越依赖于模型之外的执行基础设施，即通常所说的智能体运行框架（agent harness）。在固定模型权重的前提下修改该运行框架可显著改变任务表现，但现有智能体评估通常仅报告选定框架下的下游任务性能，对模型自主开发运行框架的能力研究仍较为匮乏。本文提出HarnessDev这一基准，将评估单元从任务输出转向可运行的基础设施。HarnessDev包含两个阶段：创建阶段中，智能体从最小种子环境与少量样例出发，构建完整的执行系统；迭代阶段中，智能体基于自身创建的初始运行框架，利用下游执行反馈迭代修改，目标是提升基准任务性能。研究随后从能力（预留基准任务的成功率）与效率（执行token成本）两个维度评估所有生成的运行框架。已公开的创建阶段结果覆盖6个大语言模型开发者、4个领域、5个下游基准，共包含2207个独立下游实例，所有评估任务均未在开发阶段公开。研究发现，生成的运行框架在代码开发、搜索研究场景下的性能仍大幅落后于成熟的人工开发参考框架，但在写作、机器学习实验场景下的表现已达到甚至超过选定的参考框架，不同生成框架的执行成本差异极大。迭代阶段可带来一定的性能提升，但这类提升并不稳定，且仅能部分迁移到预留任务上。基于固定运行时模型的对照实验进一步表明，性能提升效果高度依赖于执行该运行框架的模型，跨模型迁移能力十分有限。

title: Citing Less Critically: LLMs Reshape the Rhetoric and Reach of Scientific Citation
title_zh: 批判性引用减少：大语言模型重塑科学引用的修辞属性与传播范围
authors: Yixuan Liu, Lin Chen, Zhuoqi Liu, Jianglin Lu, Dakota Murray
abstract: Scientific citations carry rhetorical intent. Scholars may cite prior work positively (supporting), negatively (contrasting), or neutrally (mentioning). As large language models (LLMs) increasingly assist scientific writing, whether they reproduce citations with the same rhetorical intent as humans remains unclear. We introduce a masked-citation task to compare human and LLM-generated citation behavior. For each citation context, an LLM generates a replacement citation sentence, producing a counterfactual corpus directly comparable to human citation. We analyze what, whom, and how models cite, using an LLM-as-a-judge to classify citation intent and a 20-million-edge coauthorship network to measure social distance between cited authors. Across six popular LLMs and 1,746 top NLP conference papers (63k+ contexts, 132k+ citations), three patterns emerge: (1) Compared with human citation, LLMs cite significantly less critically; (2) LLMs over-cite popular and older papers, a tendency amplified for contrasting citations where human writing more often draws on recent, niche work; (3) Whereas humans often cite within their close social network, especially for supporting citations, LLMs tend to draw on more socially distant authors. Together, these differences are double-edged: LLM citation reaches beyond a scholar's close collaborators while being less critical and amplifying visibility bias, reshaping the rhetoric and reach of scientific citation.
summary_zh: 科学引用承载着修辞意图：学者可能以正面（支持）、负面（对比）或中性（提及）的方式引用前人工作。随着大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地辅助科研写作，它们生成的引用是否能复刻人类的修辞意图目前尚不明确。本文提出掩码引用任务，用于对比人类与大模型生成的引用行为：针对每个引用上下文，由大模型生成替换引用句，构建可直接与人类引用对比的反事实语料库。研究使用大模型裁判方法对引用意图分类，结合包含2000万条边的合著者网络衡量被引作者间的社会距离，分析模型引用的内容、对象与方式。基于6款主流大模型、1746篇NLP顶会论文（覆盖6.3万余个上下文、13.2万余次引用）的实验得到三个规律：（1）与人类引用相比，大模型的批判性引用占比显著更低；（2）大模型过度引用热门、较早的文献，该倾向在对比类引用中被进一步放大——而人类写作的对比类引用通常更倾向于引用近年的小众工作；（3）人类往往在自身紧密社交网络内引用，尤其是支持类引用，而大模型更倾向于引用社会距离更远的作者。上述差异是双刃剑：大模型引用突破了学者的紧密合作者圈层，但同时批判性不足、放大了可见度偏差，最终重塑了科学引用的修辞属性与传播范围。

title: From Rollouts to Recipes: Self-Contained Post-Training for LLMs
title_zh: 从统一Rollout到定制化方案：大语言模型的自包含后训练方法
authors: Yifei Li, Lingling Zhang, Muye Huang, Zihan Ma, Jiashuai Liu 等 (6 人)
abstract: Post-training large language models usually applies a single training recipe to all samples, even though the model's own rollouts reveal different sample-level learning states. We propose Self-Routing, a behavior-conditioned post-training framework that uses rollout correctness and confidence to decide how each sample should be optimized. Depending on its behavior state, a sample is routed to GRPO, on-policy self-distillation, regularization, or skipping, allowing training to adapt without external teachers, extra annotations, or additional sampling. Experiments on mathematical reasoning across Qwen3 and Qwen3.5 backbones show that Self-Routing consistently improves over uniform GRPO, uniform OPSD, fixed mixtures, and simpler routing baselines. Further analyses show that the routing distribution changes over training and reduces unnecessary updates on low-signal or already stable samples.
summary_zh: 大语言模型的后训练通常对所有样本采用统一训练方案，即便模型自身的rollout输出已经体现出不同样本层面的学习状态差异。本文提出Self-Routing（自路由）这一行为条件后训练框架，利用rollout的正确性和置信度决定每个样本的优化方式：根据自身行为状态，样本会被路由至GRPO（分组相对策略优化）、同策略自蒸馏、正则化模块，或直接跳过训练，无需外部教师、额外标注或额外采样即可实现训练自适应。基于Qwen3和Qwen3.5骨干网络的数学推理实验表明，自路由方法的效果始终优于统一GRPO、统一同策略自蒸馏、固定混合策略以及更简单的路由基线方法。进一步分析显示，路由分布会随训练过程动态变化，可减少对低信号或已处于稳定状态样本的不必要更新。

title: When Tokenization is Secretly Output Supervision
title_zh: 分词实则是隐性的输出监督
authors: Tanja Baeumel, Josef van Genabith, Simon Ostermann
abstract: Tokenization in language models is treated by default as an input preprocessing decision. We argue that this framing is incomplete: in autoregressive models, tokenizer granularity determines what the model must resolve in a single forward pass, and therefore the supervision signal it receives. This affects both the difficulty of the learning problem and the representations that emerge inside the model. We test this in a controlled experiment on numeric reasoning with a novel decoupling of input and output tokenization. As the output supervision view predicts, differences in task performance, training dynamics, and model internals are induced by output tokenization and largely invariant to input tokenization. This may matter in practice, because models with different tokenization strategies differ not only in input representation but in the task they were trained on. Comparisons between models may thus partly reflect task definition rather than ability. A survey of 120 recent *CL papers on numeric reasoning confirms that this is rarely acknowledged: only about 10% report the numeric tokenization of the models they evaluate, while 69% compare across tokenization, and thus supervision, regimes without reporting it. While prior work documents that tokenization consistently affects model performance, there is no principled account of why. We argue that framing tokenization as output supervision provides that account.
summary_zh: 语言模型的分词默认被视为一种输入预处理决策。本文指出该认知框架并不完整：在自回归模型中，分词器的粒度决定了模型需要在单次前向传播中求解的内容，进而决定了模型接收到的监督信号，这既会影响学习任务的难度，也会影响模型内部生成的表征。本文通过解耦输入分词与输出分词，在数值推理任务上开展对照实验，结果完全符合输出监督视角的预测：任务性能、训练动态和模型内部表征的差异均由输出分词引发，且几乎不受输入分词影响。该结论具备实际意义：采用不同分词策略的模型不仅在输入表征上存在差异，其训练的目标任务本身就不同，因此模型间的性能对比部分反映的是任务定义差异而非能力差异。针对120篇近年ACL数值推理相关论文的调研证实该问题极少被关注：仅约10%的论文报告了所评估模型的数值分词规则，69%的论文在未说明的情况下跨不同分词（即不同监督）机制开展对比。现有研究已证实分词会持续影响模型性能，但始终缺乏对背后机制的系统性解释，本文提出的分词即输出监督框架填补了这一空白。

title: Polish ModernBERT: The Long and Short of Polish Language Understanding
title_zh: 波兰语ModernBERT：波兰语语言理解的长文本与短文本能力研究
authors: Michał Perełkiewicz, Sławomir Dadas, Rafał Poświata, Małgorzata Grębowiec
abstract: Encoder-only Transformers remain effective for discriminative and representation-learning tasks, yet Polish encoders still largely rely on BERT/RoBERTa-style architectures. We introduce \textbf{Polish ModernBERT}, a family of four Polish encoders available at Base and Large scales, each with 512-token and 8K context variants. We adapt the ModernBERT pretraining recipe through staged selection experiments and release a long-context benchmark covering legal topic classification, ideological decision-direction prediction, factual-consistency assessment over literary plot summaries, and human-rights violation assessment. Across 30 tasks, Polish ModernBERT achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated Polish encoders, reaching 83.99 and 85.11 for the Base-8K and Large-8K models, respectively. On long-context tasks, the 8K variants improve over matched Polish RoBERTa-8K baselines from 67.47 to 77.15 and from 75.88 to 78.49 at the Base and Large scales, respectively. The Base-8K model achieves this gain with 22\% fewer parameters (149M vs.\ 190M). Efficiency measurements in representative inference setups show lower peak memory usage and latency than matched Polish RoBERTa baselines in both 512-token and 8K settings. Polish ModernBERT-8K-Base additionally achieves the best result on a Polish retrieval benchmark among the evaluated encoders below 300M parameters.
summary_zh: 仅含编码器的Transformer架构在判别任务和表征学习任务中始终表现优异，但目前波兰语编码器仍大多依赖BERT/RoBERTa风格的架构。本文推出Polish ModernBERT系列波兰语编码器，共包含4个模型，覆盖Base和Large两个参数量级，每个量级下又分别提供512 token上下文和8K上下文两个变体。研究通过多阶段筛选实验适配ModernBERT预训练方案，同时发布了覆盖法律主题分类、意识形态决策方向预测、文学剧情摘要事实一致性评估、人权侵犯评估任务的长上下文基准。在30项任务上的测试结果显示，Polish ModernBERT是所有参评波兰语编码器中综合性能最优的，Base-8K和Large-8K模型的得分分别达到83.99和85.11。在长上下文任务上，8K变体相比同配置的波兰语RoBERTa-8K基线，Base级别的性能从67.47提升至77.15，Large级别的性能从75.88提升至78.49，其中Base-8K模型实现该性能增益的同时参数量还减少了22%（1.49亿 vs 1.9亿）。代表性推理场景下的效率测试显示，无论是512 token还是8K设置，该系列模型的峰值内存占用和延迟均低于同配置的波兰语RoBERTa基线。此外，Polish ModernBERT-8K-Base在所有参数量低于3亿的参评波兰语编码器中，在波兰语检索基准上取得了最优结果。

title: Behaviorally Effective LoRA Writes Are Sparse and Structured
title_zh: 行为有效的LoRA写入是稀疏且结构化的
authors: Haruto Sato, Yuki Tanaka, Ren Nakamura, Aoi Kobayashi, Mei Ito
abstract: Low-rank adaptation fixes the rank of the update, but it does not identify which parts of a trainedwrite actually carry behavior. We study that question directly and show that behaviorally effectiveLoRA writes are sparse, structured, and far more concentrated than the raw low-rank parameterizationsuggests.We use Learned-Basis LoRA, a learned-basis continuation recipe, to expose that structure. The recipewarms up an unconstrained adapter, converts its learned write columns into a module-wise orthonormalbasis, freezes that basis, and continues training inside the constrained parameterization. Across 14exact switches from unconstrained to constrained form, held-out accuracy is unchanged at theconversion step and reconstructed write matrices differ by at most 0.25% relative Frobenius error.Same-state continuation then shows that the same trained checkpoint develops differently underdifferent write subspaces, establishing write geometry as a causal state variable. A no-retrainingprojection test shows that useful write signal stays inside the learned write space and largelydisappears from random or frozen-activation PCA controls.The concentration pattern is strong at both local and global scales. Across GSM8K, MathQA, and AQuA,per-module top-k continuation reaches its optimum at k in {2, 4} in all twelve seed-level cases wetest. A stricter global ranking test shows that learned top-16 and top-32 subsets outperform matchedrandom subsets, especially on GSM8K/Qwen and MathQA/Qwen. Single-direction ablations further reveal asparse set of late q_proj, o_proj, and down_proj components with outsized behavioral impact.
summary_zh: 低秩适配（LoRA）固定了更新的秩，但并未识别出训练得到的写入参数中哪些部分实际决定了模型行为。本文针对该问题开展研究，证明行为有效的LoRA写入是稀疏、结构化的，其集中度远高于原始低秩参数化所呈现的水平。研究使用Learned-Basis LoRA（学习基延续训练方案）暴露该结构：先对无约束适配器进行预热，将其学习得到的写入列转换为按模块划分的标准正交基，冻结该基后在约束参数化空间内继续训练。14次从无约束形式到约束形式的精确切换实验显示，转换步骤的留一准确率完全不变，重构得到的写入矩阵的相对Frobenius误差最高仅为0.25%。同状态下的延续训练进一步显示，同一训练得到的检查点在不同写入子空间下的演化路径完全不同，证明写入几何是决定模型行为的因果状态变量。无需重训练的投影测试表明，有效写入信号全部保留在学习得到的写入空间内，在随机空间或冻结激活PCA对照空间中几乎完全消失。该集中模式在局部和全局尺度下都十分显著：在GSM8K、MathQA和AQuA三个数据集上，所有12个种子级别的测试中，按模块取top-k的延续训练都在k取{2,4}时达到最优；更严格的全局排序测试显示，学习得到的top-16和top-32子集性能优于同规模随机子集，在GSM8K/Qwen和MathQA/Qwen场景下优势尤为明显。单方向消融实验进一步识别出一组稀疏的后期q_proj、o_proj和down_proj组件，它们对模型行为的影响远高于其他组件。

title: How Correct Is Your Answer? A Semantic Correctness Framework for Open QA Evaluation
title_zh: 你的答案准确度如何？面向开放问答评估的语义正确性框架
authors: Elitsa Yotkova, Violeta Kastreva, Petar Velkov, Hristo Boyanov, Dimitar Dimitrov 等 (7 人)
abstract: Reliable evaluation of open-ended question answering remains a bottleneck for measuring answer correctness of modern LLMs. Unlike multiple-choice tasks, free-form answers may be correct in many surface forms and may fail in qualitatively different ways, including incompleteness, contradiction, overgeneration, and endorsement of false premises. Existing judgment-based and similarity-based metrics often collapse these distinctions. We address this gap with three reusable contributions. First, we introduce a semantic correctness taxonomy that assigns open-ended answers to eight ordered classes, separating verbose-but-correct answers from those contaminated by hallucinated content. Second, we release CAP-Correctness, an 8.8k-example benchmark spanning widely used QA datasets, and CAP-Statements, an 11k-example dataset for converting question-answer pairs into declarative statements for natural language inference (NLI) training and statement-based evaluation. Third, we introduce CAP (Context-Aware Precision), a reference-based metric that scores question-conditioned statements using bidirectional NLI. Under a monotonicity protocol testing whether metrics respect the taxonomy's intended ordering, CAP outperforms established baselines.
summary_zh: 开放域问答的可靠评估是衡量现代大语言模型答案正确性的核心瓶颈。与多项选择任务不同，自由形式的答案可能存在大量不同的正确表面形式，也可能以不同的方式出错，包括信息不完整、自相矛盾、生成冗余内容、认可错误前提等，现有的基于裁判和基于相似度的指标往往无法区分这些差异。本文提出三项可复用的贡献填补该空白：第一，提出语义正确性分类体系，将开放域答案划分为8个有序类别，区分内容详实的正确答案和被幻觉内容污染的答案；第二，发布CAP-Correctness基准，包含8800个样本，覆盖主流问答数据集，同时发布CAP-Statements数据集，包含11000个样本，用于将问答对转换为陈述语句，供自然语言推理（NLI）训练和基于陈述的评估使用；第三，提出CAP（Context-Aware Precision，上下文感知精确率）这一基于参考的指标，通过双向自然语言推理对基于问题的陈述打分。在用于验证指标是否符合分类体系预设顺序的单调性协议测试中，CAP的表现优于所有已有的基线指标。

title: Separating Syntax from Language: A Mechanistic Account of Translation in Multilingual LLMs
title_zh: 将句法与语言分离：多语言大语言模型翻译的机制解释
authors: Mikhail Sonkin, Tanja Baeumel, Daniil Gurgurov, Josef van Genabith, Simon Ostermann
abstract: Multilingual large language models (mLLMs) achieve strong performance in machine translation, yet our understanding of the mechanisms by which they transform representations from one language to another remains incomplete. Prior work suggests that translation decomposes into separable processes within an mLLM, where conceptual content is first represented independently, followed by a production into language-specific form. In this work, we show that translation is even more modular than previously assumed and that the output language production in translation processes is actually further separable into a syntax and a surface language process. We construct controlled multilingual datasets that isolate cross-linguistic differences in word-order and use causal interventions and probing to track how representations are transformed during translation. We find that models first construct target-side word-order before realizing the target language surface form. We identify individual attention heads that are selectively sensitive to syntactic transformations while remaining largely invariant to language identity. These results establish the commitment to a syntactic structure as an independent stage in translation, extending prior decompositions and showing how translation is implemented by functionally different components within mLLMs.
summary_zh: 多语言大语言模型（mLLMs）在机器翻译任务上表现优异，但学界对其将表征从一种语言转换为另一种语言的机制仍缺乏完整理解。现有研究认为翻译在多语言大模型内部可分解为多个独立过程：首先独立表征概念内容，再生成对应特定语言的表层形式。本文发现翻译的模块化程度比此前假设的更高：翻译过程中的目标语言生成环节可进一步拆分为句法处理和表层语言处理两个独立过程。研究构建了可控的多语言数据集，隔离不同语言间的词序差异，通过因果干预和探针技术追踪翻译过程中的表征变换规律，发现模型会先构建目标侧的词序，再生成目标语言的表层形式。研究还识别出多个注意力头，它们对句法变换具有选择性敏感性，同时几乎不受语言身份的影响。上述结果证明句法结构生成是翻译过程中的独立阶段，拓展了此前的翻译分解理论，揭示了多语言大模型内部不同功能组件实现翻译的机制。

title: VerTox: Verifiable Reward-Guided Corpus Poisoning Against Neural Ranking Models
title_zh: VerTox：面向神经排序模型的可验证奖励引导语料库投毒攻击框架
authors: Zhiqi Huang, Vivek Datla, Zhichao Xu, Puxuan Yu, Vivek Srikumar 等 (6 人)
abstract: Neural ranking models have become core components of modern information retrieval systems and important building blocks of AI systems such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines. However, their robustness remains insufficiently understood in the presence of large language models (LLMs), which can generate fluent and deceptive content at scale. This work investigates the vulnerability of neural ranking models to corpus poisoning attacks, in which an adversary injects a small number of maliciously crafted documents into the corpus to distort ranking behavior. We propose VerTox, the first framework to formulate corpus poisoning as a verifiable reward-guided reinforcement learning (RLVR) problem. By explicitly coupling ranking distortion with factual corruption through specialized reward shaping, we fine-tune compact LLMs into adversarial generators. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves near-perfect attack success rates, producing adversarial documents that frequently rank higher than target documents across major neural ranking architectures, as well as a proprietary commercial embedding model. The generated adversarial documents are fluent and exhibit low perplexity, making them difficult to detect. Furthermore, by explicitly encouraging factual corruption, our adversarial documents significantly degrade the performance of a downstream RAG application.
summary_zh: 神经排序模型已经成为现代信息检索系统的核心组件，也是检索增强生成（RAG）流水线等AI系统的重要基础模块。但随着大语言模型可大规模生成流畅且具备欺骗性的内容，神经排序模型在该场景下的鲁棒性仍未得到充分研究。本文针对神经排序模型的语料库投毒攻击漏洞开展研究：攻击者向语料库中注入少量精心构造的恶意文档，即可扭曲排序模型的行为。本文提出VerTox，这是首个将语料库投毒建模为可验证奖励引导强化学习（RLVR）问题的框架。通过特殊的奖励塑形机制将排序扭曲效果与事实篡改效果显式耦合，研究对小型大模型进行微调得到对抗生成器。实验表明该方法的攻击成功率接近完美，生成的对抗文档在主流神经排序架构以及商用专有嵌入模型中，排名经常高于目标文档；生成的对抗文档流畅度高、困惑度低，难以被检测。此外，通过显式鼓励事实篡改，该对抗文档还会显著降低下游RAG应用的性能。

title: Explore Before Committing: Hypothesis-Guided Search for Deep Research Agents
title_zh: 决策前先探索：面向深度研究智能体的假设引导搜索方法
authors: Ruochen Zhou, Zhengyu Chen, Luan Zhang, Siyang Gao, Yee Whye Teh 等 (6 人)
abstract: Deep-research agents answer complex questions by interacting with search and browsing tools, yet they often search along a single evolving trajectory. Our trajectory-level analysis reveals a common failure mode in which the agent may encounter an early search state with several plausible directions, but follow one direction before collecting enough comparative evidence. Once this happens, subsequent tool calls tend to reinforce the same path, increasing the chance of failure when the initial direction is misleading. We further find that successful trajectories reduce this risk through two behaviors: grounding vague exploration in concrete candidates and shifting directions when the current path is weak or incomplete. Based on these findings, we propose HypoSearch, which generates lightweight hypotheses as soft search hints, explores them through bounded independent branches, and compares branch-level evidence before commitment. Across four deep-research benchmarks and three backbone models, HypoSearch consistently outperforms single-trajectory search and standard parallel baselines, improving Qwen3.5-122B from 46.7 to 60.0 on BC-small while using fewer tool calls than five independent trajectories. A pilot supervised fine-tuning study further shows that these behavioral signals can curate compact training trajectories and reduce degradation from unfiltered data.
summary_zh: 深度研究智能体通过与搜索、浏览工具交互回答复杂问题，但这类智能体通常仅沿单条不断演化的轨迹开展搜索。本文的轨迹层面分析发现了一类常见的失效模式：智能体在早期搜索状态下会遇到多个可行方向，但尚未收集足够对比证据就选择了其中一个方向，后续的工具调用往往会不断强化该路径，当初始方向存在误导性时，智能体失效的概率会大幅提升。研究进一步发现，成功的搜索轨迹会通过两种行为降低该风险：基于具体候选锚定模糊探索，以及在当前路径存在缺陷或信息不完整时主动切换方向。基于上述发现，本文提出HypoSearch（假设搜索框架）：生成轻量级假设作为软搜索提示，通过多个有界的独立分支探索不同假设，在最终确定搜索路径前先对比各分支收集到的证据。在4个深度研究基准和3个骨干模型上的实验显示，HypoSearch的性能始终优于单轨迹搜索和标准并行基线，在BC-small数据集上将Qwen3.5-122B的性能从46.7提升至60.0，同时工具调用量低于5条独立轨迹的基线。试点监督微调实验进一步表明，这类行为信号可用于筛选高质量的训练轨迹，减少未过滤数据带来的性能退化。

title: From Base Rollouts to RL Reasoning: A Budgeted Search Perspective
title_zh: 从基础模型Rollout到强化学习推理：基于预算搜索的视角
authors: Wenhe Sun, Cunxiang Wang, Zijun Yao, Yixin Cao
abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves language-model reasoning, but how these gains relate to inference-time decoding and search remains unclear. Does RL create reasoning the base model lacks, or shift the rollout distribution toward trajectories it can already reach but rarely samples? We study this behaviorally with a Unified Decoding Framework (UDF), which expresses token-level sampling, beam-like search, tree search, and sequence-level resampling as executable policies over a shared budgeted operating space, scored post hoc with pass@$k$, self-consistency, best-of-$N$, and first-finish success. Using paired Base/RL checkpoints from SimpleRL-Zoo, we ask whether an RL default-policy curve can be approximated by a structured path of Base operating points. On Math500, AIME, GPQA, and IFEval, the pass@$k$ recovery path follows a Budgeted Operating-Point Transition Rule (BOPTR), $N_{\mathrm{Base}} \approx \alpha N_{\mathrm{RL}}^{\beta}$, with benchmark-conditioned exponents. On Qwen2.5-7B, BOPTR gives the lowest transfer error among the non-oracle rules we test, 3.41 pp (95% CI [2.32, 5.53]); a three-seed replication gives 3.07 $\pm$ 0.39 pp. The rule extends to ten models across four families (3.28 to 4.87 pp on checkpoints added after fitting), to four benchmarks it was never fitted on (5.03 pp vs. 4.44 pp in fit), and holds without an RL checkpoint for the target model (4.19 pp) or without RL supervision of any kind (5.08 pp). These results support a qualified internalized-search reading: under the recipe we test, much of the measured RL gain corresponds to a change in sampling efficiency toward operating points the base model can already reach under search. We treat the scaling patterns as descriptive of this recipe and cohort, report where they break down, and use UDF and BOPTR as behavioral diagnostics rather than evidence of parameter-level equivalence.
summary_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）可提升大语言模型的推理能力，但该性能增益与推理时刻的解码和搜索过程的关联机制尚不明确：强化学习是生成了基础模型原本不具备的推理能力，还是仅将rollout分布向基础模型本就可到达但极少采样的轨迹偏移？本文通过统一解码框架（UDF）开展行为层面研究，该框架将token级采样、类束搜索、树搜索和序列级重采样统一表示为共享预算操作空间下的可执行策略，事后通过pass@k、自一致性、best-of-N和首次完成成功率等指标打分。基于SimpleRL-Zoo中配对的基础模型/强化学习检查点开展实验，验证了强化学习的默认策略曲线可通过基础模型的结构化操作点路径近似。在Math500、AIME、GPQA和IFEval数据集上，pass@k的恢复路径符合BOPTR（预算工作点转移规则）：N_Base ≈ α N_RL^β，其中指数由具体基准决定。在Qwen2.5-7B模型上，BOPTR的迁移误差在所有非先知规则中最低，仅为3.41个百分点（95%置信区间[2.32,5.53]），三次种子重复实验得到的误差为3.07±0.39个百分点。该规则可泛化到4个家族的10个模型上（拟合后新增的检查点上误差为3.28~4.87个百分点），也可泛化到从未参与拟合的4个基准上（误差5.03个百分点，拟合集上误差为4.44个百分点），甚至在没有目标模型的强化学习检查点（误差4.19个百分点）、完全没有任何强化学习监督的场景下（误差5.08个百分点）依然成立。上述结果支持经过限定的内化搜索解释：在本文测试的训练方案下，观测到的大部分强化学习性能增益本质上是采样效率的提升，将分布向基础模型在搜索机制下本就可到达的操作点偏移。本文将该缩放模式视为当前训练方案和测试队列下的经验性描述，报告了该规律失效的场景，并将UDF和BOPTR作为行为诊断工具使用，而非参数层面等价性的证明。

title: What Does an Agentic Software Engineering Benchmark Measure? Profiling Task Demands and Agent Behaviour Beyond What Category Labels Reveal
title_zh: 智能体软件工程基准测试究竟衡量什么？突破类别标签揭示局限的任务需求画像与智能体行为分析
authors: Radin Shayanfar, Keheliya Gallaba, Ahmed E. Hassan
abstract: Agentic software engineering benchmarks are typically summarized by nominal category labels such as "bug fix" or "feature implementation," yet benchmarks carrying the same label are built through very different curation pipelines. A label thus reveals little about the engineering work a benchmark demands. We introduce the Spread--Novelty--Centrality (SNC) profile, a three-axis characterization of the demands of repository-level coding tasks, grounded in empirical software engineering research. We apply the profile to five widely used benchmarks and 14,922 trajectories of two model families at three scales, and report three findings. (1) A label is an unreliable proxy for task demands, as every pair of benchmarks is statistically separated on at least two SNC axes, and the separations trace back to specific curation decisions. (2) Agent behaviour reveals demands that the human-written gold solution cannot. Agents produce larger solutions than the gold where problem statements withhold hints and smaller ones where curation inflates the gold. How a task is phrased shapes what an agent produces. (3) Task demands correlate with success uniformly, with resolved runs concentrating in the low-SNC region for every family and scale, whereas the behavioural signatures of success are family-specific. Claude succeeds by matching the scope of the gold solution, and its parity share on files rises from $0.17$ at the smallest scale to $0.54$ at the largest. Qwen succeeds by exceeding the gold scope at every scale, and editing too little marks failure for both families.
summary_zh: 智能体软件工程基准测试通常用“漏洞修复”“功能实现”这类名义类别标签进行概括，但带有相同标签的基准测试往往是通过差异极大的构建流程生成的，因此标签几乎无法体现基准测试对工程工作的实际要求。本文提出SNC（分布-新颖性-中心性）画像框架，这一基于实证软件工程研究构建的三维度表征体系可对仓库级编码任务的需求进行刻画。我们将该画像框架应用于5个广泛使用的基准测试，以及2个模型家族、3种规模下的14922条运行轨迹，得到三项研究结论：（1）类别标签无法可靠表征任务需求，任意两个基准测试在至少两个SNC维度上都存在统计层面的显著差异，这类差异可追溯到具体的基准构建决策；（2）智能体行为能够揭示人工编写的黄金标准答案无法体现的任务需求：当问题描述缺少提示信息时，智能体生成的解决方案规模大于黄金标准，而当基准构建流程人为放大黄金标准规模时，智能体生成的解决方案规模更小，任务的表述方式会直接影响智能体的输出结果；（3）任务需求与任务成功的相关性表现一致，所有模型家族、所有规模下的成功运行样本都集中在SNC得分较低的区域，但不同家族的成功行为特征存在差异：Claude通过匹配黄金标准答案的规模实现成功，其输出与黄金标准重合的文件占比从最小规模下的0.17提升至最大规模下的0.54；Qwen在所有规模下都通过超出黄金标准的规模实现成功，而编辑量不足是两个模型家族共同的失败特征。

title: Ready to Speak: Aligning LLMs for TTS-Friendly Text Generation
title_zh: 就绪可发声：对齐大语言模型生成适配语音合成（TTS）的文本
authors: Thibaut Thonet, Jos Rozen, Laurent Besacier
abstract: Current Large Language Models (LLMs) are primarily optimized for written text, often producing outputs that are grammatically correct and helpful yet poorly suited for spoken delivery via Text-to-Speech (TTS). In this work, we study how to make LLMs natively generate TTS-friendly text, which we frame as a preference alignment problem: instead of relying on downstream rewriting modules, we directly align LLMs to generate text optimized for spoken delivery. We introduce two preference datasets spanning different target domains, CORA and Recipe, which contain paired TTS-friendly and TTS-unfriendly responses. We further propose an evaluation suite combining a pattern-based heuristic metric, a TTS$\to$ASR evaluation pipeline, and a MUSHRA listening study with human judges. Our experiments compare the recently proposed Feature-aware Sampling and Tuning (FaST) framework -- leveraging interpretable features instead of a black-box reward model -- against an array of alignment baselines on the TTS-friendly generation task. Notably, we found that FaST achieves the best overall tradeoff between TTS-friendliness and helpfulness across various settings. We also identified a strong correlation between our different metrics, highlighting the ability to reliably assess TTS-friendliness via an efficient heuristic.
summary_zh: 当前的大语言模型（LLM）主要针对书面文本优化，生成的输出往往语法正确、信息完备，但并不适合通过语音合成（TTS）技术进行语音播报。本研究探索如何让大语言模型原生生成适配TTS的文本，将该问题定义为偏好对齐问题：不依赖下游重写模块，直接对齐大语言模型的生成逻辑，输出专为语音播报优化的文本。本文构建了覆盖不同目标领域的两个偏好数据集CORA和Recipe，其中包含成对的适配TTS和不适配TTS的响应样本。我们进一步提出了一套综合评估体系，融合基于模式的启发式指标、TTS转自动语音识别（ASR）评估流水线，以及面向人类评审的MUSHRA听力研究。在适配TTS文本生成任务上，我们将近期提出的FaST（特征感知采样与调优）框架（该框架利用可解释特征而非黑盒奖励模型）与多种对齐基线方法进行对比，实验结果表明，FaST在不同设置下均实现了TTS适配性与内容有用性之间的最优整体权衡。我们还发现不同评估指标之间存在强相关性，证明可以通过高效的启发式方法可靠评估文本的TTS适配性。

title: CaRL-EM: Cost-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Entity Matching with LLMs
title_zh: CaRL-EM：面向大语言模型实体匹配的成本感知强化学习方法
authors: Chaohui Guo, Michel Klein, Zhisheng Huang
abstract: Entity matching (EM) requires fine-grained contextual understanding and domain knowledge. Recent work shows that large language models (LLMs) can serve as strong matchers across domains, but most methods either make independent pairwise decisions or rely on manually designed composite pipelines, thus lacking flexibility in realistic multi-candidate settings. At the same time, they typically ignore inference cost at scale. We formulate LLM-based EM with candidates as a cost-aware sequential decision problem and propose CaRL-EM, a reinforcement learning controller that manages LLM operations. Given the state of an anchor record, its candidate set, and the cost, CaRL-EM adaptively chooses among different operators (Match/Compare/Select/Decide) and model capacities to maximize a quality-cost objective. The policy interacts with abstract operators, allowing the same controller to be reused with different underlying LLM backends at inference time without retraining. Experiments on 7 benchmarks show that CaRL-EM (i) learns to dynamically plan the usage of inexpensive and expensive operators based on task complexity, (ii) achieves robust zero-shot transfer across diverse datasets and domains, and (iii) consistently achieves a better quality-cost trade-off than strong LLM-based baselines and manually designed pipelines, yielding a lower inference cost at comparable or higher quality.
summary_zh: 实体匹配（EM）需要细粒度的上下文理解能力与领域知识。现有研究表明大语言模型（LLM）可作为跨领域的高性能匹配器，但多数方法要么独立处理两两匹配决策，要么依赖人工设计的复合流水线，在真实多候选场景下灵活性不足，同时通常忽略大规模推理场景下的成本问题。本文将基于大语言模型的带候选集实体匹配问题建模为成本感知的序列决策问题，提出CaRL-EM这一强化学习控制器用于管理大语言模型的操作流程。给定锚点记录状态、对应的候选集与成本约束，CaRL-EM可自适应选择不同操作算子（匹配/对比/筛选/决策）与模型算力等级，实现质量-成本目标的最大化。该强化学习策略与抽象算子交互，使得同一控制器在推理阶段无需重新训练即可适配不同的底层大语言模型后端。在7个基准数据集上的实验结果表明：（1）CaRL-EM可根据任务复杂度动态规划低成本与高成本算子的使用策略；（2）它在不同数据集与领域下均实现了鲁棒的零样本迁移效果；（3）与性能优异的大语言模型基线方法和人工设计流水线相比，CaRL-EM始终能实现更优的质量-成本权衡，在匹配或更高输出质量的前提下降低推理成本。

title: PersuaRL: Reinforcement Learning-Driven Multi-Expert Selection for Persuasive Dialogue Generation in Insurance
title_zh: PersuaRL：基于强化学习的多专家选择框架用于保险领域说服性对话生成
authors: Rohan Kirti, Akash Ghosh, Aryan Vats, Niladri Ghosh, Shipra Shriparn 等 (8 人)
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are revolutionizing digital communication by powering conversational agents deployed across domains such as customer service, digital sales, and insurance. These agents, built on LLMs, can understand user input, retrieve relevant information, and generate coherent responses. However, while they excel at factual communication, they often lack the ability to engage in truly persuasive, context-sensitive dialogue, especially in domains like insurance, where trust and clarity are critical. Building on this need within the insurance domain, our work focuses on improving the persuasiveness of digital agents, aka LLMs. To support this, we introduce InsureDial, a Persuasive Insurance Dialogue dataset, designed to capture the nuances of persuasive communication specific to motor insurance interactions. We introduce PersuaRL, a reinforcement learning-based framework that equips LLM-driven dialogue agents with the ability to adaptively explore, select, and coordinate strategies across multiple expert modules, guided by the evolving dialogue context, to achieve more effective persuasion. We conduct extensive automatic human and qualitative evaluations on two benchmark persuasion dialogue datasets, including our InsureDial. Our evaluations consistently demonstrate that PersuaRL outperforms baseline, generating contextually appropriate and highly persuasive responses.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）正在革新数字交互模式，为客服、数字销售、保险等领域部署的对话智能体提供能力支撑。这类基于大语言模型构建的智能体可以理解用户输入、检索相关信息并生成连贯响应，但它们擅长事实性沟通，却往往缺乏生成真正具备说服力、上下文感知能力对话的能力，在保险这类对信任度与信息清晰度要求极高的领域表现尤为突出。针对保险领域的这一需求，本研究聚焦于提升数字智能体（即大语言模型）的说服能力，为此构建了专门的说服性保险对话数据集InsureDial，用于捕捉车险交互场景下说服性沟通的独特细节特征。本文提出PersuaRL这一基于强化学习的框架，可让大语言模型驱动的对话智能体根据动态演进的对话上下文，自适应地探索、选择并协调多专家模块的策略，实现更高效的说服效果。我们在两个说服性对话基准数据集（包括自建的InsureDial）上开展了大量自动评估、人工评估与定性评估，结果一致表明PersuaRL的表现优于基线方法，能够生成符合上下文场景、说服力极强的响应内容。

title: LLMPEDIA: Browsing, Verifying, and Comparing the Parametric Encyclopedic Knowledge of LLMs
title_zh: LLMPEDIA：浏览、验证与对比大语言模型的参数化百科知识
authors: Muhammed Saeed, Simon Razniewski
abstract: Flagship language models appear saturated on benchmarks like MMLU (Hendrycks et al., 2021), scoring above 90% - yet benchmarks test only what the experimenter thought to ask, the availability bias of fixed question sets. LLMPEDIA makes this bias measurable and browsable. We recursively materialized ~1.3M articles from three model families' parametric memory (GPT-5-mini, DeepSeek-V3.2, Llama-3.3-70B) without retrieval, then audited a stratified sample of atomic claims against Wikipedia and a curated web stack, coloring every claim supported, refuted, or insufficient (Saeed and Razniewski, 2026). On a uniform random sample the true rate is 68.4% - more than 21 pp below MMLU - with 30.5% of claims insufficient: assertions no benchmark probes and the world's largest encyclopedia cannot adjudicate - long-tail knowledge or plausible hallucination, the evidence cannot tell - extending to free text the coverage gap GPTKB established for triples (Hu et al., 2025). The resulting live, open encyclopedia lets visitors inspect this frontier one claim at a time through five one-click views - link-traversal exploration, claim-level factuality, cross-model and political-persona comparison, and a guided topic drill-down - each page, claim, and verdict at a stable URL. LLMPEDIA is live atthis https URL
summary_zh: 主流旗舰语言模型在MMLU等基准测试上的表现似乎已达饱和，得分超过90%，但这类基准测试仅覆盖实验者预设的问题，存在固定问题集带来的可得性偏差。LLMPEDIA可对该偏差进行量化并支持可视化浏览。我们在不使用外部检索的前提下，从3个模型家族（GPT-5-mini、DeepSeek-V3.2、Llama-3.3-70B）的参数化记忆中递归生成约130万篇文章，随后对分层抽样得到的原子级声明样本对照维基百科与精选网页资源进行核验，将所有声明标记为已证实、已证伪或信息不足三类（Saeed和Razniewski，2026）。在均匀随机样本上，大语言模型生成声明的真实准确率仅为68.4%，比MMLU得分低21个百分点以上，其中30.5%的声明属于信息不足类：这类声明没有被任何现有基准测试覆盖，全球最大的百科全书也无法判定其真伪，属于长尾知识或看似合理的幻觉，现有证据无法区分二者，这一发现将此前GPTKB针对三元组发现的覆盖缺口拓展到了自由文本领域（Hu等，2025）。最终生成的开放在线百科平台支持用户通过五个一键式视图逐一核验知识边界：链接遍历探索、声明级事实性校验、跨模型对比与政治立场对比、引导式主题下钻，所有页面、声明与核验结果都对应稳定的访问地址。LLMPEDIA可通过给出的链接在线访问。

title: Subword Segmental BabyLMs: Learning to Tokenise for Sample-Efficient Pretraining
title_zh: 子词分段BabyLM：面向样本高效预训练的可学习分词方法
authors: Francois Meyer
abstract: In the standard LM training pipeline, subword tokenisation is applied as a preprocessing step. Subword segmental language modelling is an alternative paradigm in which tokenisation is learned during training, allowing the model to discover subword units that optimise its training objective. In this paper, we present our submission to the 2026 BabyLM Challenge, for which we develop two new subword segmental LMs: SubSegGPT and SubSegDeBERTa. SubSegGPT is a decoder-only model that learns tokenisation during autoregressive pretraining. SubSegDeBERTa is an encoder-based model that jointly learns to generate and tokenise masked words. We train both for the Strict and Strict-small tracks. Our top submission to Strict is SubSegDeBERTa, which achieves notable gains in zero-shot evaluation. Our top submission to Strict-small is SubSegGPT, which outperforms tokenisation-based baselines. Our results show that learnable subword tokenisation can improve sample-efficiency for BabyLM pretraining. We analyse the subword learning dynamics of our models and find that tokenisation gradually converges on subword units that balance morphological alignment and fine-grained segmentation.
summary_zh: 在标准的语言模型训练流水线中，子词分词是作为预处理步骤执行的。子词分段语言建模是一种替代范式，该范式下分词过程在训练过程中同步学习，让模型自行发现能够优化训练目标的子词单元。本文介绍了我们提交至2026年BabyLM挑战赛的成果，开发了两种全新的子词分段语言模型：SubSegGPT与SubSegDeBERTa。SubSegGPT是仅含解码器的模型，在自回归预训练过程中同步学习分词逻辑。SubSegDeBERTa是基于编码器的模型，联合学习掩码词的生成与分词过程。我们针对挑战赛的Strict赛道与Strict-small赛道分别训练两个模型，提交至Strict赛道的最优模型SubSegDeBERTa在零样本评估中取得了显著性能提升，提交至Strict-small赛道的最优模型SubSegGPT性能超过了基于固定分词的基线方法。研究结果表明，可学习子词分词能够提升BabyLM预训练的样本效率。我们对模型的子词学习动态进行了分析，发现分词过程会逐步收敛到兼顾形态对齐与细粒度分割的子词单元。

title: Does task decomposition improve automatic NLG evaluation?
title_zh: 任务分解能否提升自动自然语言生成（NLG）评估效果？
authors: Sebastian Steindl, Nikos Voskarides, Alberto Gasparin, Diego Marcheggiani
